You'll also help turn recurring deal questions into playbooks and processes that let Dust move faster.

What you'll do

GTM partnership and deal execution

  • Work directly with Sales and GTM on customer and partner opportunities, from deal shaping through negotiation and signature.

  • Develop negotiation strategies, propose workable alternatives and help resolve customer objections.

  • Explain risk in commercial terms and help teams move deals forward, escalating material decisions to the General Counsel.

  • Act as a legal engineer to help develop and refine our daily use of AI agents across the business.

Commercial contracting

  • Draft, review and negotiate SaaS agreements, MSAs, order forms, DPAs, security terms and procurement documents.

  • Work through terms involving pricing and usage commitments, liability, indemnities, data use, security, audit rights and service commitments.

  • Support vendor, technology-provider and strategic partnership agreements.

Privacy, regulation and product considerations

  • Integrate privacy, data protection, AI regulatory, security and other relevant considerations into commercial deal strategy.

  • Work with Product, Security, Privacy and other teams to assess proposed customer commitments and identify practical solutions.

Playbooks and legal operations

  • Turn recurring GTM questions and negotiation patterns into templates, fallback language, playbooks and training.

  • Use Dust and other appropriate tools to make legal work more efficient, while applying sound judgment to confidential and sensitive matters.

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same three dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Qualified lawyer in England & Wales, France or another relevant jurisdiction, with substantial commercial contracts experience. Around five years' post-qualification experience is a useful guide, not a hard cutoff and we would consider exceptional candidates with fewer years experience. We hire for talent and aptitude rather than pure qualifications.

  • Experience actively supporting commercial teams and negotiating B2B technology or SaaS deals.

title: Compliance Manager
descriptionHtml:
About us

Plentific is pioneering real-time property operations for real-world impact. Our Software as a Service (SaaS) platform connects owners, operators, service providers and residents. We work with housing associations, local authorities, student housing, later living and build-to-rent operators, across a growing network of 1.7M+ properties and 5,000+ service providers worldwide, reaching 3M+ engaged residents.

Our customers trust us with their residents’ data, their supply chains and their money. This role makes sure that trust is earned every day.

Mission

You'll run Plentific’s compliance programme day to day: KYC, data protection, ISO 27001, business risk and internal audit. You’ll make it practical, evidence-based and quick, using AI tools to do in hours what used to take days.

What you’ll own

  • KYC and due diligence

  • Data protection

  • ISO 27001 ISMS

  • Business risk register

  • Internal audit programme

  • Compliance policies and training

What you’ll do

KYC and due diligence

  • Run KYC checks on customers, suppliers and service providers: identity, ownership, sanctions, PEP and adverse media.

  • Set risk-based rules for when enhanced due diligence applies, and escalate cases that need a decision.

  • Keep KYC records complete and ready for audit or client review.

Data protection

  • Run day-to-day UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018 compliance: records of processing, DPIAs, retention and data subject requests.

  • Review data processing agreements and supplier privacy terms with the legal team.

  • Manage personal data incidents from first report to close, including the decision on whether to notify the ICO within 72 hours.

Information security (ISO 27001)

  • Maintain the ISMS with Information Security Team: Statement of Applicability, risk treatment plan, control owners and evidence, etc.

  • Lead surveillance and recertification audits with our external certification body.

  • Answer security and compliance questionnaires from housing association and local authority clients.

Business risk and internal audit

  • Own the business risk register. Work with risk owners to rate, treat and report risks to the General Counsel and leadership team.

  • Plan and run an annual internal audit programme across information security, data protection and KYC, and track every finding to closure.

  • Report on compliance status and open risks in a format leadership can act on.

Policies, training and AI

  • Keep compliance policies current, short and written so people actually read them.

  • Run awareness training on data protection, information security and KYC.

  • Use AI tools every day to draft policies, review questionnaires and contracts, gather audit evidence and track regulatory change. Automate the repetitive checks.

  • Help shape how Plentific governs its own use of AI.

What you’ll need

  • 3+ years in a compliance, risk or information governance role, ideally in SaaS, fintech or another regulated tech business.

  • Good working knowledge of KYC checks, including sanctions, PEP and beneficial ownership screening, and the tools used to run them.

  • Hands-on experience of UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018: DPIAs, data subject requests, breach handling and supplier due diligence.

  • Experience running or supporting an ISO 27001 ISMS through certification and surveillance audits.

  • A track record of managing a business risk register and conducting internal audits. An ISO 27001 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor qualification helps.

  • A CIPP/E or CIPM certification is beneficial.

  • AI training credentials are beneficial, such as the IAPP AIGP or an ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer course.

  • You use AI tools daily and can give real examples of how they made your work faster or better.

  • Clear writing, and the confidence to explain a compliance requirement to an engineer, a salesperson or a client.

Nice to have

  • Experience of AI governance, such as the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001 or the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Not essential: if you don’t have it yet, you’ll learn it on the job.

Why Plentific

You'll join a scale up with ambitious growth plans and the backing to deliver them, in a role where you'll impact the future of housing:

title: Credit Manager (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Chez EndLess, un service rendu est un service payé.

Nous collectons, trions et valorisons les déchets de chantier des professionnels du BTP en Île-de-France et dans le Sud : Big Bags, bennes, apport sur site, et une plateforme digitale propriétaire qui pilote nos flux en temps réel. Le groupe réalise 20 M€ de chiffre d’affaires, compte 25 personnes dans ses bureaux de Paris 15e, et grandit par croissance organique et par acquisitions.

Nous créons le poste de Credit Manager. Soyons francs : c’est un poste de terrain dans une PME, pas un poste de pilotage à distance. Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui prend le téléphone, traite les litiges et mène ses dossiers de bout en bout.

Votre mission

Faire en sorte que chacune de nos prestations se transforme en cash, vite et proprement. Vous gérez l’ensemble du portefeuille clients en autonomie, sans équipe à encadrer, et vous êtes rattaché(e) à notre Responsable Administratif et Financier.

Le travail répétitif est déjà automatisé : chaque matin, un agent IA prépare votre liste d’appels priorisée, suit les promesses de paiement et surveille les procédures collectives. Vous gardez ce qui fait la différence : le téléphone, le jugement, la décision.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Appeler chaque jour vos clients, obtenir des engagements de paiement datés et chiffrés, et les faire tenir.
  • Traiter les litiges à la racine avec nos équipes Opérations, Planning et Expérience Client.
  • Animer le comité de crédit hebdomadaire : comptes à bloquer, à débloquer, conditions de paiement.
  • Mener les mises en demeure, les injonctions de payer et les déclarations de créance.
  • Suivre vos indicateurs : cash encaissé, délai de paiement, échu à plus de 90 jours.
  • Faire progresser le dispositif avec l’agent IA, et former nos commerciaux au réflexe « se faire payer ».

Votre profil

  • 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en recouvrement B2B ou en credit management, idéalement auprès de PME, dans le BTP ou les services.
  • Une vraie aisance au téléphone : ferme sur le fond, courtois sur la forme.
  • Les bases juridiques du recouvrement et des procédures collectives.
  • De la rigueur, de la ténacité, et l’habitude d’un logiciel comptable (Pennylane idéalement) et d’un tableur.
  • L’envie de travailler avec des outils d’IA et de les pousser plus loin.

Ce que nous proposons

  • Un CDI à Paris 15e.
  • 40 000 à 45 000 € brut par an selon l’expérience, plus 5 000 € de variable sur objectifs.
  • Un impact visible dès le premier mois : chaque jour de délai gagné, c’est du cash pour financer la croissance du groupe.
  • Des outils qui vous libèrent du travail répétitif.

Notre process

Un premier échange avec un dirigeant, un entretien avec votre futur manager, un test technique puis un entretien « culture ».

title: CRO Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über diese Rolle

Du liebst es, den Engpass im Funnel zu finden und $100 Million Offers zu bauen?

Als CRO Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Performance unseres Onlineshops vom ersten Klick auf die Ad bis zum letzten Upsell. Du analysierst den Funnel von A bis Z, findest den Engpass und löst ihn mit besseren Offers, Funnels und Tests.

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes E-Commerce Scale Up mit Sitz in der Speicherstadt Hamburg. Unsere Mission ist es, Kinder mit innovativen Produkten für das lebenslange Lernen zu begeistern und das Leben von Millionen Familien liebevoller und bunter zu gestalten.

Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte aktiv die Zukunft eines dynamischen Unternehmens mit!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Offer Building: Du entwickelst Offers, Bundles und Angebotsmechaniken auf Basis von Consumer Psychology, die Conversion Rate und AOV steigern.

  • Funnel Building: Du konzipierst Listicles, Advertorials, Quiz-Funnels, VSLs und Produktseiten, die verkaufen.

  • Funnel-Analyse: Du analysierst den Funnel von Creative über Landingpage und Checkout bis zum Upsell, identifizierst den Engpass und entwickelst die Lösung.

  • A/B-Testing: Du baust eine Testing-Roadmap auf, setzt Tests technisch um und wertest sie statistisch sauber aus.

  • Upsells & Tracking: Du baust Upsell-Strecken im Checkout und nach dem Kauf auf und stellst sicher, dass sauberes Tracking jede Entscheidung absichert.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in CRO oder Funnel Building bei einer D2C E-Commerce Brand.

  • Du weißt genau, was ein gutes Offer ausmacht. Bundling und Offer Stacking setzt du sicher ein.

  • Du hast Listicles, Advertorials, Quiz-Funnels oder VSLs selbst gebaut und optimiert.

  • Du beherrschst A/B-Testing technisch und statistisch.

  • Du bist sicher im Shopify-Ökosystem und in Tracking-Tools wie Triple Whale, GA4 oder Clarity.

  • Attraktive Vergütung & echte Aufstiegschancen – Leistung wird gesehen und außergewöhnlicher Einsatz auch außergewöhnlich belohnt.

title: CTO (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the product, roadmap, and development process that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard robotics questions become real product decisions: how do we turn customer needs into a highly capable robotic hand that is reliable, manufacturable, and ready to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As a Chief Technology Officer, you will own TACTILIA's technology strategy, product architecture, and engineering execution. You will lead a multidisciplinary organization across project management, systems engineering, mechanics, electronics, sensorics, embedded and robotics software, AI, product management, applications and testing. Your responsibility is to turn a highly capable robotic hand into a reliable, manufacturable, serviceable and scalable industrial product.

This is a leadership role with substantial technical depth. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every discipline, but you must have first-hand experience with both hardware and software development and the judgment to make sound system-level decisions across both.

What you will do:

Set the technology direction. Define TACTILIA’s technology strategy and product roadmap from the current platform to a scalable industrial product.

Lead the whole stack. Lead the teams across project management, systems, mechanics, electronics, sensorics, embedded and robotics software, AI, product, applications and testing.

Make the architecture work. Own the system architecture and the interfaces between hardware, software, AI and applications.

Turn R&D into product. Drive the transition from advanced prototypes to reliable, manufacturable, serviceable and customer-ready products.

Make the right trade-offs. Balance performance, reliability, cost, safety, manufacturability and speed of execution.

Build the organization. Recruit, develop and lead the engineering and product organization across Zurich and Munich.

Create clarity and accountability. Establish effective priorities, processes, decision-making structures and technical standards across the teams.

Own resources and execution. Manage engineering budgets, headcount and priorities in line with the company’s product and business goals.

Stay close to customers. Translate customer requirements and field experience into product decisions and future technology direction.

Represent TACTILIA externally. Act as the technical face of the company with customers, partners, SCHUNK, investors and the robotics community.

Stay close to the hard problems. Remain sufficiently hands-on to challenge important technical decisions and unblock the team when necessary.

What you bring:

You can lead across hardware and software. You have deep practical understanding of both disciplines and the credibility to guide experts across mechanics, electronics, sensors, embedded systems, controls, AI and applications.

You have led complex engineering organizations. You have successfully led multidisciplinary teams, ideally with responsibility for 20 or more people, multiple functions and a significant budget.

You have shipped physical products. You have taken complex robotics, mechatronics, medical or industrial hardware from development or prototype stage into customer use, production or product maturity.

You understand human-like robotic systems. Ideally, you have experience in humanoid or biomedical robotics, particularly with anthropomorphic mechanisms, sensor and actuator systems, robotic hands or tendon-driven devices.

You think in systems. You can connect mechanics, electronics, sensing, control, software, AI and customer applications into a coherent product architecture.

You build teams that execute. You have a track record of recruiting strong people, developing leaders and creating a culture of ownership and high standards.

You know how to scale engineering. You bring experience from a startup, scale-up or industrial technology company and understand how to combine speed with disciplined execution.

You make sound decisions under uncertainty. You are pragmatic, commercially aware and able to distinguish between the perfect solution and the right solution.

You communicate with every audience. You can engage credibly with engineers, customers, executives, investors and industrial partners.

You have a strong technical foundation. A degree in engineering, computer science, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred.

You are ready to build internationally. You are fluent in English and comfortable working across the Zurich and Munich locations. German is an advantage.

Bonus:

  • Dexterous manipulation, grasp planning, or robotic hands

  • Tactile sensing and contact-rich manipulation

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think AI is what makes the problem solvable; better software alone wasn't enough. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

Sona's Customer Success function is being built from the ground up. $Millions of ARR is moving from Implementation to Customer Success, we're heading into our first year of renewals at scale, and there's meaningful seat expansion across the base. We need CSMs who can shape what good looks like, not operate inside a playbook someone else wrote.

You'll own a book of around 20-25 enterprise accounts across social care, hospitality and retail, partnering with Support, Product and Sales to own the post-live customer experience end to end. Some of the accounts you'll inherit are in difficult places, so you'll be rebuilding trust, holding rooms independently and driving outcomes in ambiguity.

We're a high-performance team. Everyone holds an important seat and is expected to perform at an elite level. We have each other's backs, we assume good intent, and we have zero space for internal politics. If that's your default, you'll thrive here.

This is an on-site role. Four days a week you'll be in our London office or out with customers, with one day working from home. Regular travel to customers across the UK is part of the job.

Responsibilities

  • Own senior customer relationships at Director level and above (Operations, Finance, HR), in person as well as over video, and act as the escalation point for your accounts

  • Run the QBR cadence and own renewals end to end, so the value case is made long before the renewal conversation

  • Drive proactive value work: account audits, surfacing unused functionality, and translating product usage into business outcomes

  • Progress seat upsells as customers grow, and flag wider expansion opportunities to AEs

  • Hold difficult conversations with diplomacy, including product feedback that isn't on the roadmap

  • Manage customer-side projects such as integrations and configuration changes, keeping status visible so customers always know where they stand

  • Help shape how Customer Success works at Sona, from health scoring to escalation

Requirements

  • You've owned a book of enterprise SaaS accounts, whether as a CSM, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales, Implementation Consultant or PM

  • You've held Director-level customer relationships independently and been accountable for the customer health that drives renewal

  • You're commercially fluent around NRR and value realisation, and treat accounts as long-term assets

  • You're confident in complex SaaS products: you can demo, discuss configuration trade-offs and translate capability into business value

  • You've worked in a scaleup where process was still being built

  • You use AI tools daily in your CS work and can point to specific workflows

  • You can disagree with a senior customer and keep the relationship intact

It’d be a bonus if you could bring

  • Hands-on experience with Planhat, Salesforce, or similar CS platforms

  • Track record of identifying and converting commercial expansion opportunities (seat upsells, module flags)

Benefits

  • Salary: £55,000 - £75,000

  • On-site working: 4 days a week in the London office or with customers, 1 day from home

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

  • Pension contributions matched up to 5%

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • Enhanced parental leave & pay

  • Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery)

  • Annual team off-sites and quarterly socials

  • The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

  • Professional development budget

  • Unlimited free books

Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you.

title: Customer Support Mitarbeiter (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du hilfst unseren Kund:innen weiter, schriftlich und am Telefon

Bei eRecht24 melden sich jeden Tag Website-Betreiber, Online-Shops und Agenturen: mit Fragen zu ihrem Zugang, zu Rechnungen, Tarifen und unseren Tools. Sie brauchen jemanden, der ihr Anliegen versteht, verständlich antwortet und sich um die Klärung kümmert.

Wir suchen eine Person, die unseren Customer Support in Vollzeit verstärkt und gern im direkten Kundenkontakt arbeitet. Aktuell bearbeitest du vor allem schriftliche Anfragen. Telefonische Beratung findet bereits in kleinem Umfang statt und wird Schritt für Schritt ausgebaut, eingehend und ausgehend.

Wer wir sind und wo wir stehen

eRecht24 unterstützt Unternehmen bei der rechtlichen Absicherung ihrer Websites und Online-Shops. Dazu gehören der Impressum Generator, der Datenschutz Generator, der Website Scanner und viele weitere Tools, kostenlos im Freemium-Bereich und mit zusätzlichen Funktionen in eRecht24 PREMIUM.

Unser Unternehmen ist in den vergangenen Jahren stark gewachsen. Jetzt professionalisieren wir unsere Abläufe und bauen unser Support-Team weiter auf. Ein modernes Ticketsystem und eine Telefonanlage sind vorhanden. Gemeinsam mit der Teamleitung und deinen Kolleg sorgst du dafür, dass Kund:innen verlässlich Unterstützung erhalten.

Deine Aufgaben

Kundenanfragen bearbeiten und Lösungen finden

  • Du beantwortest schriftliche Anfragen zu Kundenkonten, Rechnungen, Tarifen und der Nutzung unserer Plattform.

  • Du klärst Anliegen selbstständig, hältst den Bearbeitungsstand nachvollziehbar fest und verfolgst offene Fragen bis zur Klärung.

  • Bei technischen oder rechtlich relevanten Fragen bindest du die zuständigen Fachleute ein. Dafür nutzen wir regelmäßige Sprechstunden mit IT und Partnerkanzlei.

Telefonisch beraten und Kund:innen begleiten

  • Du übernimmst telefonische Anfragen und hilfst Kund:innen bei der Nutzung unserer Produkte und der Auswahl passender Tarife.

  • Mit dem Ausbau unserer Telefonberatung kommen ausgehende Gespräche hinzu, etwa zur Klärung offener Anliegen, zur Kundenbindung und zur Rückgewinnung.

  • Du erkennst, wann ein anderer Tarif besser zum Bedarf passt, und erklärst die Möglichkeiten verständlich.

Wissen festhalten und im Team zusammenarbeiten

  • Du dokumentierst wiederkehrende Fragen und bestätigte Lösungen und hältst Antwortvorlagen und Wissensbasis aktuell.

  • Du gibst Rückmeldung, wenn Anleitungen fehlen, Abläufe stocken oder dieselben Probleme wiederholt auftreten.

  • Du stimmst dich mit deiner Teamleitung und deinen Kolleg:innen ab und sorgst für nachvollziehbare Übergaben.

Deine ersten Monate

Zu Beginn: Du lernst unsere Produkte, Tarife und typischen Kundenanliegen kennen. Du arbeitest dich in unsere Systeme ein und übernimmst schrittweise eigene Anfragen.

Nach der Einarbeitung: Du bearbeitest die üblichen Anliegen selbstständig, übernimmst telefonische Kontakte und klärst komplexere Fälle mit den zuständigen Fachleuten.

Mit dem weiteren Ausbau: Telefonische Beratung, Kundenbindung und ausgehende Gespräche werden zu einem größeren Teil deiner Arbeit.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Erfahrung im Customer Support, Kundenservice oder in der Kundenberatung, idealerweise bei einem digitalen Produkt oder Abo-Anbieter.

  • Du formulierst klare, freundliche Antworten und kannst auch kompliziertere Abläufe verständlich erklären.

  • Du telefonierst gern, hörst aufmerksam zu und bleibst auch bei unzufriedenen Kund:innen ruhig und verbindlich.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, setzt Prioritäten und behältst offene Anliegen im Blick.

  • Du findest dich sicher in digitalen Anwendungen zurecht und lernst neue Systeme und Produkte zügig kennen.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, in Wort und Schrift. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen am Telefon auf Deutsch.

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Samstagseinsätzen nach abgestimmtem Dienstplan.

Ein Plus sind Erfahrungen mit Ticketsystemen, Inbound- und Outbound-Telefonie, Kundenbindung oder Tarifberatung. Auch Kenntnisse rund um Websites, Online-Shops und Datenschutz helfen dir beim Einstieg.

Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist nicht nötig. Entscheidend sind deine Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt, deine Verlässlichkeit und die Bereitschaft, dich in unsere Produkte einzuarbeiten.

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Fachliche Unterstützung: Bei technischen und rechtlich relevanten Fragen stehen dir IT und Partnerkanzlei zur Seite.

  • Ein Team im Aufbau: Du steigst in einen Bereich ein, dessen Abläufe und Zusammenarbeit wir gerade weiterentwickeln. Deine Erfahrungen aus dem Kundenkontakt fließen dabei ein.

  • Mehr als schriftlicher Support: Mit dem Ausbau der Telefonie kommen deine Fähigkeiten in Beratung und Kundenbindung zum Tragen.

  • Direkter Austausch: Du arbeitest eng mit der Support-Teamleitung und deinen Kolleg:innen zusammen und gibst Kundenfeedback an die zuständigen Teams weiter.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vollzeit.

  • Arbeitsort Berlin mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeit an telefoniefreien Tagen.

  • Einsatz im Rahmen unserer Serviceabdeckung von Montag bis Samstag.

  • Samstagseinsätze werden mit der Support-Teamleitung abgestimmt.

  • Telefoniedienste finden vor Ort statt.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann lass uns sprechen: ein kurzes Kennenlernen, ein Fachgespräch und anschließend ein Einblick ins Team mit einer praktischen Aufgabe aus unserem Support-Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in deiner Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welche Kundenanfragen bearbeitest du heute oder hast du zuletzt bearbeitet, schriftlich und telefonisch?

  2. Beschreibe ein schwieriges Kundenanliegen: Wie bist du vorgegangen und wie hast du es gelöst?

  3. Welche Erfahrungen hast du mit telefonischer Beratung oder ausgehenden Kundengesprächen?

title: Customer Value Architect III
descriptionHtml:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the Role

Not a technical role, despite 'architect' in the title, this is relationship and strategy work, not engineering. Customer success, account management, or consulting backgrounds are a better fit than technical ones.

The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who thrives on connecting customers' Mixpanel investment to real business outcomes. You'll be the consultative owner of adoption, value, and AI maturity across a named portfolio of high-value accounts, engaged from onboarding through the full contract lifecycle. You are accountable for the outcome, not the commercial relationship owning the value case and the adoption plan behind it. You will build the executive relationships and strategic plans that make Mixpanel indispensable to how your customers build products.

Responsibilities

  • Connect mixpanel to customer value
    • Own our value workstream with customers - understanding the business challenges that led them to buy Mixpanel, how they measure the ROI of their investment, and ensuring that they achieve that ROI by working across the customers’ teams and collaborating internally with other Mixpanel teams.
    • Build and own relationships across business and technical stakeholders, including executive sponsors, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to customers' highest-priority goals.
    • Develop and execute success plans that map customer business objectives to adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
    • Perform ongoing discovery of the customer’s business priorities, internal toolset, and ongoing business pain – synthesize this information into actions that feed your success plans and share information with internal partners as needed.
    • Operate in lockstep with the AE and renewal team, with clear lanes: you partner with the AE on expansion and growth motions and with the renewal team on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that underpins both. You own the value case; they own the commercial outcome.
  • Own value delivery and product relationship 
    • Lead customer enablement sessions—covering topics like dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling—to grow Mixpanel usage depth and breadth across the customer organization.
    • Proactively monitor product usage and health signals; lead regular business reviews to surface insights, deepen adoption, and surface risk early.
    • Drive customer adoption - both identifying new pockets for Mixpanel usage within an organization and strategies for re-engagement where adoption is low.
    • Identify underutilized features and contracted capabilities, translating them into concrete recommendations that expand customer value.
    • Triage customer product requests and issues - solving their use case questions, basic troubleshooting and escalating as appropriate
  • Own the AI Conversation
    • Assess a customer's AI maturity and advise on their agent and context strategy, this is now a first-class part of the job, not a bonus skill.
    • Fluently use Mixpanel's own AI surface (Mixpanel AI, Mixpanel Agent, Headless, and MCP) to help customers building AI-native workflows on their product data.
    • Use AI as a personal operating habit: a rehearsal partner for executive conversations, a discovery-prep engine and stakeholder sentiment analysis.
  • Be the voice of the customer to cross-functional partners
    • Coordinate across GTM, Product, and Engineering to manage escalations, advocate for customer needs, and bring the right resources to bear.
    • Contribute to team playbooks and best practices that scale impact across the broader CS organization.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Experience in Customer Success, management consulting, or a related field supporting complex B2B SaaS accounts.
  • A track record of managing relationships at every level across different functions (from business executives to technical ICs) and influencing decisions at the C-suite level.
  • The ability to translate technical concepts—data models, analytics instrumentation, product metrics—into business terms that resonate with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive platform adoption and connect product usage to customer business outcomes.
  • Experience building and executing strategic value and adoption plans – tying day-to-day activities to strategic outcomes and being able to communicate wins in terms of ROI.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic or AI-native tooling. MCP-based workflows, LLM copilots, or similar (beyond casual ChatGPT use.)

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in a technical advisory or solutions capacity (e.g., implementation, professional services).

#LI-Hybrid

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Why choose Mixpanel?

title: CX Manager (d/w/m)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du verantwortest unsere Wissensdatenbank: Du hältst sie aktuell, vollständig und widerspruchsfrei, für Lumi, unsere internen KI-Tools und unser Team.
  • Du machst unseren KI-Assistenten Lumi besser: Du prüfst seine Antworten, vergleichst sie mit anderen KI-Tools und schärfst über die Wissensdatenbank nach.
  • Du arbeitest jede Produktänderung zeitnah in Wissensdatenbank und Kundenkommunikation ein und gibst neue Informationen an unsere Teams und unsere KI weiter.
  • Du verantwortest unsere Auswertungen: Tickets, Anrufe, CSAT, NPS und Bewertungen. Daraus leitest Du konkrete Verbesserungen für Wissen, Prozesse und Kommunikation ab.
  • Du entwickelst Frühwarnsysteme, die abwanderungsgefährdete Kund:innen erkennen, bevor sie kündigen, und stößt passende Maßnahmen an.
  • Du zeigst unseren Fachabteilungen, was unsere Kund:innen brauchen und wo Probleme entstehen.
  • Du findest gemeinsam mit Customer Service und Technical Support heraus, welche Anliegen künftig direkt im ersten Kontakt gelöst werden können.

  • Du lieferst unserem Produktteam auf Basis der Daten Inhalte und Anlässe, damit wir Kund:innen in allen Kanälen, auch in unserer App, im richtigen Moment informieren.

Dein Profil

title: Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling
descriptionHtml:
Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling

Hybrid in London or remote in the UK

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team.

You'll work on the credit models that sit at the core of iwoca's lending business – the models that decide who we lend to, on what terms, and how far the product can grow.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and customer lifetime value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy.

The team is around twelve data scientists, who combined create models to efficiently drive fully automated and human-in-the-loop decision making. This forms the core analytical team that interface with and support smaller analytic functions in other parts of the business.

The role

As a Data Scientist in Credit Risk Modelling, you'll use iwoca's lending data to answer credit risk and CLtV questions, and build what you find into the team's production models. The work ranges from keeping today's models accurate as conditions change, through incremental improvements, to research that could replace them.

You'll help choose the team's projects and put forward your own. With AI, prototyping is cheap enough for you to test ideas that once wouldn't have made the priority list. The R&D share of the role is growing as a result. You'll learn credit modelling in depth from several senior data scientists.

Live examples of the work:

  • Causal estimation of offer terms. Estimating the causal effect of amount, duration, and price on customer outcomes.

  • Unifying automated and manual models. Finding a principled way to put the two model families, which optimise slightly different objectives, on a common cost function.

  • IFRS accounting model. Developing a multi-stage model where recovery predictions feed back to improve the upfront loss estimates that International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) require.

  • Generalising credit and CLtV. Exploring whether a single, more general model could replace the separate credit and CLtV models.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Applied statistics. You have a background in statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar. You've applied it to real-world data, in research or at work. You know when the data breaks a method's assumptions, and what that does to your answer.

  • Probabilistic reasoning. You quantify the uncertainty in each estimate, and treat calibration as a first-order concern.

  • Research mindset. You've tested new modelling ideas of your own, and judged which were worth taking further.

  • Judgement. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere.

  • Analytical ownership. You've taken ambiguous problems from framing the question to a decision the business acted on. You give an early answer and update it as new evidence comes in.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a prototype, an automation, or a modelling pipeline others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You've worked in credit risk, lending, or customer lifetime value modelling.

  • Production ML. You've built supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Non-linear methods. You can think in terms of the cost function and inductive biases of your models.

  • Bayesian methods. You've used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Time series modelling. You've modelled temporal data where autocorrelation, drift, or seasonality mattered.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 – £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

title: Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Data Scientist at Hawk, you're the person our customers trust to make their AML and fraud detection models actually work for them: tuned to their transaction patterns, defensible to their regulators, and provably effective in their own numbers. You sit inside the regional customer team, working directly alongside Customer Value Partners on live accounts, not behind a wall of tickets from a central data science function. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset.

  • Investigate detection performance deeply: dig into missed cases, alert quality, and pattern drift, and turn what you find into concrete tuning or configuration changes.

  • Translate technical findings into customer-facing insight: build the analysis that shows investigator productivity gains, false positive cost reduction, and detection effectiveness improvements in language a customer's compliance and risk leadership actually uses.

  • Sit in the room with customers directly. Present findings, defend your methodology to a customer's own data science or compliance team, and answer the hard “why did the model do this” questions live.

  • Partner closely with your regional Customer Value Partners on account strategy, informing where the model needs to change to unlock the next stage of value realization or a renewal conversation.

  • Feed patterns and findings back into Hawk's broader model and product functions, distinguishing between “this customer needs local tuning” and “this is a systemic gap worth fixing centrally.”

  • Own the regulatory defensibility of the tuning decisions you make. Document your reasoning so a customer's audit or regulator review holds up.

  • Bring rigor to how you validate model changes before they go live: backtesting, sample review, and sign-off discipline that protects the customer's compliance posture.

Your Profile

  • 5-7 years as a data scientist in a customer-facing role, presenting analysis and defending model decisions directly to clients. This is not an internal-facing engineering or product data science background; you've sat across the table from a customer before.

  • Real experience in AML, fraud detection, or financial crime analytics is required. You understand transaction monitoring, typologies, and what a false positive actually costs an investigator, not just what one costs on a confusion matrix.

  • Strong hands-on skills in the standard data science stack (Python, SQL, and whatever ML tooling you've used in production), but your edge is judgment under ambiguity: knowing when a model change is safe to make and when it needs a human in the loop.

  • Comfortable being the technical voice in a room with a customer's risk, compliance, or data science stakeholders, and holding your own when questioned.

  • A track record of translating model performance into business value a non-technical stakeholder can act on: not just accuracy metrics, but investigator hours saved, false positive cost avoided, and cases caught.

  • Genuine comfort with ambiguity and live production systems. You're not looking for a clean offline research problem, you're looking for the “why did this alert fire on a real customer's data at 2pm today” problem.

  • An ownership mentality. You don't wait for a ticket; you notice when an account's detection performance is drifting and you go find out why.

Bonus

  • Experience specifically in transaction monitoring or payments fraud detection at a bank, payment provider, or a vendor serving them.

  • Familiarity with explainable AI and rules-based hybrid detection approaches, since that's core to how Hawk's models work.

descriptionHtml:
About Dataleap
We're the agentic operating system for the enterprise. We enable business teams to build, scale, and manage the most capable AI employees on the market.

We raised $3M from YC and angels like Aravind (CEO Perplexity) and Rahul Vohra (Superhuman). We have thousands of agents running at 2,000+ person scale-ups and Fortune 500 companies. We have PMF and are doubling revenue every month. We have far more demand than we can handle.

About the role
I'm Sacha, Chief of Staff at Dataleap. I own our existing customers, and I need someone alongside me to make our current accounts win with Dataleap.

This isn't a sales role. Your job is to make the customers we already have wildly successful, to walk into their organizations, find the people who want to build agents, and help them actually do it. You'll run adoption on the ground: sit with teams, understand their work, build agents alongside them, unblock them, and turn curious users into daily believers. When a customer succeeds, it's because you made it happen.

We're building out our German office, and this is the moment to get in. You'll work directly with me and our team on the ground: real customers, real AI deployments, real ownership from week one.

We're hiring for a full-time role in our Growth team, and we're flexible on how you start. Already have a few years under your belt? Join full-time. Still studying or just graduating? Start as a working student or intern and grow into the full-time role, with more ownership, bigger accounts and deeper work as you prove yourself. Either way, we're looking for someone who wants to stay and grow with us. This is your chance to show what you've got, and I'll make sure it's the fastest growth of your career.

 

What you'll own

  • Customer adoption. Drive real usage inside our existing accounts. Find the champions, enable them, and help them pay it forward across their org.

  • Building agents alongside customers. Sit with their teams, understand the messy details of their work, and build agents in Dataleap that solve real problems. You prove the value by shipping it.

  • Being the trusted partner. Become the person our customers love to have in the room, the one who gets their world, makes them better, and makes them feel taken care of.

  • Training and enablement. Run workshops, hackathons, and hands-on sessions that turn non-technical teams into confident agent builders.

  • Being the voice of the customer. Feed what you learn back to me, product, and engineering. Push hard for what our customers need.

  • Automate your own role with Dataleap. We build AI employees for a living, and you'll live in the product you're helping customers adopt. Build agents that eliminate the manual parts of your own job instead of doing them by hand.

Who you are

  • Hungry and proactive. You don't wait to be told. You see what needs doing and you're already on it.

  • Great with people. You're warm, confident, and easy to trust. You can walk into a room of people you've never met and have them rooting for you by the end.

  • Someone customers fall for. The bar is simple: I want customers coming back to me saying "I love this person, what a great hire." You make people feel understood and supported.

  • Super AI-native. You breathe AI. You build agents for everything and you're already living in these tools, not just exploring them.

  • A culture carrier. You embody how we work and represent Dataleap brilliantly out in the world.

  • High agency, low ego. There's unsexy work and you'll do it without flinching. You want to work hard and be part of something ambitious.

  • You speak German at a native level and are fluent in English. Based in Munich or ready to move here. Final-year students and recent graduates welcome.

How we work
This is your life's work right now, and mine too. We operate like athletes: we take care of ourselves and our bodies, and we work hard and win. High standards, high output, no excuses, and we enjoy the ride together.

What this is not

  • Not a coffee-and-shadowing internship, you'll own real customer relationships from week one.

  • Not a back-office role, you're in front of customers, in their offices, in the work.

  • Not for someone who needs rigid structure or waits to be told what to do.

What you get

  • Direct work with me and exposure to our network at YC, Founders Inc, and CDTM.

title: Deployment Strategist, Public Sector (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As an EMEA Public Sector Deployment Strategist, you will own the post-sale experience for a portfolio of public sector customers across the region, including law enforcement agencies, regulators, and government teams working some of the most complex cases in crypto-related crime. You will own onboarding, adoption, outcomes and the relationship across all TRM products, including Ardence, our newest and fastest-moving product. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts. You will define what success looks like for each customer, prove it with usage and outcomes, and enable the renewals and expansion that follow alongside our Account Directors.

The impact you will have:

  • Onboard and activate your EMEA Public Sector accounts across all TRM products, with a clear onboarding path and measurable hands-on-keyboard usage for every account in your portfolio

  • Use AI to build production CS workflows that pull from ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, and product usage telemetry to auto-generate account health summaries and QBR drafts — compressing hours of reporting prep into minutes so you can spend your time on the work that actually requires human judgment

  • Define and track adoption benchmarks across the portfolio — hands-on-keyboard usage, consumption rates, and account-specific success metrics — and surface at-risk accounts before renewal decisions are made

  • Develop new use cases with investigators and analysts that deepen usage across TRM products, including Ardence, and feed what you learn back into onboarding and enablement for the wider team

  • Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at public sector agencies and regulators across EMEA — building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner

  • Partner with ADs, who own the commercial motion, to enable renewals and expansion: bring account health, adoption evidence, and a structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract, and take accountability for the GRR and NRR outcomes that adoption drives

  • Close the feedback loop between customers and Product — synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap

  • Work as one team with EMEA colleagues across languages and time zones, sharing the playbooks, workflows, and account plans that work so coverage is consistent across the region

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years in customer success, deployment, or post-sale roles with proven accountability for GRR, NRR, and adoption outcomes — you have the track record, not just the title

  • Domain credibility in law enforcement, public sector, cyber, national security, financial crime, or blockchain intelligence — you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth

  • Comfort with ambiguity — you have worked in fast-changing product environments, can ship a working v1 without waiting for a perfect playbook, and can point to the specific outcomes it drove; Ardence is still evolving and your accounts may shift as it matures

  • Production AI fluency — you have built real, repeatable AI workflows (not just experiments) that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and have measurable results; you can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop

  • High level of independence — you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers

  • Strong executive presence — you can run a QBR with a senior government or public sector stakeholder and command the room through substance, not just polish

  • Based in the UK or Europe and comfortable working with customers across EMEA; additional European languages are a plus

About the Team:

  • The EMEA Public Sector team supports law enforcement, government, and regulatory customers working on complex cases involving crypto-related financial crime, cyber threats, and national security risks

  • You will join the EMEA Deployment Strategy team, which covers the region by geography and language (DACH and Eastern Europe, the UK, and SPLATAM), alongside Customer Experience. This is a net-new seat that adds coverage across our accounts, with high autonomy and meaningful influence on how we serve the region

  • The broader TRM CS organization operates distributed, not distant — async-first communication through Slack, strong documentation, and intentional synchronous time for key decisions

  • You will work directly with the Head of EMEA Deployment Strategy and the Head of Customer Success, with close day-to-day collaboration with the AD team and Product

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • As a globally distributed team, members may observe different timezones. However, most of the team will overlap between the hours of 7am-5:00 pm PST for meetings and collaboration.

  • Our Customer success Team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly Customer Syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with our customers. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team.

  • Moves fast and iterates — v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Ownership: While there is no formal hourly rotation, you will be the primary lead for your area and responsible for customer success. This requires a high degree of agency and a commitment to seeing mission-critical tasks through to resolution, including the flexibility to handle urgent needs outside of standard hours or on weekends when they arise.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 30 days of joining, you have met every account in your portfolio and shipped a working onboarding and adoption plan for your first 2–3 accounts — not a slide deck, but a live document with measurable adoption benchmarks that the account team is already using to set customer expectations

  • Within 6 weeks, you share a draft success metrics framework at 50% complete with the account team and key customers to validate direction — getting real signal on what drives credit consumption before investing further in building out the full playbook

  • Within 60 days, you identify the highest-impact use case or adoption play for your portfolio — presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on what to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. title: Développeur BI & Data F/H/X - CDI 39h
descriptionHtml:
Le Sud-Ouest pour ancrage, la glisse pour terrain de jeu, la passion comme ADN partagé. OneTurn vit et respire la culture outdoor et les sports d'action en portant des marques emblématiques comme Volcom, Spyder, Aspen, Etnies, éS et Emerica et pour certaines depuis plus de 30 ans.

Nos équipes sont avant tout des passionnés de montagne, d'océan, de glisse et de grand air. Des femmes et des hommes qui connaissent ces univers de l'intérieur, qui les vivent au quotidien et mettent toute leur énergie pour les incarner avec ambition.

Bienvenue chez OneTurn, OneTeam, Onthrills !

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE – Missions : Votre futur terrain de jeu !

Sous la responsabilité du Responsable Systèmes d’Information & Projets F/H/X, le Développeur Data & BI F/H/X conçoit, maintient et fait évoluer le data warehouse, les interfaces entre les systèmes et les rapports Power BI du groupe. Il contribue au sein de la DSI, à la trajectoire data du groupe.

À ce titre, ses missions principales sont les suivantes :

Data & Systèmes d’information

o Maintenir et faire évoluer le data warehouse SQL Server.

o Extraire et exploiter les données issues des applications métier (ERP, PLM, PIM, CMS, e-com, B2B, POS).

o Superviser l’exécution des flux (monitoring, alerting), traiter les incidents et documenter chaque flux (source, cible, déclencheur, procédure de reprise).

o Contrôler et fiabiliser la qualité et la cohérence des données ; participer à la gouvernance et à la structuration des données.

Développement, automatisation & intégration

o Concevoir et maintenir les automatisations et intégrations entre le SI et les systèmes tiers (T-SQL, API REST / JSON, n8n, packages SSIS existants).

o Développer et optimiser les procédures et fonctions T-SQL.

o Développer des interfaces d’accès aux données simples et performantes : vues, API, exports, serveurs MCP (accès gouverné, lecture seule, gestion des droits).

o Rationaliser l’existant : inventorier, migrer ou supprimer les traitements isolés (jobs, vues, fonctions, packages SSIS, scripts), centraliser l’ordonnancement.

o Contribuer aux choix d’architecture data.

BI & Analytics

o Concevoir, développer et maintenir les tableaux de bord Power BI.

o Concevoir et faire évoluer les modèles sémantiques Power BI.

o Identifier des leviers d’amélioration à partir des données et produire des analyses ponctuelles pour éclairer les décisions.

o Animer avec le DSI, la roadmap Data & Analytics : backlog priorisé, revue régulière avec les référents métier, communication des livraisons.

Accompagnement métier & support

o Comprendre les besoins des équipes opérationnelles et les traduire en solutions techniques.

o Prendre en charge le suivi des tickets et demandes d’assistance sur le périmètre data, intégration et outils internes, avec une priorisation partagée avec le DSI.

o Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’exploitation des outils de reporting et leur montée en autonomie (self-service encadré).

o Contribuer à l’acculturation Data au sein de l’entreprise : bonnes pratiques, diffusion des usages.

PROFIL – Le(a) candidat(e) de nos rêves

Formation : Bac+3 à Bac+5 en data engineering ;

Expérience : 3 à 6 ans d’expérience en développement BI / data engineering dans un domaine similaire ;

Compétences :

  • Maîtrise de SQL Server : T-SQL avancé (procédures, fonctions, optimisation), SQL Agent ; capacité à maintenir des packages SSIS existants (SQL Graph apprécié).
  • Maîtrise de Power BI : modèles sémantiques, DAX, administration des datasets et de la gateway.
  • Pratique des API REST / JSON, GraphQL et d’un outil d’orchestration (n8n ou équivalent) ; Python apprécié.
  • Connaissance de l’écosystème Microsoft Fabric / Azure.
  • Appétence pour l’IA appliquée aux données (MCP, RAG).
  • Connaissance des données d’une marque multicanale appréciée : cycle de vie produit (PLM, PIM), ERP / retail (sell-in, sell-out, stock).
  • Compréhension des enjeux métier, recherche de la performance, capacité de synthèse.
  • Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et gestion des priorités.
  • Maîtrise de l’anglais technique dans un environnement IT.


AVANTAGES - Ce que OneTurn vous offre (en plus d’un super job !)

OneTurn est une entreprise qui s'engage pour la diversité et l'égalité des chances.

Tous les postes ouverts au sein du groupe sont accessibles aux salariés en situation de handicap.
