As Upvest enters the next stage of growth, we are looking for an exceptional sales leader for continental Europe. You will work directly with our Director of Growth Alexander Reichhardt owning the topics most critical to Upvest's expansion beyond its current home markets:

About the role:

Own the go-to-market for Europe's next investment markets

We aim high at Upvest. Over the last years we have built one of Europe's most relevant B2B fintechs: an Investment API on top of a self-developed core banking engine, with full regulatory licences and investment operations included. Germany and the UK are proven, with more than 20 clients live and over 110 million trades processed in 2025. Our licences are passported across 20+ EEA countries, which means the infrastructure for the rest of Europe is already in place. From here we’re on a journey to enter market by market in Europe, starting with France, Spain, and Italy.

This is your opportunity to turn our foundation into a flywheel for new markets. You will own the go-to-market for continental Europe end-to-end: defining which client segments we go after first, from fast-growing fintechs to established banks, building the target list and the pipeline behind it, and shaping the commercial case that wins against local incumbents and against the instinct of large banks to build it all themselves.

Lead high-stakes sales and win complex deals with financial institutions

Our clients include the most ambitious fintechs and the most demanding financial institutions in Europe. Winning their business requires enterprise commercial rigour, deep domain knowledge, and genuine client partnership. Deals run over many months, involve procurement, risk, compliance and IT, and are won on substance rather than volume. Since inception we have been delivering on such high touch deals with clearly defined sales journeys, strong materials, and a unique approach now amplified by AI.

You will lead those deals personally before you lead them through others. That means owning the largest opportunities in your region yourself, from first conversation to signature, while bringing the discipline that makes the motion repeatable: rigorous qualification, value-based and consultative selling, predictable forecasting, and a clear view on where not to spend time. You use AI actively to increase your own coverage and later that of your team, and you feed what you learn from clients back into product, solutions, and marketing.

Attract, develop and lead a best-in-class sales team in European fintech

Building world-class financial infrastructure requires world-class people. At Upvest we put hiring excellence and people development front and centre. The Growth team today features talented, driven people coming from Europe's leading fintechs, financial institutions, and technology companies, with Sales working side by side with revenue ops, marketing, partnerships, and solutions engineering on shared targets.

With inspiring yet pragmatic and hands-on leadership you will build the European sales team around you. You will set the bar for the talent you hire, ramp new Account Executives fast, set and steer their targets, and coach them through cycles that few people have run before. You will be measured on what your team closes as much as on what you close yourself, and you will keep carrying a quota personally for as long as this stage of the business asks for it.

What you’ll do:

  • Real ownership of a region: This is a defining hire for our European expansion. You own commercial success for your markets, with Alexander, our Co-Founder Til Rochow, and the rest of senior leadership as your close sparring partners and supporters.

  • A product that gives you an unfair advantage: Our Investment API is genuinely differentiated, a full-stack B2B investment infrastructure crafted with the best product principles and most modern tech stack in the industry. It is live, regulated by BaFin and the FCA, and proven at scale with clients such as DKB, Revolut, N26, and Raisin.

  • A team that takes the work seriously: Upvest's Growth team, and the company around it, is one of a kind when it comes to combining impactful work with a collaborative and fun culture. You will have dedicated revenue ops, solutions engineering, marketing, and partnerships colleagues working with you on your deals, and strong practices around feedback, psychological safety, and team health.

  • The complexity and richness of financial infrastructure: Working at the intersection of API-first SaaS and regulated financial services, with clients ranging from hypergrowth fintechs to global banks, is one of the most strategic and commercially interesting places to be. Every client relationship and every deal teaches you something new. If you are intellectually curious about how financial markets and products are being rebuilt from the ground up, this is the role for you.

  • Flexibility with a European footprint: We are a Berlin- and London-headquartered company with a growing presence across Europe. We are equally open to candidates based in one of Europe's financial hubs, in particular Paris, Madrid, and Milan, who are willing to spend meaningful time in Berlin. What matters most is the quality of your leadership and the results you deliver.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years in senior sales roles, including at least two years leading a team, within high-growth B2B technology and financial services. You have sold API-based enterprise SaaS into fintechs, banks, brokers or wealth managers, and you know financial infrastructure such as core-banking or securities processing.

  • A proven track record of closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions, and of building the foundations that make doing so repeatable. You have taken a sales team from first foundations to early scale, with a proven track-record of exceeding ambitious revenue targets

  • Genuine European reach: You have sold across several European countries, with direct experience in at least one of France, Spain or Italy, a strong network in the world of banking and finance

  • A modern approach to sales: customer-centric, value-based, data-driven, and AI-enabled. You have strong views on what great looks like, from qualification frameworks to CRM hygiene to how account plans and collaboration roadmaps have the highest impact and are enabled by and enhanced with AI, and you turn those views into standards the team works to.

  • Hands-on ownership with strategic foresight: You operate practically, think in second-order effects to get complex deals across the line, and you are genuinely comfortable carrying quota yourself at this stage rather than only managing others who do.

  • Outstanding people leadership: You hire exceptional people, develop them continuously, and create a non-hierarchical, inclusive and respectful environment where the best talent chooses to stay and grow. You lead with clarity, empathy, and high standards.

  • Fluent English plus native-level in either French, Spanish, or Italian. Investment domain knowledge, experience selling regulated products, and time at a tier-1 growth company are a strong plus.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Wir suchen niemanden, der Anforderungen verwaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der sie löst. Du baust die Cybersecurity unserer neuen Generation auf, arbeitest selbst an der Fahrzeugsoftware und bist für unsere Entwicklungspartner die Instanz, an der kein Release vorbeigeht.

  • Gestaltungsraum, den es im Konzern nicht gibt: Du definierst Cybersecurity für eine komplette Fahrzeuggeneration

  • Kurze Wege zu Management und Board, schnelle Entscheidungen

Bau mit uns die Generation, auf die sich Betriebe verlassen können. Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf und zwei, drei Sätzen dazu, was du in deinen ersten 100 Tagen bei HEERO umsetzen würdest.

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities. Please submit your application in English.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

In this role, you will be a key driver of our mission to reimagine energy and make net-zero a reality for everyone. As a Customer Enablement Specialist, you will be the bridge between our innovative technology and the people who use it. You will empower our clients, partners, and colleagues in French-speaking markets to not only understand our platform but to master it - including the AI-powered capabilities we are continuously building and rolling out. Your work will directly accelerate Kaluza's growth by ensuring our users are confident, capable, and ready to support the energy transition.

Strategic Training & Programme Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor to our clients, partners, and internal teams, performing deep learning needs analysis to understand their unique operational challenges. You'll manage your workstream with genuine project and programme management discipline - planning, sequencing and tracking delivery within complex, multi-stakeholder client programmes, ideally drawing on agile ways of working to stay responsive as scope evolves.

Content Creation & Delivery: You will be the master of making the complex simple. You'll create high-quality, engaging training materials in both French and English, including interactive workshops, e-learning modules, and quick reference guides - translating not just today's platform, but AI features and products still in development, into training that's ready the moment they go live. You'll deliver these sessions virtually and in-person, inspiring your audience and building their confidence with every interaction.

Driving Adoption & Impact: Your role is to accelerate the adoption of the Kaluza platform. You will provide post-training support and coaching, monitor the effectiveness of your programmes, and continuously iterate based on feedback and performance metrics. You'll ensure our training leads to real-world, positive change for our users and the energy industry.


What you'll bring 

Ideally you’ll have:

  • Bilingual Fluency, to a high standard: You are fluent in both French and English, with outstanding written and spoken communication skills - essential for day-to-day stakeholder management across multiple countries, up to and including executive level.

  • Operational & Technical SaaS Training Expertise: A proven track record designing and delivering training in a SaaS or technology environment, ideally with hands-on experience of operational or technical instructional training rather than generalist L&D delivery.

  • Project & Programme Management Experience: Strong project and/or programme management experience gained within complex, multi-stakeholder environments; experience of agile delivery is a strong advantage.

  • Operational Experience: Demonstrable experience gained within an operational environment - energy sector operations and/or contact centre settings are especially valued - giving you a first-hand understanding of the pressures and workflows your training needs to support.

  • AI Fluency: Demonstrable experience building, productionalising, or delivering training on AI features and products while they are still in development, and genuine confidence working with AI tools as part of your own everyday practice.

  • Simplification Master: You possess a natural ability to take complex technical and business concepts and translate them into clear, engaging, and practical learning materials.

  • Engaging Facilitator: You are a confident and dynamic presenter, able to captivate diverse audiences and create a fun, interactive learning environment.

  • Collaborative & Proactive: You are a team player who builds strong relationships and is proactive in identifying opportunities to support others and drive continuous improvement.

What will set you apart 

  • Energy Sector Acumen: A practical background in energy utility operations or decarbonisation technologies, beyond the operational experience above, that lets you connect training directly to the real-world challenges our clients face.

  • Proven Training Leadership: A demonstrated track record of scaling training programmes and an ability to think strategically about how to build and expand a learning culture across an international organisation.


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Corporate team at Alan

You will join Alan's Corporate team, the unit that covers legal, privacy, governance, risk, compliance and security as Alan scales.

Alan wants to be in 10 countries within five years, and that only works with corporate processes built to scale with it. This is a newly created role, and your job is to make Alan's regulated development seamless and integrated with how we build product.

You will benefit from close mentorship and structured support, you won't be left on your own, and the deep legal, privacy, and security expertise stays in the team around you. At Alan, roles evolve, so you will have real opportunities to expand your scope across topics and countries as you grow.

🤝 Your missions

Corporate protects Alan and its members, but regulated work can still be slow, manual and disconnected from how we build. You are here to build the compliance product that fixes that: processes and tooling that hold as Alan grows, and that make regulated work lighter on both sides, for the teams you serve and for the experts you work with.

  • Make regulated work scale. Alan's regulatory load grows with every new member, market and product. You build the layer that absorbs it, so Corporate's load stops climbing in lockstep with the company: a clear path from each request to the right owner, and tooling that takes on the recurring work.

  • Rebuild processes end to end. You find the painful process, work out what people are really doing to get around it, and redesign it so it is faster for everyone. You stay on it after launch, watch how it is used, and keep improving it until it becomes the way people work.

  • Build practical automation and AI-enabled workflows from end-to-end. title: Legal Counsel, Employment
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Please apply with a CV in the English Language. This is a Paris-based role with global reach and therefore Fluency in French and English (both written and spoken) is important.

Role Summary

Checkout.com is seeking a talented and dynamic Legal Counsel with a strong French employment law background to join our Employment Legal team. This role will involve advising on the full spectrum of employment law issues across our French business and supporting broader global employment law initiatives, especially across other EMEA jurisdictions.

You will work closely with our People Team and key business stakeholders in France and internationally. This is a great opportunity to support and develop our French employment legal strategy while collaborating as part of a global team supporting employees across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas. You will take a consultative and commercial approach to handling complex Labor Code compliance matters, works council (CSE) consultations, litigation, employee relations, and strategic projects across France. You’ll also advise on individual and collective dismissals, restructurings, settlement negotiations, performance management, misconduct investigations and HR audits. You’ll monitor legal and regulatory developments across EMEA and provide proactive guidance on emerging risks and legal requirements. You’ll also help the employment legal team develop scalable processes, templates, and compliance frameworks, including through the use of AI tools.

You will be able to handle multiple areas of responsibilities autonomously, demonstrating excellent critical judgment with hands-on approach. You will report into our Associate General Counsel (Head of Employment) based in London. You will also work closely with the regional People Team leads, based in France and other EMEA jurisdictions.

You will be joining a high-achieving legal team in one of Europe's most valuable fintechs. Our mission is to be the best legal team in the world, providing pragmatic and commercially focused advice, finding creative solutions to manage risk and becoming trusted advisers to our colleagues in the business.

Essential Qualifications:

  • French qualified lawyer (Avocat admitted to the French Bar or Master 2 in French Employment Law / Droit du Travail)

  • 5+ years experience specializing in French employment law, either in a reputable law firm or in-house

  • Fluency in French and English (both written and spoken) with the ability to articulate complex legal issues clearly to non-French leadership.

  • Within a commutable distance from our Paris office and comfortable working in the office as necessary under our hybrid working policy (currently three days per week on scheduled office days).

Strong candidates will demonstrate the following:

  • Experience as in-house employment counsel, ideally in a large global business headquartered outside of France.

  • Extensive experience managing CSE consultations, collective negotiations, restructurings, and pre-litigation/settlement strategy in France.

  • Work with a high-growth technology or another fast-paced company.

  • Exceptional analytical and writing skills, with a business-centric focus on risk.

  • Excellent time management skills and experience managing a diverse workload and competing stakeholder demands.

  • Enthusiasm for new challenges and working with a range of different stakeholders.

  • Be a systemic thinker with proven abilities for process improvement and simplification, including AI.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, constant change, and a fast-paced culture.

Role Type and Location

This is a permanent and full-time role based in Paris. Under our current hybrid working policy, office attendance is mandatory on 3 days per week.

Additional Information

If you don't meet all the requirements but think you might still be right for the role, please apply anyway. We're always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

We believe in equal opportunities

We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However you identify. And whichever payment method you use.

Our clients come from all over the world — and so do we. Hiring hard-working people and giving them a community to thrive in is critical to our success.

When you join our team, we’ll empower you to unlock your potential so you can do your best work. We’d love to hear how you think you could make a difference here with us.

We want to set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. We’ll be happy to support you.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer (ranging from mid to principal) to help build the models that underpin these control systems and help us level up our machine learning infrastructure.

Whether in research or deployment focussed teams, we operate as one cohesive unit, sharing tech stack, knowledge, and objectives. Our focus spans from fundamental ML research to commercial-grade software development, offering diverse learning and impact opportunities.

Your main responsibilities

Reporting to a Machine Learning Team Lead, you will:

  • Build state-of-the art systems which combine edge control with active learning algorithms to continuously deliver impact and reduce CO2 emissions.

  • Work in the machine learning team as an individual contributor, building, testing and deploying our models, optimisers and controllers.

  • Contribute to technical innovation and problem-solving across the machine learning lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on customer projects, planning, designing and delivering the work packages required, as well as playing a significant role in the development of our product.

  • Help establish best practices to improve our internal processes.

  • Contribute to the design and implementation of robust, maintainable and scalable machine learning systems.

You will also contribute to our fear-free development process by building tooling that helps the team move faster and more sustainably. You will be supported by continuous builds, tests, a constructive review system, and a strong culture of improving engineering processes.

What a great fit looks like

  • You have 2 or more years of experience as a machine learning engineer.

  • You are familiar with ML techniques, and have both theoretical ML knowledge and experience implementing different types of solutions.

  • You are proficient in Python and have a good understanding of the ecosystem of tools and libraries that support ML development (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch).

  • You have experience working in end-to-end machine learning deployments.

  • You have experience working in a scientific environment across disciplines (particularly physics, chemistry, materials science, and engineering), either through previous roles or study.

  • Are passionate about making a positive impact on climate change mitigation and possess a strong interest in our mission.

You’ll excel if

  • You have experience in any of: control systems, time-series modelling, reinforcement learning, system identification, optimisation or bayesian statistics.

  • You are used to working in a fast-paced startup environment with an agile process.

  • You have a degree in machine learning, physics, chemistry, engineering, mathematics or computer science.

  • You have a track record of developing novel ML methods in relevant fields.

  • You are hungry for responsibility, enthusiastic about taking on the design and development of solutions to difficult problems, and eager to drive the progress of new products.

  • You have a solid understanding of modern cloud compute infrastructure as it relates to machine learning, and experience in working with AWS, GCP, Azure, or other vendors.

  • You have have designed and built systems end to end with software architectural best practice.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership: High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun: Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page.

title: Machine Learning Fellow - Human Frontier Collective (UK)
descriptionHtml:
About the Collective

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think.
We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Who should apply

  • Background: PhD, or postdoctoral research experience, in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field; or senior industry experience in Machine Learning or a related field.
  • Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and MLOps tools (Docker) and LLM frameworks (LangChain) is a plus.
  • Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion for applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.

How it works

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement.
  • Work authorization: We do not sponsor visas for Fellows. To participate in the HFC Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the country they reside in.
  • Community Network: Once you’ve received an invitation to join the HFC, you’ll also gain access to our newsletters, discussion channels, virtual sessions, IRL events, and much more.
  • Projects Logistics: 
    • Project selection: You’ll regularly get matched to carefully selected projects from our partners. Depending on the partner, projects range from evaluating AI models to designing experiments, building RL environments, co-authoring research papers, and more. 
    • Flexible schedule: There's no minimum commitment – you decide whether to take on a project. Most fellows spend 10–25 hours per week, on a schedule they set themselves.
    • Competitive pay: Project pay rates vary across platforms and depend on a number of factors, including but not limited to: projects, scope, skillset, and location. You’ll receive the pay information upon receiving project matching notifications.

Application process

  1. Apply: We review applications on a rolling basis.
  2. Interview: Candidates will get to discuss their research experience, professional background, and alignment with our mission to advance human-centered AI. Note: If we invited you directly, your invitation will say whether this step applies.
  3. Join the Collective: Successful candidates will receive an invitation to join the Human Frontier Collective Fellowship.

descriptionHtml:

Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !

Ton équipe :

Tu rejoins AI Advisory, l’activité de conseil IA que lance Theodo. Notre mission : aider les directions générales à passer de l’expérimentation IA à un impact business massif, en réconciliant vision stratégique et réalité technologique.

En tant que Manager, tu es garant de la qualité de tes missions et de la satisfaction des décideurs C-level. Tu produis et tu challenges le travail de ton équipe, tu fais grandir les consultants, tu conçois les offres du cabinet et tu portes l’avant-vente.

Tu es rattaché au responsable AI Advisory et tu travailles avec les équipes tech de Theodo, qui mettent en production ce que tu cadres.

Tes missions :

  • Cadrer et structurer : transformer un besoin flou en plan d’action (Audit > MVP > Scale) et construire des business cases IA chiffrés (ROI, gouvernance, dépendances) que tu défends en Comex

  • Développer le business : porter l’avant-vente, rédiger les propositions commerciales, défendre tes convictions en soutenance et assurer le foisonnement sur tes comptes
  • Construire le cabinet : concevoir de nouvelles offres et méthodologies de conseil IA, et participer au recrutement de la future équipe

Tes perspectives d’évolutions :

Le passage Directeur AI Advisory est clairement défini. Tu pilotes un compte client en autonomie, de la première mission à la revente. Tu deviens une voix de référence sur l’IA auprès de tes clients et tu portes la parole du cabinet à l’extérieur (conférences, publications). Profil recherché :

Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking an Analytics Manager to join our growing Analytics & Data Science team, reporting into the Data Tech and Analytics global lead. The team focuses on media effectiveness measurement, campaign analysis and client communication to help make brands become more valuable to the world.

You will be working with a leading advertiser, JLR, to harness their data and improve the performance of their campaigns, developing and deploying media measurement solutions. Communication with client stakeholders and effective management of assigned tasks is critical in this role. You will be joining an award winning team, with more than 16 tech and media industry awards to our name, including Campaign Magazine's Tech Awards Agency of the Year, Best Use of AI, and Breakthrough Tech as Part of a Campaign awards.

We have invested in giving you the tools to make you as successful as possible, including training/development, full access to Google Cloud Platform and a wider global community of analysts and data scientists.

Strategic Analytics Application: Build and apply a deep understanding of marketing objectives to support Account teams with comprehensive measurement and testing plans. title: Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex)
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping customers turn frontier AI capabilities into real products, workflows, and business impact. We act as trusted technical partners across solution design, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and adoption, working alongside customers to build and scale effective AI applications with OpenAI’s technologies.

The Codex Applied AI Engineering team focuses on helping organizations transform how software is built with AI. We partner directly with engineering teams and technical leaders to integrate Codex into their software development lifecycle — from identifying high-impact use cases and designing AI-enabled workflows to implementation, evaluation, and scaled adoption. Our work helps ensure AI-powered software development is effective, reliable, secure, and deeply integrated into how engineering organizations operate.


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced technical leader to join as Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex), leading a team of Applied AI Engineers responsible for driving successful Codex adoption across strategic customers. Your team will work hands-on with customer engineering organizations to design and build AI-enabled development workflows, solve complex implementation challenges, and establish scalable patterns for AI-powered software development.

As a manager, you will shape how these technical engagements operate at scale — setting strategy, coaching engineers, determining where the team can have the greatest impact, and ensuring consistently strong execution across customers. You will serve as both a people leader and senior technical advisor, partnering closely with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering to translate customer needs and real-world usage into better technical approaches, reusable patterns, and product insights.

Success in this role will be measured by meaningful and sustained Codex adoption, successful customer outcomes, and the creation of repeatable technical patterns that help engineering organizations get more value from AI.

This role is open in our Munich and Berlin offices. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.


In This Role, You Will

  • Lead, hire, and mentor a high-performing team of Applied AI Engineers supporting Codex customers across strategic accounts.

  • Own the operating model and technical engagement strategy for Codex Applied AI Engineering, helping customers move from initial exploration to meaningful, scaled adoption.

  • Guide teams in designing and implementing AI-enhanced development workflows, agentic systems, automations, evaluations, and scalable application architectures.

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point and thought partner for complex customer implementations and engineering challenges.

  • Partner with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering teams to align customer outcomes with product direction and roadmap priorities.

  • Establish repeatable technical patterns, playbooks, reference architectures, and best practices that enable broader adoption of AI-powered software development.

  • Coach Applied AI Engineers to operate as trusted technical partners to engineering leaders, executives, and highly technical customer teams.

  • Synthesize insights from customer engagements and translate them into actionable feedback for Product, Research, and Engineering.

  • Develop a deep understanding of how customers are using Codex, where they encounter friction, and where new technical approaches or product capabilities could unlock greater impact.

  • Champion safe, reliable, and effective adoption of AI-powered development workflows across industries.


You’ll Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have 8+ years of experience in deeply technical, customer-facing roles such as applied engineering, solutions architecture, deployment engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles.

  • Have 2+ years of experience leading technical teams, including hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers.

  • Have experience building or deploying generative AI, developer platforms, agentic systems, or cloud-based software solutions in production environments.

  • Possess strong hands-on software engineering experience and fluency with programming languages such as Python or JavaScript.

  • Understand modern software development lifecycles and have strong intuition for how AI and coding agents can change how software is designed, built, tested, and maintained.

  • Can work directly with customer engineering teams to understand ambiguous problems, develop technical approaches, and turn ideas into working solutions.

  • Are an effective communicator who can translate complex technical and business topics for both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.

  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and enjoy building new operating models, technical patterns, and teams from first principles.

  • Demonstrate strong ownership, humility, technical judgment, and a commitment to helping both customers and teammates succeed.

  • Are personally committed to fostering the safe and beneficial development of AI.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time.

You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Build the go-to-market strategy

  • Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale.

  • Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation.

  • Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set.

  • Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time.

  • Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality

  • Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition.

  • Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth.

  • Translate strategy into measurable objectives, combining brand and commercial KPIs.

Lead every campaign

  • Own the marketing strategy and integrated campaign plan for each new property prize launch.

  • Turn each new campaign into a compelling customer story with a clear audience, insight, proposition and creative brief.

  • Ensure every individual property campaign strengthens the brand as well as delivering its immediate commercial objectives.

  • Set a high creative bar and work closely with Creative teams to develop work that is distinctive, emotionally compelling and capable of building the brand over time.

  • Lead the cross-functional marketing squad responsible for bringing campaigns to market.

  • Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy.

  • Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation.

  • Make clear prioritisation and investment recommendations based on expected commercial impact.

Build the playbook

  • Establish the processes, templates, measurement framework and operating cadence required to run campaigns repeatedly and efficiently.

  • Track and develop our understanding of brand health alongside commercial performance, using measures such as awareness, consideration and customer perceptions where appropriate.

  • Design and prioritise tests across audiences, propositions, messaging, creative, channels and customer journeys.

  • Know when to experiment and optimise, and when consistency and creative conviction are more important than reacting to short-term campaign data.

  • Build a strong understanding of what drives performance by customer segment and campaign type.

  • Turn learnings from each campaign into improvements for the next, creating a compounding growth loop rather than starting from scratch each time.

  • Bring customer insight and market intelligence back into the wider business to help shape the future product roadmap.

🤩 About You

We're less interested in a particular industry background than in finding someone who has the right attitude and has shown success at building consumer brands and growing new consumer propositions.

You'll probably have:

  • Significant experience in consumer marketing, brand, growth or integrated marketing roles.

  • Experience taking a new proposition, product or category from early-stage concept through launch and growth.

  • Strong customer and commercial instincts: you can move comfortably between qualitative customer insight, proposition development and quantitative performance data.

  • A strong understanding of how brand building and customer acquisition work together to create sustainable growth.

  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and integrated brand and marketing strategies.

  • Strong experimentation instincts and experience using data to improve marketing performance over time, without becoming overly dependent on short-term performance signals..

  • The ability to lead complex cross-functional work without needing direct reporting lines.

  • Excellent briefing and communication skills, particularly with creative and channel specialists.

title: Marketing Specialist (m/f/d) - Promotion & Events with a passion for aviation

title: Mechanical Engineer – CAD & Engineering Support (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

About the Role

As a Mechanical Engineer – CAD & Engineering Support, you’ll produce high-quality mechanical models, drawings, and engineering documentation across Focused Energy’s projects. This is a hands-on role focused on translating design intent into accurate, well-structured CAD outputs that support manufacture, supplier engagement, assembly, and project delivery.

You’ll work across a range of technically demanding systems, including laser systems, vacuum equipment, diagnostic mounting structures, and facility mechanical infrastructure. Working closely with senior mechanical engineers and multidisciplinary project teams, you’ll provide practical design support while helping maintain consistent CAD standards, drawing conventions, and engineering documentation across the team.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop detailed 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using Autodesk Inventor or an equivalent 3D CAD tool.

  • Produce manufacturing drawings, assembly drawings, layout models, parts lists, BOMs, and drawing registers to a high engineering standard.

  • Maintain and update CAD models and associated documentation as designs evolve throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Support the design and development of mechanical systems such as vacuum chambers, laser system integration, diagnostic structures, and facility infrastructure.

  • Identify and resolve design clashes, interface issues, documentation gaps, and inconsistencies within CAD assemblies.

  • Prepare complete drawing packages and technical documentation for supplier quotation, manufacture, procurement, and design reviews.

  • Review supplier drawings and documentation, support the resolution of technical queries, and communicate design status and outstanding actions clearly.

  • Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, controls, and systems engineers to support integration activities and maintain accurate assembly models.

Who You Are

  • You are a capable mechanical engineer who can translate design intent into accurate models, drawings, and structured engineering documentation.

  • You have a highly detail-oriented and methodical approach to CAD modelling, drawing production, and document control.

  • You can manage multiple drawing and documentation tasks across concurrent projects while maintaining quality and delivery focus.

  • You communicate clearly with senior engineers, suppliers, manufacturers, and multidisciplinary project teams.

  • You proactively identify design clashes, interface risks, incomplete information, and documentation gaps before they affect delivery.

  • You take ownership of your outputs and follow through on actions, revisions, technical queries, and design updates.

  • You are comfortable working in a collaborative engineering environment and adapting to different project disciplines and technical requirements.

  • You are committed to applying engineering standards, CAD conventions, and version-control practices consistently.

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Experience with vacuum systems, chambers, precision mechanical assemblies, laser or optical system integration, or scientific instrumentation.

  • Familiarity with PDM or PLM systems, CAD data management, document control, and structured version-control practices.

  • Knowledge of design for manufacture and assembly (DFMA), supplier drawing review, prototype build support, and commissioning activities.

  • Understanding of GD&T and relevant engineering drawing standards, including ISO, DIN, or equivalent conventions.

  • Experience working in experimental physics, research, advanced engineering, or other multidisciplinary technical environments where mechanical systems must be integrated, manufactured, and tested.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

title: Medical Device Auditor
descriptionHtml:

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

title: Member of Technical Staff - Security Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The role

We build the control chain that powers on, monitors, updates, and protects devices and racks across bare metal, RTOS, and embedded Linux. We also build the communication mechanisms that connect devices to each other and to the host. Security runs through all of it. A chain of trust from the hardware up to the rack management plane: the root of trust each controller boots from, the signed updates that reach the fleet safely, the identity that lets a device prove what it is, the authenticated channels the controllers and devices talk over, and the runtime protections that keep the host Linux kernel and the on-die firmware trustworthy long after boot. These are the layers that let operators rely on the hardware.

You’d be deeply involved in that security across the chain, making it real in software. You’ll work hand in hand with our architecture and hardware teams, bringing the software and system-level view: turning threat models into concrete mechanisms in bare metal, RTOS, and Linux, then designing, prototyping, and validating them. Some of the calls in this model are still open, and you’ll help shape them.

We want engineers who understand security from the inside out. You know how the root of trust, boot chain, key hierarchy, and secure interconnects actually work under the hood, not just how to switch them on. In this role, the security of your software solutions depends entirely on how well you understand the hardware beneath it. Some of the protections we rely on live in silicon, some in software, and part of the skill is knowing which belongs where. We’re looking for people who know both sides well enough to build the mechanisms that close whole classes of bugs by design.

We’re not heavy on levels here! Whether you’d call yourself senior, staff, principal, or lead, what matters is depth of security judgement, system-level experience, and working well with the engineers around you. If you’ve worked deep in the security of real systems and like to get your hands on the code and the systems around it, we’d like to hear from you.

What you’ll do:

  • Shape the security of the control chain (device, board, chassis, and rack controllers): threat models, trust boundaries, and a coherent secure-by-design approach across all platforms

  • Design and help build secure boot and the root of trust on each controller: verified/measured boot, signing and verification, anti-rollback, and locking down debug and privileged access in production

  • Secure the interconnects, between controllers and between devices and the host, with authentication, integrity, and additional protections where needed

  • Design and build the cryptographic mechanisms: key hierarchies, provisioning and storage, device identity, and remote attestation so the fleet can prove what it’s running

  • Make firmware updates safe end to end: signed images, rollback protection, staged rollout, and clean recovery, across every hop of the chain

  • Protect the running system, not just boot: harden the host Linux kernel and the on-die firmware

  • Work closely with hardware and the rest of the software team to build security into the product, running threat-model reviews, triaging vulnerabilities, and driving fixes to closure

What we’re looking for:

We expect you to know the fundamentals, and to have real, practical experience across several of these:

  • An adversarial mindset and sharp threat-modeling instincts: trust boundaries, assets, attacks, and honesty about residual risk

  • Hands-on experience with the core security primitives in software and in silicon: secure boot, root of trust, cryptography, and key management, including how they’re implemented and where they can fail

  • Secure protocol and channel design between components

  • Strong C and Rust, and the instinct for memory safety and defensive coding that low-level security work needs

  • Experience building, not just using, security mechanisms: a secure-boot chain, key hierarchy, or attestation flow you shaped

That’s the core. We get especially curious about your application when you also bring some of the following. Very few candidates tick every box here, and we don’t expect you to:

  • Attestation at boot and at runtime, and management-plane protocols (DICE, IETF RATS, SPDM, MCTP, PLDM; confidential-computing directions like TDISP)

  • Hardware building blocks and firmware/Linux hardening (HSM, TPM, secure element, Caliptra, secure debug; open firmware/boot projects, image minimisation)

  • Assurance and resistance (supply-chain security with SBOM and SLSA, fuzzing and testing, standards like NIST 800-series, Common Criteria, OCP incl. S.A.F.E., TCG/DMTF; physical and side-channel awareness)

  • AI/LLM-assisted security tooling, and RISC-V / GPU / ML-accelerator experience

What you’re signing up for:

This is a young company doing hard things, balanced across hardware and software. We’re building the software layer for a whole inference system as it takes shape, so you’ll often be securing systems ahead of the hardware: reasoning about a threat model against a specification first, then a simulator, then early boards. You’ll work with incomplete information and watch it get sharper with every iteration. That takes comfort with ambiguity and a bias for action. If that sounds daunting, this may not be the role. If it sounds like the fun part, we should talk.

Boundaries between areas are soft here. Security touches every layer, so you’ll work across bare metal, RTOS, and Linux, and alongside the architecture and hardware teams as much as the rest of the software team. That breadth is a good part of the job.

You’ll be there for first bring-up, the first secure boot that verifies, the first device that attests itself, the first clean end-to-end run. A piece of what you built will live in silicon and in every rack we ship.

We want a team that reflects the world it’s built for, and we welcome applicants from every background, including those whose path here hasn’t been a straight line. We care that you’re excited by this kind of work, that you bring security rigour, and that you make a team better.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Mission Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as Mission Operations Manager

Run the field exercises that put SE3's autonomous systems in the hands of military units, and bring back the insight that shapes what we build next.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Mission Operations team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Mission Operations Manager, you'll plan and run the exercises and trials that prove SE3's autonomous systems and Spatial AI in realistic conditions. You'll be the day-to-day point of contact for the operational units we work with, partnering closely with our engineering, product and commercial teams and travelling regularly across Europe. What you capture in the field becomes the evidence and requirements that move our product and programmes forward.

What You'll Work On

  • Exercise Planning: Plan trials and exercises within our exercise programme, from component tests through to multi-system exercises, with clear scenarios, objectives and success criteria.

  • Exercise Delivery: Run exercises on the ground, coordinating the people, systems and logistics involved so that each one delivers usable results.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

Perks & Benefits

title: Mobile UI Designer

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's AI Neobank and financial products.

This role is for someone who loves designing mobile interfaces that feel effortless, responsive and visually refined. You'll work alongside engineers and product managers to create experiences used daily by millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.

  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes and production-ready UI.

  • Design mobile experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and financial services.

  • Build and maintain mobile design systems and reusable components.

  • Work closely with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Optimize interfaces for usability, accessibility and platform guidelines.

  • Iterate designs using analytics, usability findings and product feedback.

  • Ensure consistency across different devices, screen sizes and operating systems.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience designing mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality mobile UI work.

  • Expert proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

  • Deep understanding of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design.

  • Strong understanding of mobile usability, responsive layouts and interaction design.

  • Excellent attention to typography, spacing, colour and visual hierarchy.

  • Ability to simplify complex financial workflows into clean mobile experiences.

  • Portfolio is required.

Design Stack

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Auto Layout

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • iOS Human Interface Guidelines

  • Material Design

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks mobile-first.

  • Obsesses over visual polish and interaction quality.

  • Notices small UI inconsistencies before users do.

  • Cares about accessibility, responsiveness and performance.

  • Collaborates closely with engineers to deliver high-quality products.

  • Takes pride in shipping pixel-perfect interfaces.

This Role Is Not For

  • Designers whose experience is primarily marketing or branding.

  • People who design without considering real user behaviour.

  • Designers unfamiliar with mobile platform conventions.

  • Individuals who struggle to collaborate with engineers.

  • Candidates who cannot explain the rationale behind their design decisions.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Netherlands.

 

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

 

Interview Process

title: Moodle & E-Learning Specialist (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Moodle & E-Learning Specialist (m/w/d)

Schwerpunkt: Interaktive Lernmedien, Didaktik und digitale Lernplattformen

Vollzeit (40 Stunden/Woche)
Arbeitgeber: XRbit gUG (haftungsbeschränkt)
Arbeitsort: Dortmund - 100 Prozent Home Office eventuell möglich

Über uns

Die XRbit gUG entwickelt innovative digitale Anwendungen für Bildung, Forschung und Kultur. Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen auf Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) und interaktiven Lerntechnologien.

Gemeinsam mit Hochschulen, Forschungseinrichtungen, Unternehmen und Bildungspartnern entwickeln wir neue Wege der Wissensvermittlung – von virtuellen Trainingsumgebungen bis hin zu digitalen Weiterbildungsangeboten.

Für den Aufbau und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Moodle-basierten Lernplattform suchen wir Verstärkung in Vollzeit.

Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Konzeption, Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Lernangebote. Dabei verbindest du technische Möglichkeiten mit kreativer Mediengestaltung und didaktischem Verständnis.

Deine Schwerpunkte:

  • Moodle-Plattform: Du gestaltest die Struktur unserer Lernplattform, entwickelst Kurskonzepte und nutzt die vielfältigen Möglichkeiten von Moodle und seinen Erweiterungen.

  • Interaktive Lerninhalte: Du erstellst abwechslungsreiche Lernmodule mit H5P, interaktiven Videos, Quizformaten, Lernspielen, Verzweigungen und multimedialen Übungen.

  • 2D-Animation und Mediengestaltung: Du entwickelst anschauliche Grafiken, einfache Animationen, Erklärsequenzen und visuelle Elemente für unsere digitalen Kurse.

  • Didaktische Konzeption: Du übersetzt komplexe Fachinhalte in verständliche, motivierende und zielgruppengerechte Lernangebote. Dazu gehören Lernziele, Lernpfade, Übungen und Feedbackmechanismen.

  • Weiterentwicklung und Innovation: Du erprobst neue Moodle-Funktionen, Plugins und Autorentools und entwickelst Ideen, wie KI, Gamification und perspektivisch auch VR-/AR-Inhalte sinnvoll in Lernprozesse eingebunden werden können.

  • Qualitätssicherung: Du testest Lernangebote mit Blick auf Verständlichkeit, Benutzerfreundlichkeit, Barrierearmut und Lernerfolg.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklerteam und den fachlichen Projektpartnern zusammen. Bei komplexeren technischen Aufgaben, beispielsweise Serveradministration, Programmierung oder Schnittstellenentwicklung, wirst du von unseren Softwareentwicklern unterstützt.

Dein Profil

Wir suchen eine vielseitige Persönlichkeit, die technische Neugier, Kreativität und Freude an der Wissensvermittlung miteinander verbindet.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Moodle oder vergleichbaren Lernmanagementsystemen und die Bereitschaft, dich intensiv mit Moodle auseinanderzusetzen.

  • Erfahrung mit der Erstellung digitaler Lerninhalte, insbesondere interaktiver Übungen, Quizformate oder multimedialer Kurse.

  • Kenntnisse in H5P oder vergleichbaren Autorentools.

  • Fähigkeiten in der visuellen Gestaltung und idealerweise praktische Erfahrung bei der Erstellung von 2D-Animationen, beispielsweise mit After Effects, Adobe Animate, Rive oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen.

  • Didaktisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, fachliche Inhalte in sinnvoll strukturierte Lernprozesse zu überführen.

  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, neue Werkzeuge und Technologien auszuprobieren.

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse zur Erstellung und Abstimmung deutschsprachiger Lerninhalte.

Besonders interessant sind außerdem:

  • Erfahrungen mit Gamification, adaptiven Lernpfaden oder spielerischen Lernformaten.

  • Kenntnisse in HTML, CSS, JavaScript oder der Anpassung von Moodle-Themes und Plugins.

  • Erfahrungen mit SCORM, xAPI oder der Einbindung externer Lernanwendungen.

  • Kenntnisse in der beruflichen Bildung, Erwachsenenbildung oder Medienpädagogik.

  • Erfahrungen mit KI-gestützten Werkzeugen für die Erstellung von Lernmaterialien, Grafiken und Animationen.

Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns nicht entscheidend. Ob du deine Fähigkeiten im Studium, in einer Ausbildung, im Beruf oder autodidaktisch erworben hast: Entscheidend ist, was du praktisch umsetzen kannst.

Du musst nicht alles bereits beherrschen. Wichtig ist uns, dass du mehrere dieser Bereiche miteinander verbinden kannst und dich gerne in neue Themen einarbeitest.

Das erwartet dich bei XRbit

  • Ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet an der Schnittstelle von Bildung, Technologie und Mediengestaltung.

  • Die Möglichkeit, eine digitale Lernplattform von Beginn an maßgeblich mitzugestalten und langfristig weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum für eigene Ideen und die Erprobung neuer Lerntechnologien.

  • Die Zusammenarbeit mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Softwareentwicklung, 3D-Gestaltung, Forschung und Bildung.

  • Spannende Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekte, unter anderem in der beruflichen Bildung, im Handwerk und in der Kreislaufwirtschaft.

  • Die Möglichkeit, neue Werkzeuge und KI-Anwendungen in die eigene Arbeit einzubinden.

  • Eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem gemeinnützigen Unternehmen mit dem Ziel, Bildung innovativer und zugänglicher zu gestalten.

Deine Bewerbung

Du findest dich in diesem Profil wieder und möchtest digitale Bildung aktiv mitgestalten?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Schicke uns bitte einen Lebenslauf und, soweit vorhanden, Beispiele deiner bisherigen Arbeiten. Besonders interessant sind für uns selbst entwickelte Moodle-Kurse, H5P-Anwendungen, interaktive Lernmodule, Animationen oder vergleichbare Projekte.

Ein Bewerbungsfoto oder Angaben zu deinem Geburtsdatum benötigen wir nicht.


Möglicher Eintrittstermin: 15.01.2027

Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung sowie sexueller Identität.
