title: Product Owner - Acquitech
descriptionHtml:
Product Owner - Sales & Marketing, Acquisition Technology

Hybrid in London, UK

We're looking for a Product Owner to join the Acquitech team.

You'll own the roadmap for the team behind iwoca's acquisition data, technology and models.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star service ensure business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they power.

The team

Acquitech builds and maintains the data infrastructure behind iwoca's direct acquisition channels. The team's aim is to get the right data to the right places – so ad platforms find businesses worth reaching, analysts trust the reports they build, and the sales team knows who to call first.

The team works across four areas:

  • Tracking and attribution. Recording every lead and sign-up accurately, and sending conversion data back to ad platforms so their algorithms improve over time.

  • Customer value prediction. Building models that estimate a potential customer's expected value, used to guide where marketing spends, who receives direct mail and which businesses a salesperson prioritises.

  • The data layer. Providing a clear, trusted foundation so analysts and channel managers can build reporting without second-guessing the numbers.

  • Team tooling and automation. Building tools and automated workflows, from automating sales task assignment to running LLM analysis on sales calls so the team can review performance at scale.

The team is small – three engineers, two data scientists and you – with the senior engineer sharing the day-to-day leadership. You'll report to a Senior Product Owner in an adjacent team.

The role

As Product Owner in Acquitech, you'll turn requests from marketing and sales into well-scoped work the team can deliver, and own the roadmap. You'll have real ownership of systems that directly shape acquisition spend, and the space to move quickly in a small, capable team. The work mixes delivery – compliance sign-offs, ad platform integrations and product changes – with discovery cycles where you prototype and test ideas quickly.

You'll become the go-to person for Acquitech systems and processes, and you'll use AI to multiply what a small team can deliver – from prototyping ideas to automating workflows for the team and its stakeholders.

  • Roadmap and priorities. You'll own priorities across Acquitech's work, writing clear requirements and seeing them through to release. You'll set direction with the Head of Direct Acquisition and the channel leads who depend on the team.

  • Tracking and ad platform integrations. You'll lead the team's work on conversion tracking, custom audiences and API migrations. You'll own the product change documentation that comes with them, working through Compliance, Data Privacy and Legal.

  • Discovery. You'll run discovery work to find new opportunities, using AI to prototype and test ideas quickly, and bring findings back to the wider business – for example through weekly learning sessions.

  • Ways of working. You'll run the team's rhythms – stand-ups, retros and monthly reviews – and set clear quarterly goals.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Product ownership. You've worked in a product role, managing several projects end to end – writing requirements, owning priorities and being accountable for results.

  • Data literacy. You use data to diagnose problems, size opportunities and evaluate whether a release delivered what you hoped.

  • Technical fluency. You can discuss trade-offs with engineers around APIs, tracking pipelines and data flows. You follow the argument without needing everything translated.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly. You adapt technical detail for commercial colleagues and commercial context for engineers.

  • Leadership. You're comfortable running stand-ups and retros, setting quarterly goals and keeping priorities clear.

  • AI leverage. You've built AI workflows, or used AI to produce specs, analysis, or prototypes beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

Bonus:

  • Marketing technology. You've worked with tools such as Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, Google Ads or Meta Ads, or on conversion tracking and attribution.

  • Analytics tools. You've used Looker, Amplitude or a similar analytics platform to build or maintain reporting.

title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

title: Productmanager Data & Webdiensten
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een inspirator die strategische IT-doelen weet te operationaliseren en innovatie binnen je team stimuleert? Wil jij een veilige en moderne generieke technische IT-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden? En zorg jij ervoor dat de dagelijkse operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt?

Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Als Productmanager Data en Webdiensten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en realisatie van de productroadmap en begeleid je de processen die nodig zijn om onze producten en diensten conform de geldende kaders te realiseren. Samen met 13 collega's werk je aan het dagelijks operationeel houden en verder ontwikkelen van onze technische IT-dienstverlening.

Een belangrijke ontwikkeling is de verdere uitbreiding van selfservice, onder andere door de inzet van Infrastructure as Code en het via API's ontsluiten van onze diensten. Daarbij staan veiligheid, compliance en efficiëntie centraal. Onze diensten voldoen vanaf het ontwerp aan de geldende CIS- en ISO-kaders, waarbij het naleven van security- en compliancebeleid prioriteit heeft.

Je begeleidt een team van 10 tot 15 engineers en senior engineers bij Agile werken en de inhoudelijke productontwikkeling. Je stimuleert een proactieve werkwijze en zorgt voor de verbinding tussen strategische doelstellingen en de dagelijkse uitvoering. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega-productmanagers, architecten, servicemanagers, beheerteams en andere stakeholders.

Je belangrijkste werkzaamheden zijn:

  • Je ontwikkelt een samenhangende productstrategie en visie voor de productsuite van het team Data en Webdiensten en stemt deze af met het hoofd IGI en andere stakeholders. Hierin borg je naast vernieuwing ook veiligheid, compliance en efficiëntie.

  • Je vertaalt de vastgestelde productstrategie en visie naar een meerjarige roadmap, kwartaalplanningen en een productbacklog.

  • Je organiseert en begeleidt Agile-events, waaronder dagstarts, sprintplanningen, sprintreviews, retrospectives en refinements, zowel binnen als buiten het eigen team. Daarnaast coach je teamleden.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor technische teams, architecten, Security Services, Contracts & Finance en servicemanagement. Je bevordert de samenwerking en zorgt voor afstemming over productdoelen en -strategieën.

  • Je onderhoudt contact met afnemers en andere productmanagers, verzamelt feedback en vertaalt hun uitdagingen en behoeften naar de verdere productontwikkeling.

  • Je ontwikkelt samen met het hoofd IGI en andere productmanagers KPI's en succesmaatstaven, bijvoorbeeld voor adoptie, efficiëntie, kosten en productiviteit van engineers. Je maakt de prestaties van geleverde diensten inzichtelijk en houdt toezicht op veiligheid, compliance, beschikbaarheid en performance. Hiervoor benut je bestaande inzichten vanuit servicemanagement en ontwikkel je waar nodig aanvullende inzichten.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je werkt in het team Data en Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). Deze afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 30 experts, verdeeld over onze locaties in Heerlen en Den Haag. Het team Data en Webdiensten telt circa 15 collega's die eveneens op beide locaties werkzaam zijn.

We werken volgens een Agile-methodiek in combinatie met ITIL. Een actieve bijdrage aan deze werkwijze vinden we belangrijk. Dit betekent onder andere het opstellen van kwalitatief goede stories en epics, het actueel houden van stories op het Azure DevOps-bord en een actieve, constructieve deelname aan dagstarts, planningen, reviews en retrospectives.

Samenwerking, continu verbeteren en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk. Dit is dan ook verankerd in onze kernwaarden.

Dit ben jij

Je bent een initiatiefrijke, ondernemende en zelfstandige productmanager die strategisch inzicht weet te combineren met technische basiskennis. Je begrijpt de technische uitdagingen van onze infrastructuurdiensten en kunt hierover effectief communiceren met zowel engineers als andere stakeholders.

Je beschikt over methodische kennis van Agile en Scrum en weet hoe je samenwerking en continue verbetering binnen een team stimuleert. Je kunt strategisch denken, relevante markttrends herkennen en deze vertalen naar een productvisie. Daarbij weet je verschillende belangen en behoeften met elkaar te verbinden.

Je hebt een sterke ambitie om de user- en customer experience maximaal te faciliteren. Continu samen verbeteren zit in jouw DNA. Je ziet kansen om onze dienstverlening verder te ontwikkelen en neemt initiatief om verbeteringen daadwerkelijk te realiseren.

Daarbij herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je beschikt over technische basiskennis en hebt begrip van API's, cloudsystemen en software- en/of infrastructuurarchitectuur.

  • Je hebt kennis van Agile en Scrum en beschikt over de methodische vaardigheden om deze werkwijzen toe te passen.

  • Je beschikt over sterke sociale en communicatieve vaardigheden om effectief samen te werken met engineers en stakeholders.

  • Je bent in staat om strategisch te denken en markttrends te vertalen naar een duidelijke productvisie.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en ondernemend, neemt initiatief en stimuleert een proactieve manier van werken.

  • Je bent gericht op continu samen verbeteren en hebt oog voor de behoeften en ervaringen van gebruikers en afnemers.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 4818,- en maximaal € 7094,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. In totaal is dit 16,5% bovenop je salaris. Dit noemen wij het Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Je bepaalt zelf hoe, wanneer en op welke manier je dit budget wilt inzetten.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP Pensioenfonds.

  • Een laptop (Microsoft of Apple) en mobiele telefoon (Android of iOS).

  • Twee tot drie dagen thuiswerken, de rest ben je aanwezig in ons onlangs gerenoveerde gebouw. In je team maak je daar verder afspraken over.

Kom werken aan de feiten

Für ein langfristiges Projekt bei unserem Kunden in Bern (mit Remote-Anteil), suchen wir einen Professional ICT Test Manager (m/w/d) - SIP / VISO / Test Automation.

Key Facts
Start: 23.11.2026
Dauer: 15 Monate /
Auslastung: 80 %
Einsatzart:
Einsatzort: Bern
Einsatzland: Schweiz

Ihre Aufgaben

• Selbstständiges Erstellen von Testspezifikationen sowie Test- und Testablaufplänen

• Kontinuierliche Optimierung verschiedener Tests und Analyse von Anforderungen

• Befähigung der Fachbereiche zu effizienten Testvorgehen

• Planung und Durchführung effektiver Softwaretests auf verschiedenen Ebenen mit spezialisierten Werkzeugen einschließlich Xray-basierter Testplanung

• Kontinuierlicher Austausch mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zur Sicherstellung einer hohen Qualität

• Durchführung automatisierter und manueller Tests

• Erweiterung und Pflege von Regressionstests

• Erstellung und Ausführung neuer oder bestehender CI/CD-Pipelines für die Testautomatisierung

• Erstellen von Testfällen und Testablaufdiagrammen sowie Implementierung von Tests

• Durchführung von Wissenstransfer zwischen Teams



Muss-Anforderungen

• ISTQB Foundation Level

• Analytisches Denken und Problemlösungskompetenz

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierung

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit agilen Testmanagement-Tools

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Testautomatisierung von REST-Schnittstellen, beispielsweise mit Bruno (CLI), sowie von Benutzeroberflächen mit Cypress, Playwright und Selenium

• Erfahrung mit System- und End-to-End-Tests (E2E) sowie mit funktionalen Abnahmetests einschließlich Analyse, Design, Implementierung, Ausführung und Berichterstellung in interdisziplinären agilen Teams

• Erfahrung mit DevOps-Tools wie Jenkins, OpenShift, Git/Bitbucket und Docker, von Vorteil

• Interesse an konstruktiven Gesprächen mit Produktteams aus Fachbereichsmitarbeitenden, BizDevOps Engineers, Architektinnen und Architekten sowie Product Ownern



Kann-Anforderungen

• ISTQB CT-TAE Test Automation Engineer

• Kenntnisse in der statischen Codeanalyse mit SonarQube

• Erfahrung mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden wie Scrum und SAFe

• Erfahrung mit Atlassian Jira (Xray) und Confluence

• Praxisorientierter Einsatz von AI Coding Assistants mit Fokus auf Kosteneffizienz, Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und nachhaltigen Wissenstransfer

• Erfahrung im Testen von Kafka-Schnittstellen



Weitere Informationen

- Einsatzzeitraum: 01.10.2026 – 31.12.2027 mit Option auf Verlängerung


- Pensum: 60–80%


- Einsatzort: Bern Wankdorf mit Remote-Anteil mit Teamtagen vor Ort (Dienstag und Donnerstag)

Vom Business Case bis hin zur Umsetzung: Als führendes Beratungsunternehmen für strategische Transformationen sind wir vertrauenswürdiger Partner für unsere Kunden - und für unsere Mitarbeitenden. Verantwortungsvoll, leistungsstark und immer mit dem Menschen im Fokus. #WeAreWavestone
Mit unserem 360°-Portfolio an Beratungsleistungen verbinden wir erstklassige Branchenexpertise mit einem breiten Spektrum an branchenübergreifenden Kompetenzen, arbeiten interdisziplinär und denken über den Tellerrand hinaus. title: Project Manager Innovation Bank Transaction Systems
descriptionHtml:
coni + partner, established 1993, is a consultancy company with headquarters in Zurich and subsidiaries in Düsseldorf and Shanghai. We are specialised in custom-fit staffing in tune with the corporate culture by ensuring a perfect match of professional skills, references and personal as well as social skills of successful candidates.

Our client is an international bank in Zurich. We are searching for a payment or transaction specialist (m, f, d) as

Project Manager Innovation Bank Transaction Systems

Your Tasks:

As a member of a team responsible for the smooth functioning of payment system operations / Analyse all incoming/outgoing payments e.g. large-value and mass payments in connection with services provided by financial market participants / Analyse the interbank alerts and the bank's crisis organization / Promoting the continuous improvement of payment processes and transformative change across the bank, including AI and its potential applications within the filtering systems designed to combat sanctions and payment fraud / Working closely with the business and IT teams to support colleagues with complex issues, with the aim of improving efficiency, the quality of transactions and services as well as operational stability / Monitoring transaction regulations and ensuring compliance with new regulatory standards by providing support with their implementation / Ensure that the process and control documentation is updated / Point of contact for enquiries regarding payment transactions and customer support / Involvement in various projects.

Your Profile:

Master’s or Bachelor’s with focus on Banking & Finance or Business Informatics / Professional experience with national and international payments as well as knowledge of the entire payments lifecycle / Sound knowledge of payment systems and operational controls of a bank / Experience as a project manager in the banking sector, in management consultancy (e.g. with the ‘Big 4’) or in strategy consultancy, combined with the specialist expertise to drive the adoption of AI within the bank / Know-how as project or sub-project leader providing business expertise to local and international projects / Ability to approach projects methodically and in a structured manner, and problem-solving skills / Ability to link different subject areas, as well as ‘holistic thinking’ / Self-starter and networker / Strong communication and negotiation skills / Strong interpersonal skills / German and English.

title: Projectontwikkelaar
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling.

Wat ga je doen

Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

· Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie;

· Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's;

· Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders;

· Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken;

· Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering;

· Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming;

· Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces;

· Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie;

· Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Hier zit je op jouw plek

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.


Dit breng jij mee

· Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar, ontwikkelmanager of vergelijkbare functie;

· Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

· Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen;

· Aantoonbare ervaring met projecten van substantiële omvang (200+ woningen is een pre).;

· Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten;

· Inzicht in bouwtechnische uitgangspunten om adviseurs aan te sturen en het plan verder uit te werken;

· Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie.

Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt van de projecten na tendergunning verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van de bouw en weet hoe je samen met alle betrokken partijen woningbouwprojecten succesvol kunt ontwikkelen én realiseren.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Het salaris voor deze functie ligt bij een medior profiel tussen € 5.639,- en € 7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur) en bij een senior profiel tussen € 6.512,- en € 9.512,- (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring.

  • Voor deze functie geldt een individuele bonusregeling, waarbij de hoogte van de bonus afhankelijk is van de behaalde resultaten.

  • Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra).

  • 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen;

  • Een laptop en een smartphone.

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap.

  • Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card.

  • Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike.

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit.

  • Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland.

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical.

  • Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.

Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen?

Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteren kan direct via onze website middels de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature.

Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze recruiter

title: Projektleiter HLS / TGA (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Hamburg | Vollzeit | unbefristet | Direktvermittlung

Für ein etabliertes Unternehmen aus der technischen Gebäudeausrüstung suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Projektleiter HLS / TGA (m/w/d). Die Position übernimmt die gesamtverantwortliche technische und kaufmännische Steuerung von Projekten im Bereich Heizung, Lüftung und Sanitär - von der Ausschreibung bis zum erfolgreichen Projektabschluss.

Gesucht wird eine Persönlichkeit, die HLS-Projekte strukturiert führt, Bauleiter und Obermonteure koordiniert, Nachunternehmer steuert und sowohl technisch als auch kaufmännisch den Überblick behält.

Aufgaben

  • Gesamtverantwortliche technische und kaufmännische Steuerung der zugeordneten HLS-Projekte

  • Fachliche Steuerung und Koordination von Bauleitern, Obermonteuren, Nachunternehmern und weiteren Projektbeteiligten

title: Propulsion Design Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Propulsion Design Engineer, you will join the Propulsion team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ propulsion system. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the electric propulsion system and guide the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, and manufacturing drawings.

You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.

The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of one of the most advanced electric propulsion systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Mature the propulsion system installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

  • Design and detail mechanical components, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

  • Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

  • Prepare and release detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards. Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system.

  • Assess system, interface and certification requirements and translate them into robust and practical design solutions.

  • Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability.

  • Perform engineering assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation.

  • Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements.

  • Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration

  • Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in a design engineering role on an EASA/FAA Part 23/25 aircraft development program.

  • Experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or international equivalent.

  • Practical experience with the design and integration of aircraft powerplant systems. Experience with electric aviation or electric propulsion systems is an asset.

  • Strong proficiency in CAD software, preferably CATIA V5/V6, including experience in part design, generative shape design, sheet metal design, assembly design, and drafting.

  • Sound knowledge of mechanical component design, aerospace materials, standard hardware and manufacturing methods, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, assembly and inspection requirements.

  • Understanding of design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly principles.

  • Ability to develop and assess installation designs while balancing functional, structural, environmental, certification, manufacturing and maintainability considerations.

  • Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach and attention to detail.

  • A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and the ability to work effectively in a multicultural team.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Propulsion Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Propulsion Test Engineer

We are looking for a Propulsion Test Engineer to plan, prepare, execute, and analyse in-house propulsion tests. You will focus on static-fire testing of small, medium, and large rocket motors, working with propulsion engineers and the wider team to produce safe, repeatable tests and high-quality data that drives the next design iteration.

We run hot fire tests and launch campaigns regularly, as such this is a unique opportunity to be in the heart of the action.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Define test objectives, success criteria, instrumentation requirements, test configurations, and data products.

  • Prepare test procedures, checklists, risk controls, readiness reviews, and supporting documentation.

  • Prepare motors, fixtures, sensors, data-acquisition systems, facilities, and support equipment for testing.

  • Execute or support static-fire tests safely and methodically, troubleshooting issues as they arise.

  • Acquire, validate, reduce, and analyse data such as force, pressure, and temperature measurements.

  • Produce post-test reports and work with engineers to feed results into design, formulation, and test-process improvements.

What we are looking for

  • A degree in mechanical, aerospace, electrical, or systems engineering, physics, mechatronics, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant.

  • Experience in test engineering, experimental engineering, laboratory testing, commissioning, or another hands-on hardware environment.

  • Experience developing or executing test procedures and working systematically through preparation, execution, data review, and reporting.

  • Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, data acquisition, calibration, and signal quality.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to safety, and a methodical approach under pressure.

  • Willingness to work directly with test stands, fixtures, cabling, instrumentation, hardware, and facilities.

Desirable experience

  • Static-fire testing or testing rocket engines, solid or hybrid motors, combustion hardware, pressure systems, or other hazardous aerospace hardware.

  • Thrust stands, pressure transducers, load cells, thermocouples, or high-speed data acquisition.

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
descriptionHtml:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.

The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.

Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime.

What you’ll own

  • API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches.

  • IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality.

  • Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform.

  • Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking.

  • Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works.

  • The project as a product. Benchmark real workloads, track performance over time, catch regressions early. Stay close to users (Genesis first), find friction and missing abstractions, drive adoption, set direction.

Who you are

You reason about whole systems and have taste for where complexity should live. You measure before you optimize, and you reach for memory traffic and launch overhead before FLOPs. You have opinions about API design. You write tests and benchmarks as you go, not afterward.

The ground that judgment stands on:

  • GPU. What optimal looks like and why: access patterns, registers, shared memory, barriers, atomics, threading. CPU intuition a plus.

  • Python & API taste. Idiomatic Python. A feel for what’s natural to Python users. APIs that free users rather than constrain them.

  • Compilers. The path from authoring to kernels (IR, lowering, optimization), weighed against maintainability.

And how you work: proactive and largely self-directed. You fetch context across the company instead of waiting for it. You’re comfortable talking to the engineers who use what you build, and at ease designing in the open for users you’ll never meet. Ready to grow into leading a small team (a couple of people, near term).

What great looks like

People adopt Quadrants from outside Genesis. Engineers write clearer code with less boilerplate. Kernels keep getting faster. Performance is tracked, not guessed. The architecture gets easier to extend, not harder.

What we’re uncompromising about

How you work is up to you. What matters is that your ownership grows over time: blind spots shrink, the parts you can vouch for expand, technical debt goes down, the core stays sound.

That takes treating understanding as real work, not overhead. You read and challenge the codebase instead of just stacking features on it. You take nothing you did not write for granted. You watch the competition and what’s coming next, and you bring it in and ship it.

Use AI agents if they help. They are productivity tools, not code owners. You are.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Bring deep expertise in causal inference, experimentation and machine learning, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

title: Regional Sales Director, Strategic Enterprise - UK
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's UK Enterprise business is one of our fastest-growing segments globally. We've scaled rapidly over the past several years — consistently outpacing the broader business — and we're now at an inflection point where we need to pair that momentum with operational rigour to sustain growth at scale.

This Regional Sales Director role is central to that next chapter. You'll lead a team of six Senior Enterprise Account Executives and Client Directors selling into some of the UK's largest and most complex organisations, spanning transportation, logistics, infrastructure, utilities, and field services.

The team is performing — but we want to turn strong results into a repeatable, scalable engine. That means bringing structure, coaching discipline, and a proven enterprise playbook without losing the pace and builder energy that got us here.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the performance, development, and day-to-day leadership of a team of Senior Enterprise AEs, driving net new logo acquisition and expansion across a defined set of strategic UK accounts
  • Coach your team through complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles where average contract values regularly reach seven figures over multi-year terms
  • Build and run a structured operating rhythm - pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecasting discipline - while getting close enough to the detail to add value at the deal level
  • Develop your reps' ability to access economic buyers, build multi-threaded relationships, and position Samsara's expanding product portfolio against a customer's most critical business priorities
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large UK enterprises - this isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles - cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping - that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the UK's largest accounts
  • Partner closely with the AVP of Strategic and Enterprise Sales UK, your peer RSDs, and cross-functional teams including Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Proven experience as a frontline or second-line sales leader in B2B enterprise technology, with direct responsibility for team quota attainment
  • Track record of coaching Account Executives through complex, multi-quarter sales cycles with average deal sizes of £250K+ ACV, but with experience of seven figure ACV deals
  • Experience selling into large, multi-stakeholder organisations where procurement, legal, and multiple business units are involved in the buying decision
  • Demonstrated ability to build and enforce a structured sales operating cadence — pipeline generation, deal qualification, forecasting accuracy, and stage progression
  • Strong commercial instinct for multi-product or platform selling, where the value proposition spans multiple use cases and buyer personas

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company that was scaling its enterprise go-to-market in the UK or EMEA — ideally where you helped build or refine the playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style with a track record of developing AEs from good to exceptional, not just managing top performers
  • Experience managing forecast accuracy as a discipline, not just an output — particularly in an environment where leadership investment decisions depend on the reliability of your calls
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you're expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity — you can set a multi-year account strategy and also jump into a deal review and tell a rep exactly where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Insurance: the carriers, MGAs, and brokers people rely on when life gets expensive and complicated. These organizations win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to insurers reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale.

In this role you will:

  • Focus on prospecting and landing net-new customers to expand the market footprint that ElevenLabs has in the Insurance industry

  • Balance a diverse pipeline of large national carriers that require a white-glove experience with regional and mid-sized insurers that require speed to close

  • Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in customer-facing and internal workflows, such as claims intake, policy servicing and renewals, billing and payment support, agent and broker support, and contact center coaching

  • Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in insurance AI governance and regulation

  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, guide customers through security, architecture, and AI governance review, and set them up to scale in production

  • Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Insurance positioning, messaging, and references

Requirements

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

  • Insurance experience (carriers, MGAs, brokers, insurtech) is preferred but not required. We weigh demonstrated adaptability and fast ramp in a new industry heavily

  • Proven success closing [six- and seven-figure] deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

title: Activation and Production Testing Specialist
descriptionHtml:
🌍 About Hopae

At Hopae, we're building the world's most trusted digital identity platform — private, secure, and built for real life. We believe identity should be in your control — not locked behind outdated systems or centralized gatekeepers.

Our product, Hopae Connect, lets businesses verify real people across borders through a single API — no need to build country-by-country integrations themselves. Our technology powers instant, privacy-first verification across fintech, credentials, supply chain, and gaming — for IDV providers, e-signature platforms, and enterprises who need identity to just work, everywhere.

Backed by top global investors, Hopae operates across Seoul, Paris, Luxembourg, and San Francisco, bringing together exceptional talent from over 10 nationalities. We move fast, think globally, and build products that define the future of identity.

💡 Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Global DNA: Work with exceptional peers across Seoul, Paris, and San Francisco

  • High Impact: Build technology shaping the global trust and identity landscape

  • Ownership Culture: No micromanagement — full trust, full accountability

  • Elite Standards: Work fast, learn fast, and grow with world-class peers

  • Inclusive & Respectful: 10+ nationalities, diverse perspectives, one vision

  • Growth Mindset: Access mentorship, leadership visibility, and continuous learning

What You Will Do

A signed contract is the start of a customer’s journey, not the finish line. On our Activation & Assurance team, you’ll help customers complete provider onboarding, understand how our product works, and validate their integration with real production testers.

This is a junior, hands-on role for someone who enjoys organized work, clear communication, and getting the details right. You’ll start with established playbooks and test procedures, then help improve them as you learn the product and settle into the team.

  • Run activation workflows. Follow provider-specific manuals to submit onboarding requests and coordinate registrations, approvals, and contracting steps with identity providers. Receive credentials and enter them accurately into the Hopae Console, following security procedures and checking the customer and environment.

  • Provide eID-specific activation guidance. When customer involvement is needed, explain the provider’s activation requirements, collect the necessary information, and guide customers through the steps they need to complete.

  • Recruit and manage production testers. Find and onboard testers for the countries and identity providers involved, confirm their eligibility and availability, explain what they need to do, and maintain an organized, reliable tester network.

  • Coordinate and run real-world tests. Once a customer has integrated our product, organize testing with real production testers. Agree on schedules, prepare test scenarios and instructions, guide testers through the user journey, and keep testing on track. Support recurring production checks using the team’s established procedures.

  • Collect evidence and report results. Gather tester feedback and supporting evidence, check outcomes against the expected user flow, and produce clear reports showing what was tested, what worked, what failed, and what still needs attention.

  • Raise issues and follow through. Turn test findings into actionable issues with reproduction steps and relevant evidence. Coordinate with Engineering, Product, and provider-facing teams, track progress, and arrange retesting when fixes are ready. You don’t need to fix the underlying code yourself, but you do need to keep the follow-up moving.

  • Keep people and information aligned. Maintain accurate records of activation status, test coverage, schedules, and blockers. Keep customers, testers, and internal teams informed, and flag missing information or schedule risks early.

  • Help improve how we work. As you gain experience, identify recurring friction and improve checklists, documentation, and handoffs. You’ll also help monitor existing operational automations, check their outputs, and flag exceptions or improvement opportunities.

Who You Are

  • You are detail-driven and dependable. You can follow defined processes consistently, check information carefully, and complete repeatable work without losing accuracy or leaving loose ends.

  • You work in an organized way. You can manage multiple requests and test schedules, keep records current, and follow up with the right people to meet agreed timelines.

  • You communicate clearly and patiently. You’re comfortable working with customers, external testers, and identity providers. You can explain instructions, ask useful questions, and keep people informed without overwhelming them.

  • You are good at gathering and structuring information. You can turn scattered feedback, screenshots, and observations into a clear test report or issue that someone else can act on. You distinguish confirmed findings from things that still need investigation.

  • You have practical technical curiosity. You can learn your way around APIs, credentials, configuration settings, and test versus production environments. You don’t need to be a developer or an identity expert, but you should be comfortable reading documentation and following technical instructions.

  • You know when to ask for help. You recognize when something falls outside the playbook, escalate with useful context, and handle credentials and tester information carefully.

  • You want to grow beyond the checklist. You’re happy to learn established workflows first, then use what you’ve learned to suggest practical process improvements. We don’t expect you to arrive with every answer.

  • You work comfortably in Korean and English. You can communicate with local teammates and international customers, testers, and providers, both in writing and in conversation.

  • Bonus: Experience in customer onboarding, operations, testing coordination, technical support, or customer success. Familiarity with B2B SaaS or digital identity is helpful, but not required.

About the job

As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, we are seeking an Engagement Manager to lead the implementation of AI-driven initiatives powered by QVAC, Tether’s SDK for local AI and delegated inference. The role focuses on orchestrating complex, multi-stakeholder deployments of decentralized AI solutions across enterprise, government, and institutional environments.

This position combines client engagement, technical coordination, and delivery oversight to ensure successful onboarding and execution of AI use cases, ranging from edge AI deployments to privacy-preserving inference systems. The Engagement Manager plays a central role in aligning client objectives with product capabilities, coordinating internal and external stakeholders, and driving implementations from initial scoping through production rollout.

Client & Partner Engagement

Implementations Oversight

  • Lead end-to-end coordination of QVAC-based implementations from kickoff through production deployment.

  • Define implementation roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies across AI models, infrastructure, and integration layers.

  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and actual product capabilities, avoiding scope drift or mispositioning.

  • Track progress across multiple concurrent AI deployments, ensuring timely delivery and readiness for production environments.

Cross-functional Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with product, engineering, and research teams to align on QVAC capabilities, limitations, and roadmap evolution.

  • Work with legal and compliance teams where required, particularly in sensitive AI deployments involving data locality or privacy constraints.

  • Maintain structured communication flows across all stakeholders involved in the implementation lifecycle.

Governance & Reporting

  • Establish and maintain governance frameworks including implementation plans, risk tracking, and decision logs.

  • Produce executive-level updates summarizing progress, risks, blockers, and next steps.

  • Ensure documentation of implementation architectures, deployment patterns, and key learnings for reuse across future projects.

  • Support escalation management and ensure timely resolution of technical or operational challenges.


Core Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, technical account management, or delivery roles within AI, data infrastructure, or complex technology environments.

  • Proven experience managing cross-functional implementations involving multiple stakeholders (internal teams, clients, external partners).

  • Strong ability to operate at the intersection of technical and business domains.

Technical Understanding

  • Familiarity with AI/ML deployment concepts, including model inference, edge/local AI, and distributed compute architectures.

  • Understanding of APIs, SDK integrations, and system architecture patterns.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

title: Lead Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Aker Systems was founded in 2017 by a team of experienced technology professionals who recognised an opportunity to provide highly secure enterprise data platforms to large organisations.  We build and operate ground-breaking, ultra-secure, high performance, cloud-based data infrastructure for the enterprise. Our proprietary technology solutions drive performance and reduce costs while helping our clients to improve the management and sharing of data across their organisations.

In 2024, Aker Systems won the Breakthrough Culture Awards highlighting growth companies putting culture first. In 2020 Aker Systems was recognised as a ‘One to Watch’ on the Sunday Times Tech Track.  The Company was also recognised at the Thames Valley Tech Awards 2020; winning the Thames Valley Tech Company of the year, the Emerging Tech Company and High Growth Tech Business categories.  We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply.  We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, and supportive place for you to do your very best work.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Lead Data Engineer to design, build and evolve secure, scalable data platforms for clients across the UK Public Sector and Utilities sectors.

You will work closely with architects, engineers and client stakeholders to deliver modern cloud-based data solutions that support operational, analytical and AI-driven use cases. The role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering, helping clients modernise their data estates while ensuring solutions are secure, reliable and scalable.

Working across multiple projects, you will lead the development of batch and real-time data pipelines, support architectural decision-making, and help establish engineering best practices across delivery teams.

Strong experience with real-time streaming technologies is essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development and deployment of secure, scalable data pipelines and data platform components.
  • Design and implement batch and real-time streaming solutions using modern event-driven architectures.
  • Own technical design decisions across projects, balancing scalability, security, performance and delivery requirements.
  • Lead technical workshops, discovery sessions and architecture discussions with client stakeholders.
  • Assess existing client data platforms and design practical approaches for modernisation, migration and integration.
  • Build and maintain data ingestion, transformation and integration capabilities across a variety of data sources.
  • Develop cloud-native data platforms using AWS services and open-source technologies.
  • Ensure data quality, governance, lineage and security requirements are embedded throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Drive engineering best practices including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Support multiple client engagements, helping delivery teams maintain consistent engineering quality and standards.
  • Mentor and support engineers across project teams, providing technical guidance and leadership.
  • Perform data modelling, performance tuning and root cause analysis to resolve complex data and platform issues.

Essential Skills & Experience

Real-Time Streaming & Data Engineering

  • Strong commercial experience designing and implementing real-time streaming data platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis, Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, Apache Pulsar, or similar event-driven technologies.
  • Experience building high-volume, low-latency, resilient data pipelines in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of modern data engineering patterns, including batch, streaming and hybrid architectures.

Data Engineering & Databases

  • Extensive experience developing and operating enterprise-scale data platforms.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing data models for analytical and operational workloads.
  • Proficiency in Python or other modern programming languages used for data engineering.
  • Experience configuring, tuning and optimising relational and NoSQL databases.

Cloud & Software Engineering

  • Strong experience working with AWS cloud services, including EC2, RDS, Lambda, Athena, Glue, S3 and IAM.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
  • Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and automated testing practices.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and engineering automation.
  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code principles.
  • Experience using version control systems such as Git.

Regulated Environments

  • Experience delivering technology solutions within UK Public Sector, Utilities, Energy, Water, Financial Services or other highly regulated industries.
  • Understanding of security, governance and compliance considerations within regulated environments.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Terraform.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of Ansible and Packer.
  • Linux and Windows administration experience.
  • Experience supporting AI, machine learning or advanced analytics platforms.
  • Experience working on programmes requiring UK Government security clearance.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong technical leadership and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in complex, regulated environments.
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to support and mentor others.
  • A focus on delivering practical solutions that create value for clients.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Mathematics or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

At Aker we work as a team; we are collaborative, hardworking, open, and delivery obsessed. There is no blame culture here: try things, and take responsibility for the outcomes. title: Partner Solution Architect - SAI
descriptionHtml:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running.
