Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. 

About the Role 

Veeam is seeking a technically strong, customer-focused Strategic Partner Solutions Architect – Securiti.ai to accelerate Securiti.ai business through the established Veeam partner ecosystem. This individual will serve as the trusted technical advisor to Veeam partners, working closely with Veeam’s Channel Managers, Strategic Partner Specialists and Systems Engineers to design, demonstrate and validate Securiti.ai solutions for partners and their customers. This position adds deep technical expertise to the partner motion while preserving the Channel Manager’s ownership of the overall partner relationship. 

The Solutions Architect will bring hands-on expertise in Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC. Together with Veeam channel and partner teams, this individual will build partner technical capability, lead solution design and proofs of value, and help convert partner-led opportunities into measurable Securiti.ai pipeline and revenue. 

 Success requires technical depth, strong collaboration and the ability to translate complex data security and AI governance requirements into clear, deployable solutions. The ideal candidate is a credible pre-sales architect who excels in an overlay model — someone who strengthens existing Veeam partner relationships while contributing the architecture, demonstrations and enablement needed to build a successful Securiti.ai practice. This person can earn the confidence of partner engineers and customer security leaders alike and turn technical engagement into repeatable, partner-delivered outcomes. 

 What You’ll Do 

 Veeam Channel and Technical Alignment 

Operate as the technical overlay within the Veeam channel organization: 

  • Partner with Veeam Channel Managers, Strategic Partner Specialists and Systems Engineers to support each assigned partner with a consistent technical engagement cadence. 
  • Own the Securiti.ai technical strategy, solution architecture and pre-sales motion within each partner relationship, while the Veeam Channel Manager retains ownership of the overall relationship. 
  • Jointly engage partner technical leaders with Veeam teams to align on priority use cases, solution roadmaps and technical investments. 
  • Equip Veeam Systems Engineers and Channel Managers with the technical messaging, demo assets and training needed to introduce Securiti.ai into partner and customer conversations. 
  • Set clear rules of engagement for technical support, opportunity handoffs and escalations so partners experience Veeam and Securiti.ai as one team. 
  • Serve as the bridge between partners and Veeam and Securiti.ai product management, engineering, support and services teams, relaying field feedback and feature requirements. 

 Partner Technical Planning 

  • Develop technical enablement and certification plans for assigned partners alongside their Veeam Channel Managers and Partner Specialists, setting goals for certified engineers, demo capability, proofs of value and delivery readiness. 
  • Assess partner technical maturity, including security expertise, cloud and platform skills, services capacity and integration capabilities. 
  • Incorporate Securiti.ai technical priorities into existing Veeam partner plans and quarterly business reviews. 
  • Identify the lab, demo, training and technical resources each partner requires and review readiness on a regular cadence with Veeam and partner stakeholders. 

 Solution Architecture and Practice Enablement 

  • Recruit, train and certify partner solution engineers, architects and services teams on Securiti.ai. 
  • Lead the technical build-out of partner Data Security, DSPM and AI Governance practices, defining reference architectures, delivery methodologies, skills and certification paths. 
  • Deliver technical training, workshops and hands-on labs that enable partner and Veeam teams to demonstrate and position Securiti.ai Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC capabilities. 
  • Help partners design repeatable technical assessments, workshops, managed services and implementation offerings. 
  • Architect joint solutions that integrate Securiti.ai with the partner’s own services and their existing Veeam portfolio, creating differentiated, repeatable solutions for their customers. 
  • Create and maintain technical assets, including demo environments, reference architectures, solution briefs, discovery guides and competitive technical positioning. 

 Pre-Sales and Opportunity Support 

  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations and proofs of value with partners for priority customer opportunities. 
  • Align Veeam, Securiti.ai and partner technical teams around priority customers, supporting opportunities from technical qualification through close. 
  • Respond to technical requirements, RFPs and security questionnaires, and address architecture, integration and compliance questions from customer stakeholders. 
  • Support a smooth transition from sale to implementation, ensuring partner delivery teams are prepared for successful deployment and adoption. 

 Measures of Success 

  • Securiti.ai pipeline and revenue influenced through partner technical engagement. 
  • Number of partner engineers trained and certified on Securiti.ai and partners able to independently demonstrate, sell and deliver solutions. 
  • Technical win rate and conversion of proofs of value into closed business. 
  • Number of joint solutions, reference architectures and partner-led assessments and services brought to market. 
  • Customer deployment success, partner satisfaction and strength of alignment with Veeam channel and technical teams. 

What You’ll Bring 

  •  7+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, sales engineering or technical consulting for enterprise technology. 
  • Demonstrated success in a channel-facing, partner technical or overlay pre-sales role. 
  • Proven ability to collaborate with existing account and relationship owners while leading the technical sale for a specialized solution portfolio. 
  • Experience enabling and supporting technical teams at VARs, solution providers, MSPs, integrators, or advisory partners. 
  • Strong ability to lead technical discovery, solution design, product demonstrations and proofs of value. 
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, data security, data governance, privacy or AI security. 
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), SaaS applications, data platforms and identity and access management. 
  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, architectures and use cases that both sales and technical audiences can act on. 
  • Ability to influence internal and external stakeholders without relying on direct authority. 
  • Strong communication, presentation, whiteboarding and technical writing skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple partner and customer engagements while maintaining accountability for measurable results. 
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, enablement sessions, customer engagements and industry events. 

 Bonus Skills 

  • Hands-on experience with Securiti.ai or comparable DSPM, data discovery and classification, AI governance, privacy management, or GRC platforms. 
  • Experience designing partner-led assessments, managed services, workshops, or professional services offerings. 
  • Familiarity with privacy and AI regulations and frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF. 
  • Relevant security, privacy, or cloud certifications (for example CIPP, CISSP, CCSP, or an AWS, Azure or GCP architect or security credential). 

What You'll Get

Veeam, following its acquisition of Securiti AI - the leader in AI-powered data security posture management (DSPM) - is seeking Business Development Representatives to drive growth in this innovative business. 

You will generate new demand and build qualified pipeline, working both self-generated outbound and inbound demand from marketing. You will run discovery conversations that produce genuinely qualified opportunities, and stay with them until they are established with a Sales Specialist. 

What You’ll Do

Generate demand 

  • Work inbound and marketing-sourced leads — demo requests, event leads and campaign responses.

  • Research prospects to uncover business context and pain points, using AI-enabled tools to prioritise the accounts most likely to convert.

  • Qualify for value as well as fit — understand budget, scope and the size of the problem before advancing an opportunity.
  • Record meeting outcomes honestly. A meeting logged as moving forward is a commitment to convert it. 

Convert meetings into pipeline 

  • Convert qualified meetings into pipeline opportunities.
  • Own the handover to the Sales Specialist, ensuring actionable intelligence is documented in Salesforce.
  • Stay engaged after handover — support early discovery, help secure the next meeting, and keep the opportunity moving. 

Partner with Sales Specialists and Marketing 

  • Work with your Sales Specialists to agree target accounts and shape the outbound plan for your patch — know which accounts matter, and why, before you start.
  • Build genuine partnership on live opportunities: brief thoroughly, agree the next step, and keep the specialist informed as the opportunity develops.

  • Give marketing structured feedback on lead quality, events and campaigns. You see first-hand what converts and what does not, and that insight should shape where the next investment goes. 

Keep the record straight 

  • Log every meeting outcome within 24 hours and link each opportunity to the meeting that originated it.
  • Maintain accurate records of account activity and qualification in Salesforce — reporting and forecasting depend on it. 

Grow

  • Stay current on industry trends and the competitive landscape, and seek feedback to keep improving

What You’ll Bring

  • Minimum of 2 years experience as a Business Development Representative, Sales Development Representative, or in a related pipeline-generation role.
  • A track record of converting meetings into qualified opportunities, not just booking them.
  • Resilience and persistence — you treat objections as information and don’t take “no” as a final answer.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with strong listening skills and the ability to adapt your style to what you hear.
  • Genuine curiosity about buyers — you want to understand their world before engaging with your solution.
  • A self-starter with strong organisational skills and the discipline to keep a CRM accurate under pressure.
  • Confidence working alongside Sales Specialists and Marketing — agreeing priorities, giving honest feedback, and chasing or escalating when an opportunity stalls.
  • Exposure to data security, AI governance, data privacy or compliance as a market.
  • Experience using Salesforce and research tools.
  • Previous experience in technology or SaaS.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted productivity tools and experimenting with new technology.
  • Knowledge of account-based marketing and sales strategies.

The Senior Manager, International Customer Supply Chain will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer and retail partner experience across rhode’s growing international business. This role will partner closely with Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Operations, international distributors and retail partners to ensure strong execution across order management, inventory flow, launch planning, and ongoing customer supply chain performance. This role will support multiple international markets and distribution partners, requiring strong coordination across regions and global supply chain processes.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires strong analytical skills, clear communication, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where processes are still being built. The ideal candidate is proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable moving between day-to-day execution and longer-term process improvement.

A core focus of this role will be building strong relationships with key retail partners, understanding their supply chain requirements, supporting innovation and promotional planning, identifying and mitigating supply risks, and using customer data to improve in-stocks, fulfillment, and overall service levels.


What You'll Do

  • Serve as a key point of contact between rhode and international distributors and retail customer operations teams, supporting day-to-day execution and market-specific supply chain needs

  • Continually assess opportunities to improve customer supply chain, reduce operational costs, and drive volume through supply chain metrics

  • Develop a deep understanding of each international distributor and retail partner’s distribution model, operational requirements, key metrics, and inventory planning needs

  • Strong analytical skills to produce qualitative/quantitative data (using Excel, PowerPoint, NetSuite, Tableau) that can be shared to drive business

  • Broad understanding of policies, processes and systems relating to retail distributor operations

  • Overseeing and ensuring smooth order processing and timely delivery across international customers, distributors, and retail partners with focus on Innovation planning and customer expansion

  • Provide weekly sell in data vs. forecast and any risks associated to the month/quarter plan to Finance, Sales and Operations stakeholders

  • Track & monitor weekly sell out data coupled with retailer in stock levels in partnership with Demand planning and Sales account leads

  • As needed, partner with international distributors, retailer Supply Chain & planning teams to drive additional orders or forecast adjustments guaranteeing appropriate inventory coverage

  • Track and report on key international customer supply chain KPIs, including fulfillment, in-stocks, service levels, on-time delivery, and potential chargeback risk

  • Internal and external collaboration for alignment and identifying opportunities

  • Participate and contribute to customer demand forecasting, maximizing forecast accuracy

  • Participate and influence assortment decisions aimed at optimizing sales and productivity by utilizing analytics, market research, consumer research, and customer intelligence

  • Partner closely with international teams, distributors, and cross-functional stakeholders to support new market launches, regional assortment expansion, and ongoing operational excellence.

  • Ability to connect internal functions to drive supply chain improvements (fill rate, on-time, in-stocks, reduce potential chargebacks, customer program execution) for the customer

  • Help educate and align internal teams on international customer expectations, distributor requirements, regional retailer requirements, and best practices for execution


    • What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain or another analytical field preferred or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of experience in customer supply chain, retail operations, customer logistics, demand planning, supply planning, or related operational roles

  • Must have experience with Sephora and/or other global prestige beauty retailers

  • Experience supporting international retailers, distributors, or global customer supply chain operations.

  • Strong communication skills both verbal and written

  • Excellent Excel Skills and knowledge

  • Proven ability to build strong relationships with retail partners, internal cross-functional teams and deliver results

  • Ability to make thoughtful decisions when data is limited, ambiguous, or evolving

  • Experience managing multiple countries, distributors, or regional supply chain requirements

  • Willingness to travel internationally is required

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

You'll build and lead the regional team of product Subject Matter Experts who win GitLab's most complex opportunities. Your team covers four product groups: Security & Compliance, Platform, Core DevSecOps, and AI & Competitive. You'll partner with regional sales leadership to decide where SMEs go, coach your team to technical wins, and make sure every engagement leaves the Account team stronger. This is a player-coach role. You'll stay close to the technology and step into critical deals yourself.

What you'll do

  • Hire, develop and retain a regional team of SMEs across four product groups, with a clear growth path for each person.
  • Run the regional engagement model with Account SA and Post-Sales leaders. Keep triage fast, coverage focused on the top opportunities, and the line between Account SA and SME ownership clear.
  • Partner with regional sales leaders and AVPs on deal strategy, forecast calls and product-category plans.
  • Review SME coverage weekly against the regional pipeline. Move capacity to where product-category commit and consumption are at risk.
  • Step into strategic deals as an executive technical sponsor when the opportunity calls for it.
  • Coach SMEs on PoV design, executive storytelling and competitive positioning. Hold a high bar for technical quality.
  • Keep engagement and outcome data accurate in Salesforce so the team's impact is visible and measurable.
  • Work with your peer regional managers and the Senior Director on shared assets, enablement programs and a consistent global playbook.
  • Bring regional customer and competitive signals to Product and Engineering through the Senior Director.
  • Build a team culture of trust, ownership and learning. Celebrate wins openly and treat misses as data.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ Years experience leading technical pre-sales, solutions architecture or consulting, including time leading teams of technical individual contributors.
  • Hands-on depth in at least one of the four product groups, and enough breadth to coach across all four, including working fluency with AI-assisted development.
  • A record of hiring and developing high-performing technical specialists or SAs.
  • Experience partnering with sales leaders on enterprise forecasts, deal strategy and territory planning.
  • Comfort with data. You can show how your team moves win rates, cycle times and consumption.
  • Strong executive presence with customers and internal leaders.
  • Experience leading through change, with clear and steady communication.
  • Experience running an overlay or specialist team, or launching a new team or product category.
  • Ability to travel at least 25% 

How you'll be measured

  • Regional product-category commit attainment and consumption growth.
  • Technical win rate, PoV conversion and time to production use on SME-engaged opportunities.
  • SME coverage of the top 10% of regional opportunities, and lead time from request to engagement.
  • Account SA satisfaction with SME support.
  • Team hiring, ramp time, engagement and retention.
  • EAP Participation Rates for your given geography

#LI-CM1

About the team

SMEs are part of GitLab's Solutions Architecture team, a trusted technical partner for the field. The SME organization brings the deepest product expertise to GitLab's most complex opportunities, scales that expertise into the Account SA team, and carries customer feedback into product direction, enablement and value messaging. The team is distributed and all-remote.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
YOUR MISSION

 

A software engineer today uses Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest.

 

We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers, with real revenue and customers who tell us when we are slow.

 

The problems are open ones. Getting an agent to reason usefully about geometry, making 3D search work on real customer part libraries, and figuring out what the interface even looks like when an engineer asks why a bracket failed. There is research to borrow from and very little product to copy.

 

Senior or staff level depending on experience.

 

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 

You will own large problems end to end, across the stack. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but here is what the last two years have actually involved.

 

  • A multi-agent orchestration SDK, built from scratch. Nothing off the shelf handled what we needed: long-horizon execution that runs for hours and survives restarts.

  • CAD conversion as a real pipeline. It used to be manual and brittle. Turning it into production infrastructure meant writing a Python wrapper around a C++ SDK and making it reliable enough to sit under everything else.

  • Migrating the application off Electron and Webpack onto SSR React with Vite. That architecture is what the whole product now sits on.

 

What is coming:

 

  • 3D-to-3D search across real customer part libraries, not benchmark datasets

  • Constraint solvers and optimization, and getting an agent to use one sensibly

  • Agents that hold a useful model of a physical object, which is still an open problem

  • Hybrid cloud deployments for manufacturers who cannot send their data anywhere

 

We work in Python and TypeScript, with multi-agent orchestration and AI integrations across several providers.

 

WHAT WE CARE ABOUT

 

  • You have shipped production systems across frontend and backend, and can point at them

  • Your CV reads as a set of problems, not a stack

  • You use AI heavily to go faster, but you built things the hard way first

  • You are fine when the problem is not yet defined

  • You deliver end to end, and you are still there when it needs maintaining

 

Bonus: CAD, computational geometry, constraint solving or optimization, 3D, LLM agents, industrial software. None required.

descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Risk Analyst

You'll support & refine our lending strategy within Germany, including supporting new growth initiatives, designing & analysing tests, supporting the development of our scorecards and underwriting strategy, and managing our portfolio risk.

Working closely with data scientists, credit analysts and cross functional teams, you’ll solve analytical problems to help us provide small & medium size businesses in Germany with the funds they need to grow.

The team

The Lending Strategy team decides who iwoca lends to in Germany, and on what terms. Its work covers model development, lending strategy, and portfolio risk. The team works closely with Data Science (credit models), Product, tech teams, Operations Strategy, and our team of Credit Analysts. The team’s work is central to iwoca Germany’s growth and has a direct impact on both customer outcomes and business performance. The team includes data scientists, developers, and risk analysts, all working hybrid schedules in London.

 

The role

We're looking for a curious and motivated individual to join our Lending Strategy team as a Risk Analyst. You’ll work with analysts, data scientists, and senior stakeholders to shape iwoca Germany’s lending strategy.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Build expertise in the credit domain.

  • Develop your analytical skills through exposure to different experimental approaches and complex analysis.

  • Play a leading role in providing insightful analytics on the risk profile of our lending book and assisting with lending strategy decisions.

  • Partner with key stakeholders within Team Germany in order to provide credit risk expertise to multi-disciplinary projects.

  • Work closely with the data science teams to improve our credit assessment scorecards & strategies (both for our automated and manual underwriting processes).

  • Develop and maintain reporting dashboards, presenting a clear picture of the state of our lending.

  • Practice turning data into information, and information into insights, so that you and various stakeholders can deliver improvements with real impact for our customers.

The requirements

We look for people that are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential:

  • A degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar.

  • Ability to analyse data and generate insights to support decisions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor analysis and recommendations to different audiences.

  • An analytical mindset with a practical approach to problem solving.

  • A bucket-load of common sense.

  • A commitment to using modern tools effectively – including AI – to maximise quality, speed, and rigour, while retaining responsibility for accuracy and outcomes.

Bonus:

  • Experience in B2B or B2C credit risk lending and strategy.

  • Experience with SQL and Python

  • Experience with data visualisation tools like Looker

The salary

We expect to pay from £40,000–£55,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Sales Development Representative (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

AI is fundamentally changing how enterprises operate.

For decades, procurement teams have relied on spreadsheets, emails, and fragmented processes to manage billions of dollars in spend. As AI agents become capable of taking over increasingly complex workflows, the way companies run procurement is about to change.

At Lio, we're building THE AI workforce for procurement.

As a Sales Development Representative, you're not just booking meetings.

You're creating the first impression of Lio. You're opening conversations with the world's largest enterprises and helping procurement leaders understand how AI can transform the way they operate.

You'll work closely with founders, Account Executives, Marketing, and Product, and directly influence how we scale our go-to-market motion.

What You'll Do

  • Generate and qualify pipeline through creative outbound and inbound strategies

  • Engage early-stage prospects and educate them on how AI agents can transform procurement operations

  • Run outreach across multiple channels including email, LinkedIn, and phone

  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Account Executives to refine messaging, qualification, and handoff processes

  • Capture customer feedback and share insights with Product to help shape future features and improvements

  • Own your pipeline from first touch to handoff and ensure a seamless customer experience

  • Help build and continuously improve Lio's go-to-market playbook

Your Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Take ownership by default. You don't wait for instructions or permission. You make things happen, care about outcomes, and see challenges as problems to solve rather than obstacles to accept.

  • Know how to communicate and excite. Whether you're speaking to a Fortune 500 executive, a procurement leader, or an operational buyer on the factory floor, you know how to build trust, create excitement, and adapt your message to the person in front of you.

  • Enjoy high-growth environments. Things move quickly, priorities change, and ambiguity doesn't scare you. You learn fast, adapt quickly, and thrive when there's a lot to build.

  • Are curious about AI and excited about the opportunities this technology creates for enterprises. You don't need to be an expert, but you believe AI will fundamentally reshape how businesses operate.

What's not required

Previous experience in enterprise sales, business development, or SDR roles is not required.

We're much more interested in ambition, curiosity, communication skills, and execution than in having the perfect CV.

Why Join Lio?

Lio is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Silicon Valley's most prestigious investor. We're bringing that same ambition, speed, and culture to Munich. This is a unique opportunity to join a company with Silicon Valley DNA while building in Europe.

We work with Fortune 500 companies across Europe and the US, working with C-level procurement leaders on large-scale transformation initiatives. From your very first day, you'll be exposed to some of the most influential enterprises in the world and play a role in how AI gets adopted in the real world.

We move fast, iterate constantly, and care deeply about execution. There are no endless approval processes, no politics, and no waiting around for permission. People here own outcomes and continuously raise the bar.

Joining Lio today means joining early. The category is still being defined. The playbook is still being written. Everyone at Lio is expected to take ownership, move fast, and help shape not only the business, but also the culture we're building.

If you're excited about building something exceptional, working with world-class customers, and helping shape one of Europe's category defining AI companies, we'd love to hear from you.

Opportunities like this don't come around often. If you're looking for a comfortable 9-to-5, Lio is probably not for you. If you're excited about building something extraordinary, we'd love to talk.

Any questions about the role? Feel free to reach out to Cansel.

The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with a proven track record in SaaS sales, a deep understanding of the vacation rental or hospitality tech industry, and demonstrable experience leading multilingual, remote sales teams.

About the role

As the EMEA Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving revenue growth, coaching and developing a team of Account Executives, and refining our sales strategy to capture market share across the region. This is a fully remote position, however, we do require this individual to be based out of the UK with professional French language proficiency.

  • Performance Management: Set clear sales targets and KPIs. Conduct regular pipeline reviews, 1-on-1s, and coaching sessions to ensure the team meets and exceeds individual and collective goals.

  • Sales Strategy & Execution: Develop and implement a comprehensive sales strategy for the EMEA market, identifying key growth opportunities, target segments, and effective go-to-market tactics.

  • Pipeline & Revenue Growth: Take ownership of the EMEA sales pipeline from lead to close, ensuring predictable and consistent revenue growth.

  • Process Optimization: Continuously refine and improve sales processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, and Product teams to ensure alignment, provide market feedback, and contribute to the overall success of the company.

  • Market Expertise: Serve as an expert on the EMEA vacation rental market, staying informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and customer needs to inform sales strategy.

  • Forecasting & Reporting: Deliver accurate and timely sales forecasts, reports, and performance analysis to senior leadership.

  • Industry Experience: Proven experience in the vacation rental, property management, or hospitality technology (PropTech/HospiTech) industry is highly desirable.

  • EMEA Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the diverse business cultures, languages, and market dynamics across the EMEA region.

  • Remote Team Management: Demonstrated success in managing and motivating a fully remote, geographically distributed sales team.

  • Multilingual Abilities: Professional fluency in English and French is required for this role.

  • Tech Savvy: Proficient with modern sales tools, including CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), sales engagement platforms, and communication tools.

  • Data-Driven: Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to drive decisions, forecast accurately, and manage team performance.

What we offer

title: Sales Planning & Strategy
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

  • Business Strategy

    • Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan

    • Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

    • Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

  • Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

  • Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

  • Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense:

  • At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

  • Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence:

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

  • Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

  • Great written and oral structure and communication

  • Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

  • Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris or Barcelona area

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

  • Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

  • Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or Barcelona office

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Du hast bereits mehrere Jahre im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet und kennst den gesamten Sales-Zyklus von der Akquise bis zum Abschluss aus erster Hand.

Self-Confident.
Du glaubst an deine Fähigkeit, ein Gespräch zu führen und abzuschließen, ohne dabei arrogant zu wirken.

Self-Starter.
Du baust dir deine eigene Pipeline auf, statt auf eingehende Leads zu warten, und nutzt eine ruhige Woche, um noch aktiver zu prospektieren.

Coachable.
Du nimmst direktes Feedback an, ohne defensiv zu werden, und wendest es sichtbar im nächsten Gespräch an.

Resilient.
Du erholst dich schnell von einem verlorenen Deal oder einer schwierigen Woche und hältst deine Aktivität konstant hoch.

Fast Learner.
Du arbeitest dich schnell in ein technisches Produkt ein und kannst es Kund:innen verständlich erklären.

Structured.
Du hältst deine Pipeline sauber und deine CRM-Notizen zuverlässig, ohne dass man dir hinterherlaufen muss.

Strong communicator.
Du sprichst muttersprachliches Deutsch und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Who We Don’t Want

Relies on leads being handed over.
Du bist darauf angewiesen, dass Leads dir zugeteilt werden, und kannst oder willst nicht selbst aktiv Kund:innen akquirieren.

Gets defensive with feedback.
Du reagierst bei direktem Feedback defensiv, statt es anzunehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Weak written communication.
Du drückst dich schriftlich nicht klar und professionell aus.

In it for the paycheck alone.
Du jagst nur dem Gehalt hinterher und bringst kein echtes Interesse am Handwerk des Verkaufens mit.

Your Day To Day

Pipeline & Outbound (ca. 20%)

  • Neben eingehenden Leads baust du dir eigene Pipeline auf: Per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail sprichst du Unternehmen im DACH-Raum an, für die Superchat einen echten Unterschied macht
  • Du entscheidest mit, welche Branchen und Accounts sich lohnen, und findest heraus, welche Ansprache funktioniert

Discovery & Demos (ca. 60%)

  • Im Erstgespräch findest du heraus, wo es in der Kundenkommunikation hakt, zum Beispiel bei unbeantworteten WhatsApp-Nachrichten, überlasteten Teams oder verstreuten Kanälen
  • In der Demo zeigst du nicht jedes Feature, sondern genau das, was das Problem deines Gegenübers löst
  • Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführer:innen und Teamleads auf Augenhöhe und übersetzt das Produkt in konkreten Business-Mehrwert

Closing & Forecast (ca. 20%)

  • Du verhandelst, räumst Einwände aus und bringst deine Deals selbstständig zum Abschluss
  • Forecast, Deal-Stages und nächste Schritte pflegst du sauber in HubSpot, sodass du jederzeit weißt, wo deine Zahl steht
  • Was du in Kundengesprächen hörst, gibst du an Marketing und Produkt weiter

Stakeholders

Kund:innen: deine wichtigste Ansprechgruppe im täglichen Austausch - von der ersten Ansprache über Demos bis zum Abschluss
Sales Team: für gemeinsames Training, Knowledge-Sharing und den Austausch von Best Practices im Sales-Zyklus
Customer Success Team: für die Übergabe nach erfolgreichem Abschluss und einen reibungslosen Start ins Onboarding

Why People Choose Us

  • Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit vor Ort: Wir sind gerne gemeinsam im Berliner Office. Genau dort entstehen die besten Ideen, Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen. Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag
  • Wir sind ein internationales Team mit unterschiedlichsten kulturellen Hintergründen und Sprachen - Offenheit, gegenseitiger Respekt und der Austausch verschiedener Perspektiven prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit
  • Wir schätzen Ambition und Motivation - wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Initiative zeigen und Lust haben, sich schnell weiterzuentwickeln
  • Wir arbeiten mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer starken Lernmentalität - Fragen stellen, neugierig bleiben und sich kontinuierlich verbessern gehört bei uns dazu
  • Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - no Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel

Benefits & culture

  • Du hast die Wahl zwischen einer Urban Sports Club/John Reed Mitgliedschaft oder Fahrkarten/Dance-Abo
  • Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents
  • Jährliches Budget für persönliche Weiterbildung in Höhe von 500 € für zum Beispiel Konferenzen, Kurse, Bücher, Karrierecoach usw.
  • Eine integrative und aufregende Start-up-Kultur, die schnelles berufliches und persönliches Wachstum ermöglicht
  • Schönes Büro im Herzen von Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) mit kostenlosen Snacks, Getränken und bester Ausstattung

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Uns ist wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen wirklich gerne Zeit miteinander verbringen - egal ob beim HYROX-Training, Golfen, Beer-Pong-Turnieren, Running Clubs, Warhammer, gemeinsamen Wochenendaktivitäten oder welcher Community auch immer du hier aufbauen möchtest!

Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass Diversität Unternehmen besser macht. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerber:innen. Unabhängig von Gender, Herkunft, Nationalität oder Glaube. Fühl dich frei und schicke uns gerne deine Bewerbung!

Mit deiner Bewerbung stimmst du unseren Datenschutzrichtlinien zu.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! 🙂

title: Senior Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.

We’re seeking a Senior Account Manager to join our Sales team. The Senior Account Manager will report directly to the Assistant Director of Sales UK.

We’re Here For You - At Convene, you’ll receive:

Health and Wellness

  • Private medical insurance
  • Subsidised eye care
  • Subsidised fitness membership
  • Employee Assistance Program: well-being support and personal advice programme

Time Off and Work-Life Balance

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, and company sick pay
  • Financial Support and Benefits
  • Bonus scheme
  • Interest-free loan for rail season tickets & further education
  • Subsidised bicycle purchase through Cycle to Work scheme

Professional Development and Recognition

  • Continuous professional and personal development support
  • Employee recognition and reward programs to mark achievements and milestones

Community and Impact

  • Opportunities to volunteer, donate, and participate in community give-back initiatives
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact on your team and the business in the work that you do

What You’ll Do:

  • Consistently exceed revenue targets through strategic sales and account management efforts, aligning with broader commercial objectives.
  • Cultivate relationships in managed accounts, aiming to elevate them to the Regional/Enterprise level or identify opportunities for MSAs across the global portfolio.
  • Drive new revenue growth by capitalizing on opportunities in the experiential events market.
  • Serve as a go-to expert on Convene product offerings, including meetings and technology solutions, and translate product features into functional client solutions.
  • Maintain an engaging sales presence, both in person and virtually.
  • Demonstrate thorough knowledge of competitors, articulating the Convene story and differentiation.
  • Grow demand through strategic account development, expanding your network of contacts, and building long-term relationships.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Convene products and locations, contributing to local and regional brand building.
  • Understand the local, regional, and global business plan to ensure personal targets align with overall sales objectives.
  • Share market intelligence and industry trends with the Senior Leadership team.
  • Conduct and coordinate site inspections, virtual tours, client meetings, and quarterly business reviews for key accounts.
  • Discover and build relationships with new decision-makers, while nurturing current and prospective clients and referral partners.
  • Respond rapidly to client inquiries and maintain up-to-date account details for key accounts.
  • Negotiate and close agreements, adhering to internal pricing guidelines while ensuring client specifications are met.
  • Stay informed of competitive landscape and maintain relationships with industry counterparts.
  • Attend trade shows, networking sessions, and events to prospect for new business.
  • Exceed budgeted financial goals for both quarterly and annual targets.
  • Cultivate relationships with allocated key accounts through consultative sales efforts to achieve and surpass commercial goals.
  • Own and manage a portfolio of accounts based on location, volume, and spend.
  • Target and secure new business to increase market share across the global portfolio of brands and products.
  • Secure repeat business from allocated accounts, ensuring long-term client satisfaction and retention.

What We Look For:

  • 5+ years of experience in a commercial role within the UK meetings and events industry
  • Proven track record in selling to London’s corporate and agency markets
  • Knowledge of experiential events across business and consumer markets
  • Exceptional networking abilities and relationship-building sales skills
  • Capable of working independently while thriving in a team-oriented environment

title: (Senior) Account Manager - Nachhaltigkeit
descriptionHtml:
No previous experience in the sustainability space? Don't worry, we are happy to help you grow into an expert and thought leader at Root! This role requires presence in our Berlin office and both German and English language skills.

 

🌎 What we do

We build software that helps companies along the food system get to Net Zero.

~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met. Enterprise software and new business processes can help.

We raised >€10m in funding, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early stage tech team in Europe. Will you be the next to join us? 🚀

  

🔭 What you will work on

Your mission

Drive customer success as a trusted advisor and account manager for our enterprise customers. Own a portfolio end-to-end from onboarding and tool adoption through retention and ARR growth, co-developing new value propositions and building the trust-based relationships that turn customers into advocates. 

Over the next 12 months you will:

  1. Grow annual contract values of existing enterprise customers

    • Translate our impact into tangible business value for economic buyers.

    • Lead renewal negotiations and drive upsell opportunities with existing customers.

    • Expand our reach within global enterprises across new regions, teams, and decision-makers.

  2. Support customers' progress along their climate journey

    • Build and nurture strong relationships with clients as their trusted climate advisor and single point of contact, coordinating internal expertise to deliver clear, actionable guidance on sustainability topics

    • Represent the customer voice and needs internally to provide input for product development.

    • Educate users and guide them toward measurable progress on their Net Zero journey.

  3. Boost farm-level data collection via the RootOS platform

    • Onboard sustainability managers, farm technicians, and farmers to the platform and guide their data collection efforts.

    • Ensure high data integrity, partner with trusted farm-level data sources, and meet data coverage targets.

    • Collect, consolidate, and prioritize product feedback.

 

🚀 You might be really good for this role if you

  • Have 3+ years of experience in customer-facing roles (ideally B2B SaaS, consulting, or startup/scale-up environments) where you built and nurtured strong client relationships end-to-end

  • Are hands-on, reliable, and detail-oriented. You thrive in fast-changing, early-stage environments, juggle multiple priorities, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

  • Are people-centric and proactive. Empathetic, approachable, and able to communicate clearly while keeping customer outcomes and business priorities aligned

  • Speak excellent German (C2) and English (C1+)

     

You don't feel like you fulfill all the criteria? We get it: confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But guess what?! There is no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. The only thing you need to ensure along the recruiting process and beyond is that the problem that we are solving with Root is one you cannot wait to get out of bed for on Monday morning! 🤗

  

🦾 How we support you

  • You will work closely with Alina, our Account Management leader.

  • You will collaborate as part of a cross-disciplinary team that brings together sales and account managers, product experts and customer success specialists

  • We believe in the power of technology. We use best-in-class tools, software and AI solutions (Hubspot, Gong, Claude, Slack, Google Workspace, Notion)

  

🎢 Hiring Process

Our ambition is to offer you an end-to-end experience that is fast and uncomplicated - we aim to keep the end-to-end process to 10 working days. We send you prep material for each step and maximise transparency at every step.

Root Global is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Accountant (All genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You will join our Finance & Accounting team based in Berlin, playing a pivotal role in ensuring financial integrity, compliance, and strategic financial operations. Working closely with cross-functional teams and senior leadership, you will contribute directly to supporting Stark's hyper-growth and mission-critical defense technology initiatives.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Accountant, you will oversee end-to-end accounting operations, statutory reporting, and financial compliance across our operations. You will drive process improvements, maintain precise financial records, and provide key financial insights to empower data-driven strategic decisions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Manage and execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities in accordance with HGB and IFRS standards.
  • Prepare financial statements, tax filings, and regulatory compliance reports accurately and on schedule.
  • Oversee general ledger accounting, accounts payable/receivable, and bank reconciliations.
  • Lead internal and external audit coordination, acting as the primary point of contact for auditors.
  • Optimize internal controls, accounting workflows, and financial systems to support scalable company growth.
  • Collaborate with Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to align accounting outputs with budgeting and forecasting models.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in accounting or auditing, preferably within a fast-growing tech or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong expertise in HGB accounting principles; thorough familiarity with IFRS is highly desirable.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field (CPA/Steuerberater qualification is a plus).
  • Proficiency with modern ERP systems (e.g., DATEV, SAP, NetSuite) and advanced Excel financial modeling skills.
  • Fluent professional proficiency in both English and German.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Prior exposure to defense, aerospace, or industrial technology sectors.
  • Experience handling government grants, public funding, or defense procurement regulations.
  • Familiarity with automated accounting workflows and digitized invoice processing tools.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Adobe Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
Senior Adobe Project Manager
London, hybrid
6 month FTC

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

The Project Manager will work directly with customers to initiate and lead their digital marketing and transformation projects using the Adobe Marketing and Commerce Solutions.

Working at multiple levels with the customer, you will evaluate the proposed solution, assess risks, confirm requirements, manage scope, and work on team staffing. You will coordinate and lead all aspects of project delivery from initiation through planning, delivering, monitoring to closing.

Aid customers in improving Adobe solutions by understanding their challenges and crafting innovative, measurable solutions.  

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead teams in scoping activities to identify, gather and analyze requirements, define key business drivers and define an effective and innovative solution
  • Management of end-to-end project life cycle: effort estimation, scope management, planning, monitoring and execution (including risks management, budget, timeline and others) and related reporting
  • Management of project resourcing and commercials including forecasting, time management and invoicing
  • Project communication to client and/or partner and internally
  • Accountable for ensuring projects are delivered to quality standards
  • Customer focus and results driven - help customer to succeed in their digital transformation journey by providing mentorship, industry leading practices and advice on Adobe Marketing and Commerce Solutions
  • Active participation in PMO practice development

WHAT YOU’ll BRING

  • Strong foundational project management skills delivering digital marketing implementation projects for a software vendor (or mixed vendor / customer background)
  • Demonstrated project management experience with experience in Digital Marketing & Automation, Campaign or Content Management solutions
  • Experience in implementing Adobe solutions: AEM, AEP, and ideally other solutions like Campaign, Commerce
  • Ability to handle large single projects or multiple concurrent smaller projects
  • Outstanding at problem-solving, with expertise in risk management, prioritization, and delivering presentations up to the Executive level within an organization
  • Experience in delivering projects using an agile methodology, e.g. SCRUM
  • A professional project management qualification & business consulting background
  • Minimum of 6 years project management experience in the industry
  • Ability to work with virtual internal teams across geographies and time zones & full fluency in English. Other European languages is a plus.

WE OFFER:

  • A flexible, hybrid working policy (2 days from the office, depending on location).
  • An excellent salary based on experience and equal pay policies
  • Pension, free private healthcare, mental health support, and company sick pay scheme.
  • 26 days paid holiday (plus UK Bank Holidays).
  • Help getting you to work with a season ticket loan and cycle to work scheme.
  • Enhanced family friendly policies to support new parents.
  • Social and Cultural Events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.
  • Inspirational Talks, bringing the outside in with regular guest speakers and events.
  • Learning and Development, supporting your growth with continuous opportunities to learn and advance.
  • Buddy Programme: You will be paired with a ‘Buddy’ to help you through your first weeks’ at DEPT®.
  • A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
  • Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
  • The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
  • Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION 

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

title: (Senior) AI Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Experten, die sich miteinander vernetzen, um als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen voranzutreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet dir die Türen zu anspruchsvollen Digitalisierungsprojekten mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum. Bei cbs arbeitest du in einem starken Team, übernimmst schnell Verantwortung und entwickelst dich fachlich wie persönlich weiter.

Als (Senior) AI Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst du KI-gestützte Automatisierungslösungen, die produktiv in den Geschäftsprozessen unserer Kunden laufen und ihnen einen messbaren Wettbewerbsvorteil verschaffen - von der intelligenten Dokumentenverarbeitung bis hin zu agentischen Systemen, die eigenständig Prozessschritte übernehmen. Deine technologische Basis ist die SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) / Business AI Platform in Kombination weiterer Cloud- und KI-Plattformen unserer Kunden. Das SAP-Zielsystem (S/4HANA oder ECC) musst du dafür noch nicht im Detail kennen - die nötige Tiefe bauen wir gemeinsam mit dir auf.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Du konzipierst und entwickelst KI-Lösungen, die manuelle Arbeit in Geschäftsprozessen gezielt automatisieren, und integrierst sie über SAP- und Non-SAP-APIs in die bestehende Systemlandschaft.

  • Du entwickelst mit Python (z. B. FastAPI, LangGraph) und Node.js/TypeScript (u. a. SAP CAP) und bewegst dich souverän in der jeweiligen Kundenlandschaft, ob SAP BTP, Hyperscaler oder spezialisierte KI-Plattformen, deren Rahmenbedingungen du bei der Architektur berücksichtigst und mitgestaltest.

  • Du verantwortest deine Lösungen von der Anforderungsaufnahme bis zum Go-Live, einschließlich Evaluierung, Monitoring und Weiterentwicklung im Betrieb.

  • Du leitest Kunden-Workshops, präsentierst Ergebnisse und vertrittst deine Architekturentscheidungen überzeugend gegenüber unseren Kunden.

  • Du bringst dich aktiv in unser Business-AI-Team ein und gestaltest unsere Methoden, Frameworks und internen Produkte mit.


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse, insbesondere im Umfeld von LLM-Anbindung und Orchestrierung, sowie Erfahrung mit Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript) und ein gutes Verständnis verteilter Anwendungen.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit generativer KI aus Projekten, Forschung oder eigenen Vorhaben. Themen wie Tool Calling, Kontext-Management, strukturierte Ausgaben und Evaluierung sind dir aus der Anwendung vertraut, und du verstehst, wie sich daraus agentische Lösungen aufbauen lassen.

  • Die Fähigkeit, dich in einem dynamischen Technologiefeld sicher zu bewegen: Du entwickelst eigenständig tragfähige Lösungsansätze, wo etablierte Muster fehlen, bewertest neue Werkzeuge kritisch und teilst deine Erkenntnisse im Team.

  • Ein technisches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit nachweisbarer Praxiserfahrung.

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
descriptionHtml:
This role is also open to candidates living in the EU or EEA. We can't consider applications from other locations.

If you've built something before, start here

Most ML jobs hand you a benchmark. This one hands you a business problem with paying customers and their real data. Construction tenders are long, messy and full of trade jargon, and every decision a customer makes on our platform becomes a labeled example you can train on.

We need someone who can turn that data into models that customers notice: from the first experiment to the model serving production traffic, and back again when a customer says it got something wrong. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first ML engineer somewhere, or shipped a model people paid for, this role was written for you.

About Scalera

Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Manufacturers, wholesalers and suppliers in Switzerland, Austria and Germany still run their most document-heavy work by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate that work one process at a time, and ML sits at the center of every one of them.

What you'll own

You'll own the ML behind our products, end to end. In practice that means:

  • Training and fine-tuning: embedding models, rerankers, classifiers and LLMs, trained on our own data.

  • Document understanding: models that pull structure, quantities and product specs out of tenders, orders and catalogs.

  • Product matching: retrieval and LLM agents that match tender positions to the right products.

  • Evaluation: offline benchmarks, per-customer evals and gates that keep a new model from shipping if it makes things worse.

  • Training and serving infrastructure: automated retrain pipelines, GPU serving and vector search in production.

  • Customer problems: when a model gets something wrong for a customer, finding out why and fixing it.

What success looks like after 3 months

  • There's a model or part of the pipeline people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next.

  • You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version.

  • A model you trained runs in production, and customers can see the difference in their results.

  • Retraining runs automatically, and nothing reaches customers without passing an eval you designed.

  • You've cut LLM cost or latency by replacing an expensive step with a smaller model of your own.

  • You've decided at least one thing we should stop building.

You'll probably thrive here if

  • You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a model in production, or a side project with real users.

  • You've trained and fine-tuned models yourself, ideally embeddings, retrieval or document models, and evaluated them honestly on held-out data.

  • You've built with LLMs in production and know where agents fail.

  • You write strong Python and can run what you build: Docker, CI/CD, and cloud on GCP, AWS or Azure.

  • You measure before you believe, and a single aggregate score doesn't convince you.

  • You'd rather open a customer's actual document than wait for a spec.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is.

  • You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title.

  • Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going.

  • You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls.

  • You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement.

You probably won't enjoy it if

  • You just want to code and go home.

  • You don't like talking to customers.

  • Ambiguity and chaos bother you.

  • You want a well-defined research agenda handed to you.

  • You'd rather hand a model to someone else to deploy and debug.

  • Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount.

Our stack

Python and PyTorch, open-weight and frontier LLMs, LangGraph, Langfuse, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Pinecone, and GCP. You don't need to know all of it on day one.

How we hire

  1. Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions.

  2. Technical deep-dive call: walk us through a model or system you built, the decisions you made and what went wrong in production.

  3. Meet Scalera Day: come to our office in Zürich, work on a real problem with real (anonymized) tender data, and meet the team.

  4. Offer: if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer.

Working at Scalera

  • Zürich HQ, four days in the office, Fridays remote. If not located in Zürich then this role is open to remote within the EU or EEA,

  • Occasional customer visits across Switzerland, Austria and Germany

  • Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity

Founders and former founders: if you're unsure whether you fit, send a few lines about what you built and why you moved on. We read every one.
