title: Senior AI Specialist (Operations) (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Doctolib is looking for you to join us as a Senior AI Specialist (x/f/m) at our Berlin location, starting as soon as possible.

Doctolib is becoming an AI-native company. We are redesigning the way we work, workflow by workflow, and are looking for people who will not only support this transformation, but actively build it. As a Senior AI Specialist, you will be the technical builder and AI Ops Owner behind AI-powered productivity for our Operations and Customer Success teams.

 

You will work in founder and product mode: you will own a workflow end to end, from context and agent design to evaluation, and continuously take it to a higher level of automation. Our ambition is to move away from manual case-by-case work towards workflows that run largely autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar. In this way, you will contribute directly to our mission of improving healthcare for everyone.

Your Responsibilities

  • Redesign workflows rather than simply automating them: You analyze the most critical Operations and Customer Success workflows, break down time-consuming processes that require limited judgment, and transform them through the use of AI agents. You set clear objectives for autonomy and quality, and continuously develop them further.

  • Build and operate AI agents as products: You develop and manage agents on platforms such as Dust or Claude. Each agent is deployed to production with a defined baseline and relevant metrics such as benefit, usage, and scalability.

  • Knowledge and context management: You deliberately curate the context agents need, from templates to core data. The guiding principle is quality over quantity. You ensure that knowledge sources in Confluence, Drive, or Salesforce are always up to date and well structured.

  • Evaluation and quality assurance: You define quality standards and establish evaluation routines to identify and address weaknesses such as hallucinations or prompt drift at an early stage. You continuously optimize prompts through systematic user feedback and A/B testing.

  • CRM and data integration: You own the interfaces between CRM systems such as Salesforce and our AI platforms. You automate data flows and work closely with IT to unlock new, valuable data sources for our agents.

  • Central interface and enablement: You translate business requirements into technical solutions and bring together stakeholders from Leadership, IT, and Product. You strengthen the team’s AI fluency in the areas of context, agent management, and evaluation.

  • Impact and measurement: Rather than inventing new KPIs, you make the success of AI measurable using existing metrics such as time, quality, and cost, and use these insights to guide the next steps in scaling.

Your Profile

Since production-ready AI workflows and agent technologies are still relatively new, years of market experience are rare. We therefore deliberately prioritize potential over years of experience alone. What matters to us is your ability to learn quickly, your strong product mindset, and your judgment. If you are passionate about this field and bring the necessary skills, we would be delighted to hear from you, even if your profile does not perfectly cover every single aspect.

What Really Matters to Us, Regardless of the Specific Tool:

  • Learning speed and a production mindset: You have taught yourself a new technical field from scratch and built something real that people actually used. You can describe precisely what went wrong, such as hallucinations, prompt drift, outdated data, or costs, and how you solved it.

  • An instinct for evaluation: You do not rely on something merely “looking good”. You define a quality bar and measure against it. For you, automation and quality go hand in hand.

  • Ownership and communication: You take ownership of a problem end to end, prioritize rigorously, feel comfortable with ambiguity, and make technical topics understandable to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Technical and data understanding: You can read and adapt scripts, understand APIs, webhooks, and automation tools such as Make, n8n, and Zapier, and know how CRM data, ideally Salesforce data, flows into AI systems.

  • Strong communication skills: You have a confident command of English and can operate at the highest level in our international environment. German at B1 level is sufficient.

We Are Particularly Interested in:

  • Expertise with agent platforms: You have practical experience with systems such as Dust, Claude, or LangChain. Since tools evolve quickly, we primarily rely on your process understanding and evaluation skills as a sustainable foundation.

  • Technical depth and data fluency: You are proficient in languages such as Python or JavaScript and can confidently navigate Salesforce architectures or BI environments such as Tableau and Metabase to manage data flows effectively.

  • Operations experience: You have solid experience working with scaled Customer Success or Operations teams and understand their specific dynamics.

What We Offer

  • A Germany-wide public transport pass sponsored by Doctolib if you work from the office or in hybrid mode

  • Company-sponsored health insurance with excellent additional benefits

  • 28 days of paid vacation, plus one additional day for every full calendar year of employment, up to a maximum of 30 days

  • Participation in Doctolib’s long-term employee equity program, DoctoGrowth

  • The opportunity to work from abroad for up to 10 days per year

  • An occupational pension scheme with an employer contribution of 40%, or 15% during the probationary period

  • The Doctolib Parent Care Program, which includes one additional month of parental leave and much more

  • Free mental health and coaching sessions through an external partner

  • In addition to healthy snacks and a regular breakfast buffet, we offer meal vouchers

  • A subsidized sports program with our partner Urban Sports Club

  • For caregivers and employees with disabilities, we offer support that includes more flexible working hours, additional leave for medical reasons, and psychological support

The Interview Process

  • Interview with Talent

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • On-site case study

  • Final interview with VP

  • Reference checks

  • Offer

Job Details

  • Permanent position

  • Full-time

  • Location: Berlin

  • Start date: July

  • Hybrid, 2 days working from home per week

Our vision is to improve the health of everyone. This is also reflected in our recruitment process. We evaluate applications exclusively on the basis of qualifications and motivation. We do not tolerate discrimination.

The more diverse our team and ideas are, the more our product can contribute to improving the health of our users. That is why we invite you to apply, regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnic origin, or disability.

 

To ensure equal opportunities, you may omit information such as photos, age, and similar details from your application. Please let us know what accommodations we can make to support you in the best possible way.

We look forward to digitalizing healthcare together with you!

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward senior engineers to be part of our early team at Resonance in Berlin. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer in Berlin, you’ll lead Resonance’s most ambitious client engagements across DACH. You will design and build production AI systems to drive a dramatic acceleration in productivity or a step change in growth for our key clients. You will work at the AI frontier, own end-to-end deployments, and lead a team of AI engineers to build at pace. You’ll set the technical direction, advising CTOs and engineering leads of leading enterprises and owning security, reliability and governance for everything we put into production. You’ll lead the build from first prototype to production while staying hands-on in the code, working across the stack from data pipelines and the AI layer to the client’s core systems, and setting the bar for code quality, evals and observability. You’ll grow the firm by building Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, turning patterns from client work into reusable components, and coaching the engineers on your team as one of our first technical leaders in Berlin.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency and a bias for action, thrive on ambiguity, and are AI-obsessed, getting hands-on with new models and tools the day they hit the market. You typically have 5+ years building software, including technical lead or architect responsibility for a production AI system. You might be a senior, staff or principal engineer at an AI-first company or scale-up, a lead forward deployed engineer, a technical lead at an AI consultancy or an AI lab’s applied team, or the founder of your own company. You write production Python or TypeScript, have designed and shipped LLM systems in production, including agents, retrieval and evals, and design for how they fail. Using market intelligence, targeted research and AI-enabled tools, you will identify where Ensono can add the greatest value, develop compelling account and pursuit strategies, and create actionable business development initiatives that bring our full portfolio of capabilities to the UK market.

Working closely with senior sales leaders, sales and wider go-to-market teams, you will help shape opportunities from initial prospect identification through to proposition and pursuit development. You will bring strong commercial judgement, curiosity and creativity, using client and market insight to turn potential opportunities into meaningful business conversations.

The ideal candidate will be an accomplished business development professional with a strong track record of creating new opportunities and engaging senior stakeholders. You will be confident using AI and data to sharpen prospecting and account strategies, an excellent communicator, and a collaborative self-starter with the energy and commercial focus to help Ensono win new clients and deliver sustainable growth.

How Your Success Will Be Measured and Rewarded

At Ensono, we want great business development to deliver great outcomes and be recognised accordingly. Success in this role will be measured through the number and quality of leads you generate, the new-logo opportunities and pipeline you create, and your contribution to converting those opportunities into sustainable growth. You'll have clear lead-generation and pipeline objectives, with strong performance recognised and rewarded through Ensono's incentive arrangements, eligibility for Presidents Club nomination, and recognition via the global Elevate recognition platform.

Role & Responsibilities:

Lead Generation & New Logo Pipeline Development: Proactively generate and qualify leads within organisations aligned to Ensono’s Ideal Client Profile (ICP), using targeted, multi-channel outreach to build a high-quality pipeline of net-new logo opportunities.

Target Account Prospecting: Develop and execute focused prospecting plans across priority accounts, identifying key decisionmakers, buying signals and relevant entry points for Ensono.

Partner with New Logo Sellers: Work closely with New Logo Sales to identify, engage and qualify prospective clients, providing insight and account intelligence that helps open doors and progress opportunities.

Market Intelligence & Whitespace Identification: Conduct targeted research across industries, markets and competitors to identify whitespace, emerging client needs and new opportunities for Ensono.

AI-Enabled Business Development: Use AI extensively to enhance prospect research, identify buying signals, personalise outreach, develop account strategies and increase the effectiveness and scale of lead-generation activity.

Target Account Management: Own and continually refine Target Account Lists (TALs), prioritising activity based on market intelligence, engagement data, seller input and opportunity potential.

Client Engagement & Relationship Building: Build relationships with key decision-makers and influencers, creating relevant conversations that connect client priorities with Ensono’s capabilities.

Lead Qualification & Opportunity Development: Qualify prospective opportunities and work with sellers to move strong leads through the early stages of the sales cycle, ensuring effective handover and continued momentum.

Propositions & Pitches: Contribute insight and research to tailored propositions, pitches and pursuit activity that demonstrate Ensono’s value and differentiation.

Go-to-Market Collaboration: Work across Sales, Marketing, Alliances and solution teams to coordinate campaigns, account-based activity and market initiatives that generate demand and create new opportunities.

Sales Effectiveness & Conversion: Analyse outreach, engagement and conversion data to continuously improve targeting, messaging, prospecting methods and lead quality.

CRM & Pipeline Discipline: Maintain accurate CRM data and account intelligence, providing clear visibility of prospecting activity, lead progression and pipeline development.

Performance & Impact: Deliver against defined lead-generation and pipeline objectives, measuring success through qualified leads, opportunities created, pipeline progression and contribution to new-logo growth.

What you will being to Ensono

  • Minimum of 8+ years of experience in business development, new logo acquisition, sales, or sales support within the IT/managed services industry.
  • Track record of supporting successful client acquisition and building net-new pipeline.
  • Experience analysing sales performance and market data to inform BD strategy and improve conversion.
  • Ability to translate research and market intelligence into actionable go-to-market plays.
  • Experience supporting partnership development and structured pursuit cycles.
  • Strong understanding of managed services, cloud solutions, and IT infrastructure.
  • Exceptional communication, proposal creation, and stakeholder-engagement skills.
  • Ability to manage CRM hygiene and support process improvements to accelerate BD effectiveness.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to identify whitespace opportunities and influence decision-making.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to operate independently and collaboratively in a fast-moving environment.
  • Willingness to travel when needed for client and stakeholder engagement.

What we can offer you:

We are a people-first business, people are at the heart of everything we do here. We offer our associates a safe environment where learning, knowledge sharing, and open communication is encouraged. Whether at one of the internal social events, competency meet-ups, hackathons or as part of one or more of our global Community Groups, such as Beautiful Brains (for the neurodiverse and curious), HERO (helping to education regarding orientation), E-Vets (Ensono veteran community) and many more, we strive to ensure that everyone feels welcome, included, and valued. title: Senior C++ Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

 

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer I
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Every payment we process runs on infrastructure we built. At Checkout.com, the Cloud Platform team owns the cloud foundations that global payments depend on: a large multi-account AWS estate, a growing Azure platform, and the networking and connectivity that reaches card schemes and banks worldwide. We are genuinely multi-cloud, and we are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer who is too - a strong generalist who treats infrastructure as a software problem and can deliver from week one.

This is a hands-on senior role in an established, fast-moving team. Everything we run is defined in code, deployed through pipelines, and reviewed like software. You will bring deep cloud expertise across AWS and Azure and pair it with a genuine software engineering mindset: you write Terraform modules others build on, you automate away toil rather than documenting it, and you treat the platform as a product with users, SLOs, and a roadmap.

As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you are responsible for the technical delivery of your team's services. You will work closely with your Engineering Manager to shape direction, manage dependencies across pillars, and ensure our platform meets the standards a regulated payments business demands.

What we are looking for:

Deep AWS expertise: Advanced, hands-on experience designing and operating production infrastructure in AWS at enterprise scale: multi-account architectures (Control Tower, Organizations, SCPs), IAM, KMS, and the core compute, storage, and security services that a large regulated estate runs on. You should have a proven track record of delivering resilient, multi-region architectures.

Azure experience: Real production experience with Azure alongside AWS: landing zones, VNet architectures, Entra ID, and the Azure resource and governance model. You understand where the two clouds differ and can design well for both rather than forcing one cloud's patterns onto the other.

Software engineering mindset: You treat infrastructure as software. Expert-level Terraform: reusable modules, secure state management, and disciplined code review. You are comfortable in a Git-based workflow with CI/CD (we use Spacelift), and you reach for Python or similar to automate what others would handle with a runbook. No ClickOps.

Strong cloud networking: Confident designing and debugging in a complex network estate: VPC and VNet design, hub-and-spoke and Transit Gateway or Cloud WAN architectures, DNS, private connectivity (PrivateLink, Private Link), and enough routing knowledge to own connectivity issues end to end rather than escalate them.

Kubernetes: Solid experience running containerised workloads in production, ideally on EKS/AKS: cluster lifecycle, workload deployment patterns, and the operational realities of keeping Kubernetes healthy at scale.

Security and compliance awareness: Experience operating in regulated environments. You understand why change control, least privilege, and auditability matter, and you design controls in rather than bolting them on. Familiarity with PCI DSS is a strong plus.

Engineering excellence: A focus on observability and measurement: you instrument what you build and answer operational questions with data rather than opinion.

Leadership and mentorship: A natural ability to guide and mentor peers, translate ambiguous problem definitions into actionable technical plans, and raise the bar through your code and your reviews.

Pragmatic problem solver: You understand when to move fast (creating tech debt) and when to move right (paying it off). You are a cornerstone in incident resolution and root-cause analysis.

Experience: 5+ years in cloud engineering roles with significant AWS depth. We need someone who can hit the ground running: comfortable joining a complex, established estate and delivering meaningful work in their first weeks, not their first quarter. A degree in Computer Science or a related field is useful but not required; we care about what you can build.

How you’ll make an impact:

Lead Design & Delivery: Take ownership of large-scale platform projects end to end, from architecture through Terraform to production, ensuring they are scalable, secure, and cost-optimised.

Build the paved road: Design the platform primitives that every product team at Checkout.com builds on, so that the secure path is also the easy path.

Architectural Influence: Work with Engineering Managers and architects to refine requirements and shape the technical direction of the platform, documenting significant decisions as ADRs.

Operational SME: Act as the Subject Matter Expert for numerous team-owned services, providing advanced operational support and ensuring high availability for our global payment systems.

Evangelise Best Practices: Produce exemplary code and documentation that inspires others. You will be responsible for spreading best practices and standards across your group.

Manage Dependencies: Navigate the organisation to manage technical dependencies inside and outside your pillar, optimising for both delivery speed and business outcomes.

Foster Culture: Embody Checkout Operating Principles, using them to shape the group’s culture and acting as an example of efficiency and professional excellence.

AI Integration: Proactively explore and implement AI-driven automation to enhance infrastructure efficiency and team productivity.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Senior Commercial Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About us

Every large industrial company is trying to make better decisions with the data it already owns. Most hit the same wall. Strategy lives in one system, sales in another, the market model in a consultant's spreadsheet, and the plan in a deck nobody has opened since the offsite. By the time a regional head knows a segment has moved, the quarter is gone. The data exists. It just never arrives anywhere a decision is being made.

STRATOS was built to solve this problem. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data.

STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup funded extensively by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by nearly a dozen global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.

The role. As a Senior Commercial Product Manager, you own a portfolio of our most important customers. You are responsible for the success of each deployment, for the value it creates for the customer, and for growing the relationship from initial pilot to organisation-wide rollout. You work directly with their C-suite and sales leadership to understand their business model, their commercial priorities, and where untapped growth potential lies across their markets, segments and accounts.

You translate those priorities into what STRATOS delivers. You define what the solution needs to do, work with our engineers to make sure it gets built right, and bring the results back to the customer's decision-makers. You bridge two worlds: the customer's commercial reality and our product.

Your responsibility doesn't end at go-live. You stay at the customer's side as they put the solution to work: challenging their thinking, helping them act on what the data shows, and making sure the impact is visible in their results.

This role suits someone who wants to own outcomes rather than just recommend them. Beyond your own accounts, you help shape the direction of STRATOS – what we build, how we deploy it and how we grow.

The roles you'll play

  • Trusted advisor to the C-suite — work directly with executive teams and sales leadership on where to play, how to win, and how to organise and steer a sales force. You are the person they call before they decide, not after.

  • Owner of the customer, end to end — from first pilot to multi-country rollout, the deployment, the relationship and the results are yours. Our engineers build it; you decide what gets built and you stand behind whether it worked.

  • Commercial owner of your portfolio — you are responsible for its growth: expansion into new use cases and new markets, and the judgement of when a customer is ready for more and when they are not.

  • Product manager for your market — you translate what you see across your customers into our roadmap, define what gets built, and own it with engineering through to release.

  • Builder of the function — you shape how STRATOS deploys and scales: the standards, the tooling and the people. Senior CPMs coach the CPMs around them.

Who this is for. We hire for commercial judgement and the credibility to hold a room of executives. That does not come from one background, and we are open about where yours comes from.

What we're actually looking for:

  • You have owned a complex piece of work end to end — scoping it, aligning stakeholders who disagreed, delivering it, and being accountable for whether it worked. We're interested in people who ran the engagement, not only staffed it.

  • You can hold your own with a commercial director who has run their business for twenty years and change their mind with evidence rather than seniority.

  • You do your own analysis. You are comfortable in the data, and you'd rather check the number yourself than take it from a slide.

  • You can explain something complicated to someone non-technical without making them feel stupid.

  • You are genuinely interested in how industrial businesses make money — pricing, channels, sales coverage, market structure.

  • You want to be somewhere your decisions are visible. At our size, the roadmap changes because of what you bring back.

This is probably not for you if you want a defined remit, a stable set of processes, or a role where strategy and delivery are separate jobs.

What we offer

  • Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company

  • A highly competitive salary

  • Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for

  • Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum

  • Private healthcare

  • Pension scheme

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays

  • Work from abroad — up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time

  • Hybrid office policy, with visa sponsorship available

  • A company committed to social and environmental responsibility — we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes

Practicalities

  • London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office

  • Travel to some customer sites roughly, mostly within Europe

  • German is useful and several of our customers are German-speaking, but it is not required

The process

  1. First round with our Talent Lead - 30 minutes

  1. Technical case interview - 45 minutes

  1. Hiring manager interview with a senior executive - 30 minutes

  1. Second senior executive interview, which may include a case exercise - 30 minutes

  1. Final stage with our CEO - 45 minutes

title: (Senior) Consultant Customer Engagement D365
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij als Senior Consultant D365 CE klaar om jouw carrière naar het volgende niveau te tillen bij HSO, één van de grootste Microsoft Gold Partners ter wereld? Sluit je aan bij ons CE team en maak het verschil!

Join the journey


Wat ga je doen?

  • Als D365 CE Senior Consultant werk je aan uitdagende projecten voor nationale en internationale klanten in diverse sectoren. Je speelt een cruciale rol in het adviseren, ontwerpen en implementeren van Dynamics 365 CE oplossingen die klanten helpen hun bedrijfsprocessen te optimaliseren en klantrelaties te verbeteren. Je werkt nauw samen met interne teams, projectmanager en stakeholders bij de klant om oplossingen te leveren die voldoen aan de specifieke zakelijke behoeften van elke klant. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:
  • Adviesrol: in nauwe samenwerking met de klant analyseer je bedrijfsprocessen en adviseer je over de beste Dynamics 365 CE oplossingen om klantdoelen te bereiken.
  • Implementatie: je geeft leiding aan, en bent functioneel eindverantwoordelijk voor, de implementatie van Dynamics 365 CE inclusief configuratie, aanpassing en integratie met andere systemen.
  • Projectmanagement: je werkt samen met projectmanagers om de scope, planning en kwaliteit van projecten te bewaken.
  • Klantcontact: jij fungeert als sparringpartner voor klanten. Je begrijpt de klantbehoeftes en vertaalt deze naar oplossingen. Je bent op de hoogte van de laatste AI ontwikkelingen en AI functies binnen D365 en zet deze in om klanten te helpen slimmer te werken, betere inzichten te krijgen en klantrelaties op een meer gepersonaliseerde manier te beheren.
  • Teamontwikkeling: jij coacht Junior en Medior Consultants binnen het Dynamics-team en bevordert kennisdeling. Je zet je in op een professionele samenwerking met je collega’s.
  • Op de hoogte blijven: jij volgt actief de technologische trends en innovaties binnen het Microsoft ecosysteem en vertaalt deze naar verbeteringen voor onze klanten.


Over het team
Jij komt in een toegewijd team van bijna 100 CE professionals die elkaar waarderen en ondersteunen. HSO is Microsoft Gold Partner en behoort tot de top 2 van de wereld op het gebied van Dynamics 365 implementaties. De serviceline biedt op maat gemaakte oplossingen die organisaties transformeren en helpen hun digitale ambities waar te maken. Als pionier in de industie, met een focus op innovatie, klantgerichtheid en duurzame groei, is het de ideale plek voor CE professionals die hun carrière willen versnellen. Om jouw kennis te verbreden zijn er maandelijks team meetings, expertsessies en is er alle ruimte voor het volgen van trainingen, conferenties en workshops. 

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring ervaring met Dynamics 365 CE implementaties, bij voorkeur in een consultancy-omgeving;
  • Kennis: diepgaande kennis van Dynamics 365 CE modules zoals Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Project Operations en Marketing;
  • Technische vaardigheden: ervaring met Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps), Azure en integraties met derde partijen;
  • Projectervaring: ervaring met zowel agile als watervalprojectmethodologieën;
  • Communicatie: uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
  • Leiderschap: ervaring in het aansturen en coachen van teams en het fungeren als trusted advisor voor klanten.

Voldoe je niet aan bovenstaand profiel en heb je nog geen Dynamics 365 ervaring maar heb je wel proceskennis en ben je in staat om als sparringpartner te fungeren omdat je de uitdagingen waar onze klanten mee worstelen van dichtbij, aan bijvoorbeeld de klantkant, hebt meegemaakt. Twijfel dan niet en solliciteer!

Wat bieden we jou?    
Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;  
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten; 
  • 25 Vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;  
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;  
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;  
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.   


Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  
Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden. 

Over HSO   
HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  

HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.

Benefits

Was du davon hast:

  • Umsatzbeteiligung auf deine Bestandskunden – vertraglich geregelt, ohne Politik
  • Direkter Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – du gestaltest den Enterprise-Bereich mit, statt ihn nur auszuführen

  • Kein Up-or-out – dein Wert bemisst sich an Ergebnissen, nicht an Politik oder Tenure
  • Attraktives Fixum plus Beteiligungsmodell

  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Hamburgs, MacBook & iPhone
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Gründern statt anonymer Konzernstruktur

Wen wir wirklich suchen

Du kommst aus der Top-Beratung und willst nicht mehr für die Marke eines anderen liefern. Du willst eigene Mandate, echte Beteiligung und Entscheidungen, die auch wirklich deine sind.

Wenn du lieber baust als verwaltest und lieber mit einem kleinen Team etwas Großes aufziehst, als in einem großen Team ein kleines Rädchen zu sein – dann bist du hier richtig.

title: Senior Content Creator (Mensch)
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Wir bei T&P verstehen uns als datengetriebene Kommunikationsagentur, deren Mission es ist, Kreativität, Technologie und Daten auf neue, aufregende und effektive Weise zu verknüpfen. Wir nennen es das &Modell und die Prämisse ist einfach: Kreation, Strategie, Media und Daten/CRM arbeiten Hand in Hand und lösen Herausforderungen als ein Team, das nah und partnerschaftlich mit dem Kunden zusammenarbeitet.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
  • Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
  • Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
  • Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
  • More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das bewegst du:

Als Senior Content Creator bist du die treibende Kraft für plattformstarken Content: Vom ersten Konzept über die Set-Regie bis zum KI-optimierten Master-Cut machst du Marken auf TikTok, IG & Co. unübersehbar.

  • Creative Lead & Storytelling: Im Co-Creation-Trio mit Social Media Management und klassischem Conceptor entwickelst du native Formate für TikTok, Instagram, YouTube und LinkedIn. Mit Gespür für Trends und Timing machst du daraus Content, der hängenbleibt.
  • End-to-End Regie & Dreh: Am Set übernimmst du eigenverantwortlich Produktionsleitung und Regie. Vom cineastischen High-End-Setup bis zum agilen Smartphone-Shooting erweckst du Ideen visuell zum Leben.
  • High-End Post-Production: Du gibst jedem Asset den perfekten Schliff. Mit Editing, Color Grading, Sound Design und Motion Graphics erschaffst du plattformoptimierte Master auf Studioniveau.
  • Client Sparring & Pitch: Mit Moodboards und ersten Schnittfassungen machst du Ideen greifbar. Du präsentierst deine Konzepte mit Überzeugungskraft und stehst Kund:innen bei visuellen Fragen verlässlich zur Seite.
  • Produktions- & Ressourcensteuerung: Bei größeren Projekten behältst du Budget und Timings im Blick. Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für das was am Set gebraucht wird und hast kein Problem damit auch für größere Produktionen eine Technik-Liste aufzusetzen.
  • Data Insights & KI-Innovation: Performance-Daten nutzt du als Hebel für gezielte kreative Optimierungen. Gleichzeitig integrierst du generative KI-Tools ganz selbstverständlich in Ideation, Kreation und Editing.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Plattform-Expertise & Storytelling: Du besitzt ein exzellentes Gespür für Algorithmen, aktuelle Trends und natives Storytelling. Markenbotschaften übersetzt du zielsicher in virale und performante Formate für TikTok, Instagram, YouTube und LinkedIn.
  • Dreherfahrung & Set-Routine: Mehrjährige Praxis am Set zeichnet dich aus. Du beherrschst Kamerasysteme, Licht und Ton routiniert und behältst auch bei dynamischen Live- und Event-Drehs stets die Ruhe und den Überblick. Dabei reist du gerne auch mal zu spannenden Locations und bist offen dafür, wenn ein Event vereinzelt mal aufs Wochenende fällt.
  • High-End Postproduktion: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects und DaVinci Resolve beherrschst du auf Top-Niveau, ergänzt durch Know-how in Photoshop und Figma. Schnitt, Color Grading, Sounddesign und Motion Graphics setzt du eigenständig und stilsicher um.
  • Präsentations- & Argumentationsstärke: Du bringst visuelle Ideen überzeugend auf den Punkt, begründest gestalterische Entscheidungen fachlich fundiert vor Kund:innen und berätst verlässlich zu Machbarkeit und Bildsprache.
  • Team & Mentoring: Du hast Freude daran, Best Practices im Team zu etablieren, konstruktives Feedback zu geben und Kolleg:innen fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Performance-Gespür & KI-Tools: Du verstehst es, Performance-Daten zu lesen und in kreative Hebel für Hooks, Pacing und Visuals zu übersetzen. Generative KI-Tools wie Midjourney, Firefly oder Runway nutzt du bereits neugierig und routiniert im Arbeitsalltag.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #kreativ #kommunikativ #motiviert 

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media:

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.
 
WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.

title: Senior Creative Project Manager -Fixed Term Contract
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Creative Project Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week from our London HQ. In this role, you'll help us lead the end-to-end delivery of creative projects across diverse briefs—from fast-turnaround sprints to global, multi-channel campaigns—while driving studio operations and process improvements. This is a 12 month fixed term contract.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Creative Studio team. Reporting into the PMO Lead, you'll work alongside Creative, Campaign, Design, and Creative Operations functions to power our in-house marketing and creative output.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

Campaign & Project Delivery

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of creative briefs—ranging from high-volume growth marketing and CRM sprints to complex, multi-market campaigns including AV and TVC.
  • Develop accurate project plans, timelines, and milestones while managing budgets and resources to ensure seamless delivery across creative and marketing teams.

Stakeholder Leadership & Traffic Management

  • Act as the primary contact for projects, building strong relationships across internal teams and partner agencies while keeping everyone aligned on goals and milestones.
  • Manage traffic and intake: evaluate briefs, flag out-of-scope requests, manage sprint scheduling, and allocate resources based on team capacity.

Operations & Process Improvement

  • Own key PMO operations by refining Asana templates, documentation, and intake workflows to make studio operations more efficient, consistent, and scalable.
  • Support studio-wide operational initiatives, including resourcing models, tooling, reporting, and adopting AI-enabled creative production workflows in partnership with our Creative AI Technologist.

Risk Mitigation & Team Mentorship

  • Identify project risks early and implement effective solution strategies to keep work moving smoothly without compromising quality.
  • Motivate and guide creative project teams, sharing best practices across the PMO and supporting less experienced project managers and freelancers.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience managing end-to-end creative projects and integrated campaigns within an in-house studio or creative marketing agency.
  • Proven ability in resource management, capacity planning, and traffic management for high-volume, fast-turnaround performance and growth marketing assets (paid social, CRM, in-app).
  • Deep understanding of creative operations, including intake flows, studio tooling (e.g., Asana), project documentation, and process optimization across local and global markets.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge, motivate, and align cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage project budgets, mitigate risks proactively, and deliver high-quality work to tight deadlines.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools and adoption strategies into creative production and studio workflows.
  • Experience managing and onboarding external agencies or freelance resources.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

You’ll report to Matias del Carril, our CRM & Lifecycle Lead, who has been at Qonto for 2 years. title: Senior Customer Success Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why join us?

Mitti by SafetyCulture is a global tech company, just not the kind you're picturing. Our almost 1,000-person team builds tools that make work better for the three billion frontline workers who keep the world moving. We've got big tech scale, without the sign-off layers or corporate theatre. This next chapter is about scaling smart, powered by AI, a clear vision and real ownership.

Big tech impact, without the big tech ick.

Role Purpose

This role exists to unlock technical value for Mitti’s customers, designing and implementing solutions that ensure customers integrate deeply with the platform and realise measurable operational outcomes, while bridging the gap between Go-to-Market (GTM) teams and Product, Design & Engineering (PDE). They own end-to-end delivery of integration offerings within defined scope, timeline, and budget, escalating only where customer requirements exceed standard package boundaries.

 

What you'll do

  • Own technical solution design for select customers, from scoping integrations and data workflows through to working implementations.

  • Build and maintain Workato integrations and automations that connect Mitti to customers' systems and trigger actions off events in the platform.

  • Deliver our standard Integration/Automation packages end-to-end (scope, build, test, handoff) on time and within the effort budget.

  • Advise customers and partners on integration architecture, and support CSMs and AEs with implementation plans and pre-sales technical questions (APIs, security architecture, cloud integrations).

  • Act as the technical bridge between GTM, PDE and API & Integrations Engineering, routing customer integration feedback to the roadmap.

  • Spot recurring patterns and repeated "out of scope" requests across customers, and help turn them into packaged offerings, reusable automations and shared tooling in the Customer Solution & Implementation toolkit.

What you'll bring

Integration and automation

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automations in an iPaaS or workflow-automation platform, such as Workato or Zapier.

  • Proven track record of building and maintaining custom system-to-system automations (webhooks, REST APIs, OAuth, data mapping) triggered by events in a core platform, beyond configuring pre-built templates.

  • You can speak in detail about an integration tool you've used: what you built, how it worked and the trade-offs.

Custom code

  • Comfort writing code (JavaScript, Python or similar) inside workflows where drag-and-drop steps fall short: custom scripting, complex conditional logic, parsing nested JSON and error handling.

  • Broader scripting or programming experience (Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Go) to automate workflows or extend the platform for specific customer use cases.

Data and APIs

  • SQL and relational data modelling, and experience turning raw data into business-relevant insight.

  • Confidence reading API documentation and building or troubleshooting API integrations across a wide variety of enterprise system architectures, data models and integration patterns.

Ways of working

  • Credible with both engineers and business stakeholders, with a customer-first, self-directed approach to a high-volume, concurrent workload.

  • Fluent use of AI tools and coding assistants to speed up spec writing, data analysis and automation builds. You review AI-generated code for quality, correctness and security before deploying.

 

Benefits

At Mitti, we care about people and growing the team, through:

  • Equity with high growth potential, and a competitive salary,

  • Hybrid working arrangements with flexibility,

  • Access to professional and personal training and development opportunities; Hackathons, Workshops, Lunch & Learns;

  • We encourage involvement in the community, open source work, attending talks and events, and experimenting with new technologies.

You'll also receive other perks such as:

  • Remote flexible working arrangements

  • Wellbeing initiatives such as subsidised fitness programs, EAP services and generous parental leave policy

  • Quarterly celebrations and team events

  • Table tennis, board games, gym sessions, book club, and pet-friendly offices.

We’re committed to building inclusive teams and cultivating a sense of belonging so our people can bring their whole authentic selves to work each day. We seek to make reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process to create an even playing field for all candidates. Thanks to the tireless efforts of the entire Mitti team we’ve built an incredible culture which has seen us recognised as a Best Place to Work in Australia , the US and the UK .

Even if you don't meet every requirement listed in the ad, please consider applying for this role. We prioritise inclusion and value individuals with potential over a checklist of qualifications. Don't rule yourself out, hit that apply button if this job resonates with you

You can find out more about life at Mitti via Youtube , Twitter , Instagram and LinkedIn.

About the team 

The Data Cloud Acceleration team identifies gaps and opportunities across clients and business units, then moves quickly to deliver practical new capabilities. We often develop and deploy the first version of a model, workflow, dataset, or application in days or weeks, learn from real usage, and improve it iteratively. 

We are business-minded technologists who care more about impact than technical novelty. We use sophisticated methods when the problem requires them and simpler approaches when they will deliver a better result faster. Our work should be predictable, demoable, trusted, reusable, measured, and amplified by AI. 

About the role 

The Senior Data Scientist will build models, analyses, and supporting ML components that improve business decisions, intelligence products, and client outcomes. You will independently own defined deliverables—from understanding the requirement and preparing the data through modeling, validation, documentation, and delivery. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will work across varied revenue and intelligence initiatives, often in partnership with a Lead Data Scientist, application engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. The right candidate can move quickly without sacrificing trustworthiness and knows how to balance statistical rigor with the practical needs of the business. 

What you’ll do

  • Own model and analysis deliverables. Take a defined business problem and independently deliver a reliable model, analysis component, scoring workflow, or supporting dataset.  

  • Translate business questions into analytical approaches. Ask clarifying questions, understand how the output will be used, and recommend an approach that fits the decision, timeline, and available data.  

  • Build and test models quickly. Develop practical solutions using statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, or existing models and services where appropriate.  

  • Prepare trustworthy data. Profile, cleanse, join, and validate noisy datasets while checking completeness, freshness, distributions, nulls, duplicates, and match rates.  

  • Create repeatable scoring workflows. Move useful work beyond the notebook by building reusable Python components, batch-scoring processes, APIs, or lightweight services.  

  • Evaluate results responsibly. Establish baselines, select appropriate metrics, perform statistical reasonableness checks, reconcile unexpected results, and clearly document limitations.  

  • Support intelligence products and applications. Work with application and data teams to define the right data ingredients, test hypotheses, and integrate model outputs into usable experiences.  

  • Add operational discipline. Include validation, monitoring, failure handling, refresh expectations, documentation, and a clear usage path in delivered work.  

  • Use AI to improve your own productivity. Apply tools such as Claude, Codex, and similar assistants to accelerate coding, testing, research, debugging, and documentation while independently verifying the results.  

  • Communicate progress early and clearly. Make milestones, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and issues visible rather than waiting until delivery.  

What ownership looks like at this level

You are expected to own the deliverable. That means: 

  • Working independently on a well-defined model, workflow, dataset, or component  

  • Producing reliable and repeatable outputs rather than one-time analyses  

  • Adding appropriate validation and basic monitoring  

  • Documenting assumptions, methodology, limitations, and usage  

  • Demonstrating the output and explaining how it supports the business  

  • Raising risks and ambiguity early  

  • Leaving the work in a condition that another team member can operate or extend  

You will receive guidance on broader product direction, methodology, and complex stakeholder decisions, but you should not require step-by-step direction to complete the work. 

Experience that can set you up for success

These are useful indicators rather than absolute requirements: 

  • Experience applying statistical analysis and machine learning to real business problems  

  • Strong Python skills and familiarity with libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow  

  • Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing large datasets  

  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Athena, Hive, BigQuery, or similar technologies  

  • Experience developing classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, recommendation, optimization, or anomaly-detection solutions  

  • Familiarity with model evaluation, experimental design, feature engineering, and statistical validation  

  • Experience creating repeatable batch-scoring workflows or exposing model outputs through APIs or services  

  • Familiarity with orchestration and automation tools such as Airflow, AWS Glue, Prefect, or similar platforms  

  • Experience using version control, testing, and reproducible development practices  

  • Ability to explain analytical results and trade-offs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders  

  • Meaningful use of GenAI tools to improve the speed and quality of day-to-day work  

You’ll thrive here if you 

  • Are pragmatic. You select the simplest credible approach that can deliver useful business impact.  

  • Move quickly with discipline. You can produce an initial version rapidly while still validating the fundamentals.  

  • Care about trust. You check the data, question surprising results, and make limitations visible.  

  • Work well with ambiguity. You can turn an incomplete request into a clear set of questions, assumptions, and next steps.  

  • Think beyond the notebook. You consider how a model will be refreshed, accessed, demonstrated, monitored, and reused.  

  • Understand the business context. You evaluate technical decisions through the lens of client outcomes, revenue, cost, adoption, and decision quality.  

  • Are curious and low-ego. You are comfortable learning from others, revising an approach, and using an existing solution when it is better than building a new one.  

Early indicators of success 

Within the first several months, a successful candidate will have: 

  • Independently delivered a model, analysis workflow, or scoring component used in an active business or intelligence initiative  

  • Added repeatable validation and documentation to their deliverables  

  • Converted at least one exploratory analysis or prototype into a reusable workflow  

  • Demonstrated clear understanding of how their work supports a client, product, revenue, or operational outcome  

  • Used AI-assisted development to improve delivery speed without compromising accuracy or trust  

  • Earned confidence from data science, application, and business partners through reliable execution and clear communication 

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.  

We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here:  https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.  

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products. Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Senior DevOps Engineer Role:

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Nearform, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure to support scalable and reliable applications. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and managing cloud-based infrastructure on AWS.
  • Creating and maintaining deployment architectures and continuous delivery pipelines.
  • Designing high-availability and fault-tolerant solutions for applications.
  • Implementing monitoring frameworks, including dashboards, alerts, and escalation processes.
  • Automating infrastructure provisioning and management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Managing containerized applications and orchestrating deployments using Kubernetes.
  • Ensuring security best practices are applied across CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and microservices.
  • Optimizing system performance and scalability through observability and proactive monitoring.
  • Collaborating with development teams to streamline deployment workflows and improve DevOps processes.
  • Advising clients on best practices for cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, and system security.
  • Engaging in technical discussions with stakeholders and supporting project execution to ensure timely delivery.
  • Assisting with the analysis of client requirements.
  • Working with and supporting Technical Leaders in project execution and timely delivery.
  • Collaborating with client teams.

What we are looking for in this person

  • Significant experience delivering at a Senior Engineer level. Our Seniors typically have at least 6 years’ commercial experience.
  • Practical experience and knowledge of developing real-world solutions.
  • Practical experience of delivering in an agile environment.
  • Strong experience managing and automating cloud-based infrastructure on AWS.
  • Proficiency in infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools, ideally Kubernetes (K8s).
  • Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
  • Scripting and automation expertise, preferably with Python.
  • Experience with observability tools and monitoring frameworks for system performance optimization.
  • Solid understanding of security best practices across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.
  • Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!
  • Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
  • Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
  • Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.
  • Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
  • Pension & Insurances - We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.

Our Interview Process

  • Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
    An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.
  • Technical Assessment (1 hour via Zoom)
    A live coding challenge with one of our trained interviewers. You'll be asked to build a working solution to a problem via screen sharing, demonstrating your DevOps engineering expertise, problem-solving ability, and coding best practices in a real-time environment.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45 mins via Zoom)
    A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct manual and electronic identity verification checks to confirm the identity of prospective employees.


Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence. 

If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.  

Our salary range starts from £75,000 + bonus & benefits and will be discussed during the initial interview based on your experience.

descriptionHtml:
We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting), with 25+ nationalities and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our collective travel belts.
