That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning.

Your expedition: DevOps at Polarsteps

One person, the whole platform.

Polarsteps helps 23+ million travellers plan, track and relive their trips, and all of it runs on our infrastructure. As our DevOps Engineer, you’ll be the main point of contact for that infrastructure. You’ll work alongside our Platform team and support all 8 of our engineering teams, so everyone can ship with confidence.

There’s plenty of room to bring your own ideas and improve how we work, with a supportive team around you to figure things out together. If you enjoy being hands-on, setting up good processes and helping others make the right technical choices, this is your kind of adventure.

Our ambition is big. We want our infrastructure ready for 100 million+ users, built efficiently in both cost and resources.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day:

You will:

  • Report to Simeon, our Lead Backend Engineer, and work closely with our Platform team (Youri, William, Paco, Jimmy, Florian and Ledio) and team leads across Engineering.

  • Own the day-to-day operations of our AWS stack, including S3 and our PostgreSQL databases.

  • Spot bottlenecks in our architecture and scaling, both for users and for developer experience. You’ll create and execute a plan with Engineering and other stakeholders.

  • Review, improve and maintain our observability, monitoring and alerting.

  • Manage and respond to incidents, and keep our infrastructure and troubleshooting documentation up to date.

  • Strengthen platform security and privacy, working alongside our external security lead.

  • Lead initiatives like rolling out company-wide SSO and managing our VPN.

  • You use AI tools like Claude Code, MCP servers and AI-assisted observability (e.g. Datadog) as a daily part of your workflow, from debugging incidents and infrastructure issues to writing and reviewing code.

  • Support our Data team with the infrastructure behind our analytics stack.

The equipment in your backpack

What we’re hoping you’ll bring with you:

  • 5+ years as a DevOps Engineer, SRE or Platform Engineer.

  • Experience automating infrastructure and processes on AWS.

  • Fluency in shell scripting, Python and Terraform / OpenTofu.

  • Experience monitoring, troubleshooting and scaling a similar stack (Python, PostgreSQL/RDS) under growing load.

  • Comfort making changes to backend code when automation calls for it.

  • A pragmatic mindset: you know when to cut corners and when to build something that lasts.

  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical people, helping them reach decisions on complex trade-offs.

  • Autonomy and a collaborative nature. You’re happy setting up your own processes while working with everyone.

  • Knowledgeable of platform security best practices.

Bonus points if you’ve worked with Nix, Kubernetes, ArgoCD or ECS, RabbitMQ, or TypeScript on the frontend ✨

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 84.000 and 99.000 gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, to be evaluated during the interview process.

  • Hybrid working. Split your time between the office and your home, as you see fit.

  • An extensive home office set-up — everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you, but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily office lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

STACK is a proven, trusted partner for the world's most innovative companies, designing, developing and operating sustainable global digital infrastructure. title: (Senior) Electronics Engineer, Hardware & Firmware (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of Schunk, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As an Electronics Engineer (Embedded Hardware & Firmware) at TACTILIA Robotics, you will help design and build the physical and low-level intelligence that brings our robotic hands to life.

You will own the complete embedded hardware and firmware stack—from schematics and high-density multilayer layouts to the real-time C/C++ firmware running directly on the metal.

Fitting multiple drives, high-density tactile arrays, and power electronics into a hand-sized volume means every decision is a tight balance of space, thermals, signal integrity, and manufacturability. You will work closely with the CTO and cross-functional team, moving smoothly between architecture, circuit design, and the lab to solve complex problems where physics meets code.

What you will do:

  • Own the hardware architecture. Design schematics and high-density, multilayer PCB layouts (mixed-signal, tight thermal/EMC constraints) built for modularity across product variants—not a one-off prototype.

  • Build control hardware and firmware that can't miss a beat. Search, evaluate, test, and integrate actuator hardware alongside motor drivers for compact servo drives; write deterministic real-time firmware (C/C++) for control loops, timing-critical execution, limit monitoring, and fault handling.

  • Choose the right sensor and make the data mean something. Search, evaluate, test, and integrate sensor hardware for tactile sensing and proprioception (position and force); design low-noise readout electronics, signal conditioning, filtering, and calibration pipelines to deliver clean, low-latency telemetry to the software stack.

  • Ship rock-solid bootloaders and drivers. Build field-updatable bootloaders, low-level drivers, and secure, fail-safe update strategies across product generations—documented and reliable, not tribal knowledge.

  • Build interfaces customers actually want to integrate. Implement and maintain fieldbus and hardware communication layers (EtherCAT, CANopen, Ethernet) aligned cleanly with higher-level software and robot controllers.

  • Debug on real hardware. Own the lab bring-up process from first power-on to full validation. Trace issues across the hardware, firmware, and mechanical boundaries with scopes, logic analyzers, and thermal imaging.

  • Build security into the product from day one. Support Cyber Resilience Act compliance by integrating secure boot, signed firmware updates, and hardware-level trust mechanisms early in the design cycle.

  • Build for series production, not just the lab. Design for manufacturing and test (DFM/DFT), select resilient supply-chain components with second sources, run EMC pre-compliance, and drive hardware through production ramp-up.

  • Work across the whole team. Tight loop with Mechanics, Software, and System Applications—translating mechanical and control requirements into robust, deployable electronics.

What you bring:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field.

  • 5–10 years of experience developing embedded hardware and firmware for mechatronic products, including at least one product taken into series production.

  • Proven expertise in schematic capture and multilayer PCB layout (Altium, KiCad, or similar), specifically for space-constrained, mixed-signal designs.

  • Strong C/C++ skills on bare-metal or RTOS (ARM Cortex-M or similar) with a deep understanding of timing, concurrency, memory, and register-level hardware control.

  • Hands-on experience with BLDC/DC motor driver design, current/velocity/position control loops, and low-level sensor interfacing.

  • A strong hardware mindset: you enjoy lab bring-up, signal-integrity debugging, and getting to the bottom of transient issues with a scope or logic analyzer.

  • Fluent English; German is a plus, not a requirement.

Bonus:

  • Miniature electronics, high-density PCB packaging, or tight thermal constraints

  • Tactile, force/torque, or contact-rich sensor arrays

  • Real-time fieldbuses (EtherCAT, CANopen)

  • Product security: secure boot, signed firmware, CRA, IEC 62443

  • Functional safety standards (Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066)

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.

That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Hardware Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
We are looking to add a Senior Hardware Engineer II to our team. If you are great at what you do, enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. At the Principal level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and hardware systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Principal level also includes technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for critical designs and teams of engineers developing new products and systems. At a small company and a startup, your work will make direct contributions to the success of the business. The work is challenging and impactful, requiring both breadth and depth of technical knowledge. Our products are made for high-reliability space and airborne applications, so designs require high levels of technical rigor while maintaining the agility of a startup environment. The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Own end-to-end design of complex electronics modules and systems, from concept and architecture through schematic, layout, test, and production. Products may include high-speed digital, power electronics, and/or RF.
  • Lead teams of hardware engineers to develop new products with multiple electronics modules.
  • Provide subject matter expertise in support of hardware development across the company.
  • Develop hardware architecture and write hardware requirements for systems of high complexity.
  • Perform detailed and complete schematic design for complex boards, ranging from key components to supporting passives.
  • Perform detailed PCB layout in Altium Designer for complex boards, often working with a PCB Drafter.
  • Complete analysis such as worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity analysis, and power integrity analysis. Guide analysis methodology.
  • Develop bring-up plans and design verification plans for new hardware and complex systems.
  • Perform bring-up and key verification testing of modules and complex integrated systems, often working with a team to complete validation.
  • Release modules and assemblies to production, working with the Manufacturing and Test Engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior and senior engineers to build technical understanding and professional development.
  • Use strong working knowledge of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, to streamline development of complex hardware systems.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor of Science (BS) degree or higher in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • Minimum of 6 years of industry or university research experience in board-level electronics design, analysis, and test.
  • Direct experience designing high-reliability electronics and small systems for space or defense applications, including part derating, worst-case analysis, and thermal constraints.
  • Experience owning the design phase of complex board-level electronics and small hardware systems, including architecture design, trade studies, key part selection, and detailed design.
  • Multiple experiences delivering hardware products through production and deployment.
  • Expertise in PCB layout and manufacturing, including high-density interconnect (HDI) stackup design, IPC standards, and industry best practices.
  • Expertise derisking designs with board-level signal integrity and/or power integrity simulation tools such as Ansys SIwave, ADS SIPro, or Mentor Hyperlynx.
  • Strong understanding of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, that contributes to judicious design of hardware system architectures.
  • Expert-level proficiency in electronics design tools such as Altium.
  • Extensive lab experience for bring-up and verification of new hardware, based on in-depth understanding of specialized lab equipment.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills.

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Experience leading teams of hardware engineers to develop multi-module assemblies, including hardware architecture, requirements, and interconnects.
  • Design for space radiation environments.

  • Creator-Beziehungen & Verhandlung: Du bringst ein belastbares Netzwerk aus Creatorn und Management-Agenturen mit und baust es weiter aus. Du führst anspruchsvolle Vertrags- und Rahmenverhandlungen mit Top-Creatorn und Agenturen und entwickelst Vergütungsmodelle für nachhaltig hohen NC ROAS und langfristige Partnerschaften.

  • Kreatives Testing mit System: Du denkst in Hypothesen und isolierst Variablen sauber. Du planst Testing-Roadmaps für Produkte, Hooks, Formate und Angles, wertest sie statistisch belastbar aus und überführst die Learnings in Briefings, Bundles und Landingpages.

  • KI als Hebel und neuer Standard: Du setzt KI dort ein, wo sie Qualität und Geschwindigkeit steigert, zum Beispiel bei Creator-Scouting und -Scoring, Performance-Auswertung, Briefing-Erstellung oder Content-Analyse. Du entwickelst daraus Workflows und Best Practices, die das ganze Team nutzt, und hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse kritisch.

  • Konzeption, Bundles & Verkaufspsychologie: Du übersetzt Daten in messerscharfe, kreative Creator-Briefings, konzipierst unwiderstehliche Produkt-Bundles und gestaltest Landingpages mit, gezielt mit verkaufspsychologischen Triggern für maximale Conversion.

  • Schnittstelle zum Performance-Team: Du bist der verlängerte Arm von Paid Media. Du erkennst, welcher Creator-Content als Ad auf Meta oder TikTok performt, sicherst die nötigen Nutzungsrechte und lieferst dem Team laufend frisches Creative-Futter.

  • Channel-Expansion: Du bringst neue Plattformen und Formate in den Mix und baust sie datenbasiert auf. Gerade Social Commerce wie TikTok Shop (Affiliate-Programm, Live-Shopping) ist für uns ein spannendes Feld.

  • Sparring & Standards: Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Management und Kolleg:innen, coachst bei Bedarf Junior-Kolleg:innen und hilfst, Prozesse, Benchmarks und Reportings im Team zu professionalisieren.


DAS BIST DU

Du hast Lust in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, das sich für einen nachhaltigeren Lifestyle einsetzt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung von Tag 1, gehst Herausforderungen proaktiv an und fühlst dich in einem schnelllebigen und dynamischen Startup-Umfeld wohl? Wir glauben, das könnte ein gutes Match sein!

Bei everdrop arbeiten Menschen mit Growth Mindset, die Lust darauf haben, immer wieder Neues zu lernen. Wenn du gerne eigene Ideen einbringst, Lust hast, Dinge von Beginn an mitzugestalten und die folgenden Skills und Erfahrungen mitbringst, könnte das der Anfang einer wunderbaren Love Story sein.

Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Senior-Vorerfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im performance-getriebenen Influencer Marketing in einem schnell wachsenden D2C-E-Commerce-Umfeld oder einer Performance-Agentur, davon mehrere Jahre mit eigener Budgetverantwortung.

  • Budget-Verantwortung: Du hast bereits einen Großteil eines monatlichen Creator-Spends im sechsstelligen Bereich eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und kannst nachweisen, welchen Impact deine Entscheidungen hatten.

  • KI-Kompetenz: Du hast KI bereits praktisch im Marketing eingesetzt, etwa für Analyse, Automatisierung oder Content-Prozesse, und kannst Beispiele nennen, wie du damit Ergebnisse verbessert oder Zeit gespart hast.

  • Analytische Exzellenz: CAC, NC ROAS, CVR, CPM und LTV sind dein Alltag. Du kannst komplexe Performance-Daten über den gesamten Funnel hinweg eigenständig auswerten, Zusammenhänge erkennen, bevor andere sie sehen, und daraus klare Budgetentscheidungen ableiten. Du hinterfragst Zahlen kritisch, trennst Korrelation von Kausalität und stellst deine Erkenntnisse so dar, dass auch das Management sofort handeln kann.

  • Netzwerk: Du bringst bestehende Beziehungen zu Creatorn und Agenturen im DACH-Raum und idealerweise darüber hinaus mit, sodass wir schnell Zugang zu starken Partner:innen bekommen.

  • Verhandlungsgeschick: Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung mit komplexen Verträgen und Rahmenvereinbarungen mit Top-Creatorn und Management-Agenturen.

  • A/B-Testing-Mindset: Du isolierst Variablen, denkst in Hypothesen und leitest daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Konsumentenverständnis: Du kennst Direct-Response-Prinzipien und weißt, welche psychologischen Trigger Conversions auslösen, im Storytelling der Creator ebenso wie auf der Landingpage.

  • Ownership: Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit Durchschlagskraft, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine KPIs und behältst auch bei hoher Kampagnendichte den Überblick.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (mind. C1) und sichere Englischkenntnisse. Französisch, Italienisch und Polnisch sind ein Plus.

  • Plus: Erfahrung mit TikTok Shop (Affiliate, Live-Shopping, GMV-Tracking).

DAS IST EVERDROP


Unsere Mission 💚🌱🌎

Wir wollen die Welt verändern – gemeinsam mit dir! Die Alltagsprodukte von everdrop helfen den Menschen, ganz einfach ihren ökologischen Fußabdruck im Haushalt zu reduzieren. Im Jahr 2020 sind wir mit unseren Reiniger-Tabs gestartet. Seitdem haben unsere Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte bereits mehr als 20 Millionen Einweg-Plastikflaschen und Tausende Tonnen unnötige CO2-Emissionen und chemische Rohstoffe eingespart. Seit 2023 sind wir übrigens eine zertifizierte B Corp. Und mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir everdrop aufs nächste Level bringen. Schließ dich unserer Mission an – und hilf uns, einen nachhaltigen Lifestyle so einfach zu machen, dass er zum neuen Standard in unserer Gesellschaft wird.

Unsere Benefits 🍲💪🏡

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice Möglichkeiten

  • 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub (plus 24.12. und 31.12. frei)

  • zusätzlich 2 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr für eigene umwelt- oder gemeinnützige Projekte ("Green & Social Impact Days”)

  • kostenloses veganes Mittagessen einmal pro Woche und Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine

  • Mitgliedschaft und Discounts über FutureBens & Corporate Benefits

    Darüber hinaus erwarten dich ein wunderschönes, offenes Büro in der Nähe der Isar, ein Macbook solange du bei everdrop arbeitest, regelmäßige Team-Events, ein starker Teamgeist und ganz viele Office-Hunde die sich schon darauf freuen, dich kennenzulernen!

Unsere Werte 💛🏳️‍🌈🤝‍

Unser Commitment, die Welt ein Stück besser zu machen, ist mit JEDI-Prinzipien verbunden. JEDI steht für Gerechtigkeit, Chancengerechtigkeit, Vielfalt und Inklusion (= Justice, Equity, Diversity, Inclusion). Wir verstehen diese Prinzipien als Grundlage unseres alltäglichen Handelns – sowohl intern beim Recruiting und innerhalb unserer Arbeitsabläufe, als auch gegenüber unseren Kund*innen und der Gesellschaft. Wir verpflichten uns dazu, daran zu arbeiten, systemische Barrieren abzubauen und eine Kultur zu fördern, in der jede Stimme gehört wird. Dies setzen wir durch konkrete Maßnahmen um:

  • In der Community: Wir nutzen unsere Plattform, um das Bewusstsein für soziale und ökologische Gerechtigkeit zu stärken.

Im Arbeitsalltag orientieren wir uns an unseren vier “Core Values”. Sie geben ganz klar vor, wie wir als Individuen und im Team miteinander arbeiten wollen:

#1 WE ARE AMBITIOUS
#2 WE TAKE OWNERSHIP
#3 WE ARE SOLUTION-ORIENTED
#4 WE ARE AWARE

Wir behandeln jeden Menschen gleich, unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, Aussehen, Sprache, Kultur, Nationalität, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung oder körperlicher Einschränkung.

Wir sind ganz bestimmt nicht perfekt – aber wir wollen jeden Tag besser werden und mit jedem Schritt etwas Neues dazulernen. Genau darum geht es ja bei jeder Reise. Kommst du mit?

title: Senior Insights & Curation Researcher
descriptionHtml:
Working closely with the Creative Insights team, this person will be responsible for the gathering, selection, and elevation of visuals within Getty Images and iStock library to regularly promote the breadth and depth, creativity, and differentiation of Getty Images’ and iStock’s Creative visual offering.

En étroite collaboration avec l’équipe Creative Insights, cette personne sera chargée de l’identification, de la sélection et de la mise en valeur des contenus visuels de la bibliothèque Getty Images et iStock afin de promouvoir régulièrement l’étendue, la qualité, la créativité et la différenciation de l’offre visuelle Creative.


Who You Are:

You are passionate about the way imagery works. You are naturally interested in visual communication in all forms and love discussing the content that you come across. You are equal parts creative, analytical and commercial. You enjoy selecting and curating visuals to tell compelling stories that are commercially relevant and are comfortable sharing your visual expertise with the world at large. You are highly organized and detail-oriented, able to manage the moving parts of multiple work streams operating simultaneously while still meeting deadlines. You are a creative problem-solver with the ability to quickly identify problems and work independently to find appropriate solutions. You have a pulse on what’s new and next in art and culture and are not afraid to share your insights and perspective with a multi-disciplinary creative team.

Votre profil:

Vous êtes passionné(e) par l’image et par la manière dont elle communique. Vous vous intéressez naturellement à toutes les formes de communication visuelle et aimez échanger autour des contenus que vous découvrez. Vous combinez sens créatif, esprit analytique et vision commerciale. Vous aimez sélectionner et mettre en scène des visuels pour raconter des histoires pertinentes sur le plan commercial et êtes à l’aise pour partager votre expertise visuelle. Vous êtes organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs projets simultanément tout en respectant les délais. Vous êtes force de proposition, autonome dans la résolution de problèmes et attentif(ve) aux nouvelles tendances de l’art et de la culture.


Your Next Challenge:
Insights-Driven Curation & Promotion
  • Provide promotional sets of visuals for assigned Creative Insights research projects, thought leadership (e.g., trend articles, toolkits, etc.), and other activities as assigned
  • Support bespoke requests for promotional sets of visuals to be funneled directly to key customers as part of partnership activations or as incentive for enterprise deals
  • Create themed sets of visuals to accompany insights for materials developed by Regional Marketing as well as PR activities such as press mentions, interviews, bylines, and events
  • Select and regularly rotate visuals to be promoted on the Getty Images and iStock homepages as well as on other owned social platforms such as Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn and email newsletters
  • Manage the merchandising of our key global and regional Creative special collections, curations and galleries (e.g., Project #ShowUs, The Disability Collection, LGBTQIA+ Curation, etc.) across Getty Images and iStock site pages
  • Support process for submission of premium visuals, stories, thought leadership) for awards and industry recognition
    • Visual Strategy & Education
  • Collaborate with Insights team to create visual narratives for key research and thought leadership projects in-region

  • Work with Insights, Sales Research and Custom Solutions teams to identify customer needs and content gaps in our visual offering
  • Develop and lead regular updates and trainings on new visual narratives and strategy in tandem with Insights team
  • Brainstorm and provide ongoing POV on visual trends across things aesthetics, video, subject, industry, regional
  • Set and maintain regional strategies for the ongoing development of the Creative special collections and ensure alignment to global strategy.

  • Fournir des sélections promotionnelles de visuels pour les projets de recherche Creative Insights, les initiatives de leadership d’opinion (articles de tendances, guides, etc.) et toute autre activité confiée.

  • Contribuer aux candidatures et soumissions pour des prix et reconnaissances du secteur.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe Insights pour développer des récits visuels autour des projets de recherche et de leadership d’opinion.
  • Assurer une veille régulière de l’offre visuelle Getty Images et iStock et travailler avec les équipes de création de contenu pour maintenir des sélections pertinentes et actualisées.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Insights, Sales Research et Custom Solutions afin d’identifier les besoins clients et les lacunes de l’offre visuelle.
  • Concevoir et animer des formations et mises à jour régulières sur les nouvelles orientations visuelles et stratégiques.
  • Apporter un point de vue sur les tendances visuelles en matière d’esthétique, vidéo, sujets, secteurs et régions.

Whether the goal is commercial or philanthropic, revenue-generating or society-changing, market-disrupting or headline-driving, our visuals help any brand, business, or organization communicate more effectively with their target audience and urge them to action. In other words, we know how powerful an image or video can be—and that it can move the world. Working at Getty Images Our goal is to be one of the best places to work globally, which means we’re dedicated to providing experiences and resources that allow you to do your best work. Getty Images believes that diversity is critical to our success in moving the world and is committed to creating an inclusive, mutually respectful environment that celebrates diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Der Leipziger Investmentmarkt schläft nicht. Und wir auch nicht.

Notartermin.

title: Senior/Lead Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Full Remote - Germany)
descriptionHtml:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next.

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO, with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

If you’re looking for more than a campaign-management role, this is your opportunity to drive measurable growth at exceptional scale.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own one of EverAI’s biggest growth opportunities: lead the strategy and execution across the full CRM lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion through repeat purchasing, retention, and reactivation

  • Find the growth hiding in our user base: use behavioral data to uncover where users lose interest, stop engaging, or miss an opportunity to purchase

  • Crack the first-purchase challenge: create onboarding, abandoned-payment, offer, and follow-up journeys that turn more registered users into paying customers

  • Keep users coming back: increase token purchases, repeat purchasing, retention, reactivation, and LTV through smarter segmentation, personalization, and timing

  • Test big ideas quickly: build experiments, measure what genuinely moved the numbers, scale the winners, and turn each result into the next opportunity

  • Make ambitious CRM ideas possible: work directly with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative to improve the tooling, tracking, messages, offers, and reporting behind the channel

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve scaled CRM before: you can show significant improvements you personally drove in revenue, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, reactivation, or LTV, with real numbers

  • You understand consumer growth: you’ve worked in a high-volume B2C subscription business, where CRM had a direct effect on revenue

  • You think like a builder: you do not stop at recommendations; you can personally create segments, journeys, experiments, campaign logic, and performance analysis

  • You know how to find and prove what works: you can turn user behavior into ideas and use testing, control groups, attribution, and incrementality to validate the results

  • You move quickly and take ownership: you are comfortable building without a finished playbook, deciding what matters most, and creating momentum without waiting for perfect information

  • You communicate clearly and work across teams: you collaborate directly with technical, creative, and commercial stakeholders in English

  • You are comfortable with our product category: you can confidently work on products powered by uncensored AI models and content

Bonus points

  • You have worked in iGaming, free-to-play gaming, fintech, consumer subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce

  • You have experience with token, credit, virtual-currency, bonus, or repeat-deposit models

  • You have built or redesigned CRM in a fast-scaling company

title: Senior / Lead Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the role

Nebius is looking for a Senior / Lead Program Manager to help develop and execute our asset-light model for expanding AI infrastructure through partnerships.

You will work at the intersection of strategy, finance, commercial negotiations and execution. Your focus will be to turn complex partnership opportunities into clear business cases, workable commercial terms and agreements that support the needs of Nebius, our partners and our customers.

This role suits someone who combines structured problem-solving with strong financial understanding and the ability to move work forward across multiple teams. You should be comfortable assessing commercial trade-offs, bringing clarity to ambiguous problems and taking responsibility for progress.

This is an individual contributor role with significant cross-functional responsibility. You will lead projects and influence stakeholders without direct line-management responsibility.

What you’ll do

  • Develop commercial frameworks and term sheets. Define proposed terms for asset-light partnerships, balancing financial returns, risk, responsibilities and the interests of Nebius and its partners.
  • Support the partnership team. Build the operational framework, track and report progress, develop commercial guidelines
  • Build business cases with Finance. Coordinate the analysis supporting partnership proposals, working through financial models, testing assumptions and assessing how different commercial terms affect the economics.
  • Shape contractual and legal structures. Partner with Legal and relevant business teams to translate the commercial model into practical structures and agreements for partners and customers.
  • Drive cross-functional execution. Bring together Finance, Legal, commercial, technical and operational stakeholders, establishing clear ownership, resolving dependencies and maintaining momentum.
  • Prepare decisions and recommendations. Turn complex information into clear options, explain trade-offs and help stakeholders reach informed decisions.
  • Develop repeatable ways of working. Capture lessons from individual partnerships and improve the frameworks, templates and processes that support the model as it grows.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in management consulting or a strategy and operations role within a technology business.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down unfamiliar, complex problems and develop practical recommendations.
  • Financial fluency: you can read and work with financial models, challenge assumptions and explain the commercial implications of the numbers. A specialist financial analyst background is not required.
  • Experience developing business cases, assessing commercial opportunities or supporting complex transactions and partnerships.
  • Confidence working with commercial terms and contracts alongside finance and legal specialists.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to align teams with different priorities and influence without formal authority.
  • The initiative and judgment to drive projects independently, manage ambiguity and recognise when a decision needs wider input.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, particularly when presenting analysis and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Revenue operations background: Supporting sales or partnership teams with clear processes, compensation structure etc.

Experience that would be valuable

  • Work on large, complex projects in data centres, digital infrastructure, real estate, power or related sectors.
  • Revenue operations background: supporting sales or partnership teams with clear processes, compensation structure etc.
  • Exposure to partnership models, infrastructure economics or arrangements involving several commercial counterparties.
  • Experience taking a strategic recommendation through negotiation and into implementation.
  • Sector experience is valuable, but we are also interested in strong generalists who can learn a new business model quickly and apply sound commercial judgment.



Why join Nebius

Nebius is scaling a new generation of AI infrastructure across EMEA. You will have genuine ownership of how that infrastructure is designed, standardised and delivered, working on complex projects where technical judgement has a direct impact on speed, capacity and long-term operational performance.

  • Commercial Law Foundation: Experience managing a variety of commercial contracts and regulatory matters.

Great to Have (but not required):

  • Collaborative Mindset: A desire to work effectively across different cultures, time zones, and departments.

  • Innovation-Led: An interest in how AI and technology are evolving the legal profession; we value a forward-thinking approach to productivity.

  • Mission-Driven: A genuine interest in contributing to a business that prioritizes social impact.

Benefits

  • Time off: 27 days holiday (including 3 winter shutdown days) and bank holidays, plus 5 extra days off (1 life event, 2 volunteer days and 2 summer shutdown days).

The role

From day one you’ll enable international coordination and implementation of strategic product priorities by creating, standardising and optimising processes across central and local physical product teams and other stakeholders. The role will require a mix of process improvement, change management, technical understanding, project management and stakeholder management skills. Not only will you be an ambassador of Product Operations Excellence, but also champion the value of process automation and optimization, to set a solid basis for growth.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the operating model: Diagnose end-to-end processes across central and local Product teams and adjacent functions (Procurement, FSQA, Production). 
  • Design and scale standards: Own process frameworks, SOPs and rollout "golden standards" that teams across markets adopt. Challenge and iterate existing policies and guidelines when they no longer fit the business.
  • Lead cross-market change: Drive organizational change across markets and functions, balancing central consistency with local needs. Build alignment with senior stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and ensure a constant flow of information.
  • Lead programs and automation: Own complex automation and tooling initiatives from a commercial perspective. Sign off on tooling designs and business cases, guide Tech teams on scope, edge cases and interdependencies, and take part in Steering Committees. On top of that, identify where AI can reshape Product Operations processes, build the business cases and prototypes, and deploy the successful tools across markets and teams. 
  • Lead under uncertainty: Scope and drive short- and long-term programs from broadly defined outcomes. Develop plan Bs and alternative solutions when priorities shift, and turn ambiguous problems into manageable, measurable workstreams.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years minimum experience in Product Operations or Operational/Process Excellence; passion for food or experience within Food/FMCG industry or consultancy is a plus
  • Recognized expertise in process excellence, change management and program delivery, with advanced knowledge of methodologies, current best practices and industry trends. You continuously challenge the status quo and bring new ideas to life.
  • Highly numerate and commercially minded, able to build rigorous, objective business cases and to judge technical designs with confidence.
  • A strong stakeholder leader who manages global and local stakeholders at all levels, aligns teams across markets, and communicates clearly to different audiences.
  • Autonomous and outcome-driven: you manage scope and timelines independently, prioritize relentlessly, and are comfortable being challenged on the soundness of your work.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, demanding and data-driven environment. 
  • Curious about AI and automation: you actively explore how AI can reshape processes, assess its impact rigorously, and lead teams to adopt it where it creates measurable value.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from a top-tier university, preferably in business, management, operations or a related field. Six Sigma Belt or PMP certification is a big plus. 

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • 2 years contract.
  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

About HelloFresh

HelloFresh is on a mission to change the way people eat, forever!

Since our 2011 founding in Europe’s vibrant tech hub, Berlin, we’ve become the world's leading meal kit provider, delivering to over 4.2 million households worldwide in 15 countries across 3 continents. 

Our more than 15,000 employees from over 70+ nationalities are the heart and soul of our diverse, fast-paced and dynamic environment where innovation and smart, fast action is encouraged. 

We will encourage you to make an immediate impact in your area of work as well as empower you to grow your career with us.

Are you up for the challenge?

Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days. 

We are HelloFresh

At HelloFresh we embrace and welcome diversity and we currently employ over 15,000 individuals globally who contribute to this. We employ individuals based on their ability to perform a job rather than on the basis of their: race, national origin, color, caste, social origin or position, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, political opinion, marital status or any other characteristic. We encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunity employer – everyone is welcome at our table.

descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

We identify potential prospects, leverage diverse outreach strategies, engage in strategic conversations with stakeholders, and collaborate with Account Executives to expand our footprint within new and existing accounts, ultimately generating revenue for the organization. At our core, we are a dynamic team of highly motivated self-starters who are passionate about the AlphaSense product. We rely on product and industry knowledge to communicate the value of our solution and convert interested prospects into qualified leads.

About the Role: We are looking for a passionate, data-driven Senior Sales Development Manager to help accelerate pipeline generation and drive new business growth. This individual will attract, retain, and cultivate exceptional Sales Development talent and future Account Executives within our team. Your leadership will be key in ensuring our team achieves ambitious goals and continues to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 

This is a hybrid role, 3 days per week in our London office.

What You’ll Do:

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits  ✨

Our Customer Operations & Specialist Services teams⭐

We are recruiting for 4 opportunities across our Customer Operations and Specialist Services teams to join us as Senior Manager in Supplier Performance. We are recruiting for 4 roles, with 1 to join us in each of the following areas: Complaints, VAIB (Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusivity and Bereavements), Financial Health and Core Customer Operations.

Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service.

We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area. 

Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.


🔑You’ll play a key role by...

You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.

  • Leading a dedicated oversight team: You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.
  • Managing the partnership day to day: You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.
  • Acting as the translation layer: You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.
  • Tracking and managing performance: You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.
  • Forecasting and planning: Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.
  • Owning change execution: You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.
  • Integrating the teams: You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.
  • You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.
  • You have a proven track record of leading through others and  can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.
  • You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.
  • You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  • Recruiter call (25 minutes)
  • Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)
  • Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

#LI-REMOTE#LI-CB4

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer - DFM
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do
  • You’ll be the focal point between product development (Engineering) and industrialization (Manufacturing)
  • Ensure manufacturing optimized design decisions from early project phases. Advise and consult the engineering team based on your expertise in manufacturing.
  • Represent manufacturing in concept development, design meetings and design reviews. Flagging risks and proactively developing solutions and suggestions for improvements.
  • Follow the entire manufacturing engineering process until full production rate to capture lessons learned and best practices from each program to implement into following design projects.
  • Develop tools and processes to ensure an effective and efficient DFM process, supportive to Engineering teams and overall accelerating the time to market and efficiency.
  • Suggest technologies and processes to be considered. Initiate strategic competence build-up if beneficial and required to a program.
  • Work with vendors and equipment manufacturers to identify innovative solutions to manufacturing problems. Drive co-development for highly specialized processes & technologies.
  • Operate as a manufacturing all‑rounder, bridging detailed process design with factory‑level thinking to ensure coherent design and seamless integration into the manufacturing system at exceptional industrialization speed.
  • Identify process‑level risks and trade‑offs early, driving mitigations through design, analysis, or process changes.
  • Produce and maintain clear documentation, including drawings, specifications, and design justifications.
  • Act as a technically credible problem‑solver in ambiguous environments, closing decisions and keeping programs moving at pace.

Who you are
  • A senior Manufacturing Engineer with firsthand expertise and experience in manufacturing / assembly. Ideally combined with experience in product design or previous DFM roles.
  • Experienced working on complex, integrated manufacturing systems. Ideally in aerospace, defence, or other high‑performance, cross functional environments under intense time pressure.
  • Managing partners and suppliers proficiently and effectively. Motivating everyone to go above and beyond to achieve common goals and timelines.
  • Dealing well with ambiguity and uncertainty, willing to anticipate, test and reconsider if necessary.
  • Comfortable operating at multiple levels of abstraction from detailed design to work center‑ or system‑level.
  • Experienced working on complex, integrated systems, ideally in aerospace, defence, or other high‑performance hardware environments.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals covering process- and product design
  • Pragmatic and delivery‑focused, able to make sound engineering trade‑offs without over‑engineering
  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines and acting as a technical integrator, not just a specialist.
  • Hands‑on by instinct, willing to support build, integration, and test when needed.
  • Calm and effective in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where priorities evolve.
  • Motivated by building real, high‑consequence hardware where mechanical and system correctness truly matter.

What we offer
  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.

Security and Eligibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV) At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics.

The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small.

What you'll do

  • Mentor the mechanical engineers day to day: help them make design decisions, set methods and keep projects focused

  • Design parts and assemblies in CAD, including tolerancing, and check every design for manufacturability and cost before it goes out

  • Lead testing and integration of mechanics and electronics, and solve the problems that only show once everything is assembled

  • Prioritise incoming work, follow up on progress and make the day-to-day technical calls on the mechanical side

  • Make the gated design process work in practice and run design reviews (safety, mechanics, electronics, manufacturability) before parts are integrated

  • Put design for manufacturing and design for cost in place: fewer, standardised parts and production methods that scale

  • Work with the electronics owner of each robot module from the first prototype on, and with Production on manufacturability and production jigs

  • Build and iterate prototypes based on customer and field feedback

About you

  • Several years of hands-on mechanical design in R&D at a company that develops and builds its own electromechanical products (e.g. power tools, home appliances, e-mobility, production machines, robotics, marine propulsion)

  • A proven record of taking an electromechanical product from prototype to series production (ideally 1,000+ units a year) on a fast development cycle of about a year, not a decade-long program

  • You still design hands-on in CAD, mainly metal parts and assemblies, with strong tolerancing skills (any CAD tool; Onshape is a plus)

  • You've applied design for manufacturing and design for cost, and cut cost through design: fewer parts, standard parts

  • At least two years of mentoring or technically guiding other engineers; a team-lead title isn't required

  • Experience testing and integrating mechanics with electronics

  • You've introduced processes, design reviews or engineering standards that helped a team deliver

  • You handle unclear requirements and break complex problems down so others can work on them

  • German is a plus, since production is mostly German-speaking

  • Bonus: GD&T and tolerance stack-ups, design of production jigs, or projects with motors, motor controllers or electronics

What Filics offers

  • A key role at an early stage: shape both the mechanical team and the product

  • Real ownership of the mechanical side, from first prototype to series production

  • A mix of hands-on engineering and leadership, with a path into team lead and engineering management as Filics grows

  • Fast design cycles driven by customer and field feedback

  • A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across mechanics, electronics, software and production

  • Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company

  • An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

descriptionHtml:

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

The Role

You’ll own the operational backbone of our People function: payroll, global mobility, PEOs, commission and equity administration, HRIS, and the systems that keep everything in sync. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on clean operations, not a junior administrator position and not a People leadership seat.

You'll operate the frameworks our leadership and Finance set (pay philosophy, salary bands, commission structure, equity strategy). Your job is to implement those decisions accurately and on time, with a clear audit trail, and with the judgment to stop or escalate anything that doesn't fit the framework or lacks proper approval.

What You'll Do

  • Own payroll controls and monthly validation across UK payroll, PEOs, and other employment models, with clean reconciliation to Finance each month

  • Run visa and mobility operations end-to-end: sponsorships, relocations, compliance, right-to-work controls, and coordination with immigration advisers.

  • Manage commission review, approvals, exceptions, ns and payment accuracy each cycle; reconcile commission data between sales systems, Finance, and payroll

  • Own equity grant administration: approvals, documentation, vesting schedules, leaver events, exercises, cap table reconciliation and employee communications

  • Build and improve people workflows in Humans, Ashby and connected systems, using automation to remove manual steps from pay reviews, promotion packs, onboarding and routine queries.

  • Own onboarding, probation, employment changes, transfers, parental leave, and offboarding end-to-end: coordinate access, equipment, payroll and documentation across People, IT, Finance and hiring managers

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • 5+ years of People Operations or HR generalist experience in a scaling technology business or high-growth scaleup, with meaningful hands-on work in payroll, mobility, PEOs and benefits

  • Track record of building and running multi-country people processes from the ground up, not just maintaining existing structures.

  • Confidence owning payroll controls, global mobility operations and equity administration across multiple jurisdictions

  • Strong data literacy and experience with HRIS platforms, payroll systems and ATS integrations, with a bias toward automation over manual work

  • Clear written communicator who can produce clean documentation and audit-ready records

Valued

  • Experience independently owning multi-country payroll, mobility and equity through a scale up's growth phase.

  • Familiarity with PEO relationships, renewals and service management

  • Experience with commission administration and pooling

How We Work

We're an office-first team in London. You'll be based at our offices on Paul Street and expect to work in-office as your default. We work together because it helps us move faster, collaborate closely across Finance, IT and People, and stay sharp on detail.

This role sits at the center of trust for the whole company. We expect high standards of accuracy, timeliness and data integrity. You'll manage sensitive information and ensure payments, visas, and equity records are handled properly.

People will come to you with urgent requests and competing priorities. You need to stay organised, keep control of your workload, and know when to push back and when to escalate. This isn't a role for someone who needs a heavy process or lots of direction.

  

Why Wordsmith

We're scaling fast across product, commercial, and engineering, and People operations is foundational to that growth. Every new hire adds complexity to payroll, visas, benefits, and equity. Getting that right, automated, ed and audit-ready is what lets us move quickly without losing control.

This role is a key foundational hire. You'll be building the systems and processes that scale with us from ~130 people toward 300. You'll have real ownership over how the function works, and a clear seat in how we operate.

You'll report to our Head of People (or interim People leader, with a clear line to a future Head of People), work closely with Finance and leadership, and have meaningful say in how we run the function.

descriptionHtml:

Du analysierst die Performance komplexer Power-Platform-Lösungen, optimierst Prozesse und sorgst für die Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Compliance-Richtlinien.

Darauf aufbauend entwickelst du skalierbare technische Designs und leitest die Umsetzung.
