title: Senior Software Engineer — ML Inference & Numerics
descriptionHtml:
About Tensordyne

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

Help make the latest AI models run well on our silicon. You'll work from model code to measured hardware performance: bring up new architectures, track down accuracy failures, and improve latency, throughput, and memory use.

The bigger challenge is making that work repeatable. You'll build an agentic harness that can explore implementations, run experiments, check results, and guide the next change. Every investigation should leave behind better software, better tests, and a shorter path for the next model.

We're looking for an excellent software engineer who understands LLM inference deeply and knows how to put coding agents to work. You'll own substantial parts of our SDK and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your particular focus will be numerical optimization: finding where precision matters, where computation can be cheaper, and how to preserve model quality.

What you'll do

  • Build the agentic workflows. Give agents the tools to inspect models, change implementations and numerical settings, run emulation and hardware experiments, and diagnose failures. Build the feedback and evaluation that make the results trustworthy.
  • Bring up new models quickly; make them go brrrr. Work with engineers across the stack to take unfamiliar architectures from reference code to validated, performant execution on our accelerator. Turn what you learn into reusable model support and SDK improvements.
  • Optimize numerics. Explore precision, accumulation, and quantization choices across the model. Understand how they interact with kernels, KV caches, memory, and distributed execution, then measure the gains in latency, throughput, and memory use against model quality on silicon.
  • Make numerical quality measurable. Build conversion and emulation software that lets you test numerical choices quickly. Compare activations and outputs against reference models, trace accuracy regressions to their source, and validate changes with end-to-end model evaluations.
  • Ship software that lasts. Own design, implementation, testing, and delivery. Build clear APIs that are easy to use for agents. Make difficult bugs reproducible and keep them from returning. Know when to build fast, and when to build thoroughly.
  • Shape the next chip. Work with hardware architects to test how numerical formats and arithmetic choices affect real models. Turn those findings into better hardware and algorithm designs.

What we need from you

  • You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model's implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention, KV caches, MoE, batching, and parallelism. You understand how these translate into compute, memory, and communication on an accelerator.
  • You build excellent software. You've owned substantial systems and delivered complex features from design through production. You're strong in Python, thoughtful about interfaces, and rigorous about abstractions and testing.
  • You are fluent with agentic tooling. You'd rather build the agent that runs the optimization than doing it by hand; and running numerous agents in parallel excites you. You know what is required for agents to work effectively in a large software organization, and you have the judgement when an agentic loop still needs a human.
  • You take ownership and bring others along. You form clear hypotheses, test them, and drive problems to resolution across software boundaries. You communicate clearly through specs, design docs, and reviews that people and agents can act on. You explain complex trade-offs, give direct feedback, and make the people around you better.

If you tick a few of these boxes, we'd love to hear from you.

We'd be thrilled if you had

  • Expertise in improving inference systems like debugging and optimizing the runtime of complex models and reasoning about accuracy-performance trade-offs.
  • Experience with ML compilers, accelerator SDKs, or model compression libraries, particularly for non-NVIDIA accelerators such as TPU, Trainium/Inferentia, Tenstorrent, Groq, or Cerebras.
  • Experience with model quantization, sparsity, codebooks, low-rank factorization or other compression techniques.
  • Contributions to distributed inference or serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.

Why join us

Your code will help determine how quickly we support new models, how efficiently they run, and what we build into our next chip. You'll own meaningful software, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon.

If you want to build the tools, solve the hard failures, and help set the engineering direction of a new inference platform, we'd like to hear from you.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other's differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.

A Senior Staff Engineer at Monzo is a hands on engineering leadership (IC) position. As a Senior Staff Engineer you’ll:

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.

title: Senior Staff Security Engineer, AI Security
descriptionHtml:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

As a Senior Staff Security Engineer focused on AI Security, you will be Ripple's deepest technical expert at the intersection of artificial intelligence and security. This is a purpose-built, high-impact individual contributor role that spans two critical mandates: securing AI systems that Ripple builds and operates, and harnessing AI to make Ripple's security function faster, smarter, and more scalable.

You will lead the technical strategy for AI security across the agentic SDLC, define and operationalize guardrails for LLM and agentic AI adoption, and build AI-powered security tooling in close partnership with the broader organization to embed AI security into how Ripple operates every day. You will also shape Ripple's external posture on AI security, contributing to industry standards, regulatory discussions, and Ripple's published security practices.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Drive the AI Security technical strategy and roadmap, defining how Ripple secures its AI systems, governs agentic workflows, and embeds security controls into the AI development lifecycle from day one.
  • Design and implement security controls for LLM-integrated and agentic AI systems, including sandboxing, identity and permission scoping, runtime monitoring, and containment of autonomous agent actions that exceed authorized scope.
  • Own AI security across the Controlled Agentic SDLC, establishing security guardrails, AI provenance standards, dual-review requirements, and audit trail controls for AI-assisted development across Ripple Engineering.
  • Lead the security review and risk assessment of all AI integrations entering production, including LLM APIs, SaaS copilots, AI code editors, agentic workflows, third-party MCP servers, and vendor-embedded AI.
  • Build and scale Ripple's Shadow AI detection capability, surfacing unsanctioned AI usage, driving adoption of the AI acceptable use policy, and ensuring all AI workflows operate within Ripple's auditable perimeter.
  • Serve as Ripple's go-to technical resource on agentic AI risks, including MCP server security, tool poisoning, prompt injection at the orchestration layer, and excessive agency in multi-agent systems, translating emerging threats into concrete mitigations with Engineering and Product.
  • Shape Ripple's external AI security posture, contributing to industry frameworks, engaging regulators, and publishing research that establishes Ripple as a credible voice in responsible AI security. 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 10+ years of Security Engineering experience with demonstrated depth in at least two domains, such as Product Security, Cloud Security, or Security Operations, and meaningful hands-on exposure to AI or ML security in practice.
  • Solid understanding of AI and LLM security concepts, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data poisoning, model extraction, RAG manipulation, and agentic risks such as tool poisoning, excessive agency, and MCP server vulnerabilities.
  • Experience securing agentic AI systems, including sandboxing, permission scoping, human-in-the-loop design, or runtime monitoring for autonomous workflows.
  • Fluency with core Security Engineering domains including cloud security on AWS, GCP, or Azure, CI/CD pipeline security, container and Kubernetes security, IAM, and API security, with the ability to reason about how these apply in AI-specific contexts.
  • Strong threat modeling instincts, whether using STRIDE, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM Top 10, or your own approach, and comfort applying frameworks to architectures where the playbook remains in development.
  • Experience in FinTech, crypto, or other highly regulated environments is a strong plus, ideally with exposure to frameworks like NYDFS, MAS, DORA, or SOC 2 as they relate to AI adoption.
  • Proven ability to work across teams, influence technical direction without direct authority, and bring structure to problems that span Engineering, Product, and Security.
  • A genuine builder's mentality. You are energized by problems without established playbooks, comfortable building in ambiguity, and motivated by raising the bar in an area that is still being defined.

Other common names for this role: AI Security Architect, LLM Security Engineer, Agentic AI Security Lead

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.

  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

descriptionHtml:
The Robotics and Mechatronics Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a (Senior) Systems and Safety Engineer (m/f/d), who will own system-level engineering and functional safety for our robot. You'll decide whether a design is safe enough to ship, since missing a hazard here risks real injury.

Responsibilities

  • Requirements Management: Elicit, write, review, and manage system, subsystem, and safety requirements with full traceability, keeping requirements, architecture, implementation, and verification artifacts linked across the system lifecycle.
  • System Architecture: Define, maintain, and review system and subsystem architecture, including interfaces, functional decomposition, and requirements allocation across the system.
  • Hazard & Safety Analysis: Perform hazard analysis, risk assessment, and failure analysis (FMEA, FMEDA, fault tree analysis where applicable), and define the safety concepts, safety functions, and fault reaction strategies that follow from it.
  • Certification Work Products: Develop and maintain the safety and systems engineering work products required for certification, including the safety plan, verification and validation plan, and system architecture documentation.
  • Cross-Team Coordination: Work across hardware, software, mechanical, and test teams to keep the system coherent, safety-compliant, and fully covered by traceable requirements.

Skills

  • Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field.
  • Systems & Safety Experience: Experience applying systems engineering and functional safety practices to complex electromechanical systems.
  • Failure Analysis Techniques: Hands-on experience conducting FMEA, FMEDA, or fault tree analysis to identify and assess system hazards.
  • Safety Standards: Solid understanding of machinery and robot safety standards, including ISO 10218, ISO 13849, IEC 61508, IEC 60204, IEC 61800, and IEC 61010.
  • Schematics & Firmware Literacy: Ability to read and understand electronic schematics and related firmware at a system level.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Cosuno

Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling our Engineering, AI and Product teams with that capital. That is where you come in.

Your mission

As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech, you make sure every seat in Engineering and Product goes to someone exceptional. You report to Maximilian Seifert (CTO) and work closely with Carmen Pölking (Head of Product). Engineers trust you to tell them honestly what a role at Cosuno looks like, and our tech leads trust you to bring them people who raise the bar.

What you will achieve in your first year

  • You hire 25 people across Software Engineering, Product Management and Product Design, owning every process from intake to signed contract.

  • You build warm pipelines of senior engineers before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies.

  • Together with our tech leads, you design structured, scorecard-based interview loops, from technical screening to final interview.

  • You put Cosuno on the map in the Berlin and European tech community, through referrals, meetups and content with our engineers.

  • You advise on levelling, compensation and market trends, so our offers win.

  • You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire.

What the job really looks like

  • The best engineers rarely apply. Most of your hires come from your own outreach, so a large part of your week is sourcing and candidate conversations.

  • You compete with big tech and AI companies for the same people, and you need a compelling story to win them.

  • You talk shop with engineers. You do not need to code, but you understand what a TypeScript full-stack role or an ML engineering role really involves.

  • There is no large TA team and no finished playbook. You build the processes while you hire.

  • You push back when a profile, a process or a decision is not right. We want you to.

What you bring

  • At least 4 years of recruiting experience, of which at least 2 years in-house at a high-growth tech company, hiring software engineers.

  • A track record you can prove in numbers: hires made, time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate. You steer your pipeline by data, not gut feeling.

  • Technical fluency: you understand modern tech stacks and roles (full-stack, backend, AI/ML, platform) well enough to assess candidates and challenge hiring managers.

  • Proven technical sourcing skills across LinkedIn, GitHub and tech communities, including Boolean and X-ray searches.

  • Structured assessment: you have built interview loops with engineering teams and keep them fair, fast and consistent.

  • Strong closing skills: you win engineers against competing offers, including from big tech and AI companies.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have

  • German language skills.

  • Experience hiring AI/ML engineers.

  • Experience with cross-border hiring in Europe, including Employer of Record set-ups.

  • Hands-on experience with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay or Lusha.

  • Curiosity about construction or other traditional industries.

What we offer

  • Salary: €70,000–90,000 gross base salary per year, depending on experience, plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period.

  • AI at the core: you work with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter and you have a budget to test new tools.

  • Learning budget for your professional development.

  • Time off: 25 vacation days per year, rising by one day for each year with Cosuno up to a maximum of 28 days. On top of that, 24 and 31 December are always off.

  • Flexibility: fully remote within Germany or from our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg, with flexible hours.

  • Top equipment: a new MacBook Air.

  • A great team: open and international, with regular off-sites and team events.

  • Stability: permanent contract in a well-funded company.

Our hiring process (max. 4 weeks)

  1. Intro call with Vivien (People Lead), 30 minutes, video.

  2. Live Case Study with one of our Engineers, 60 minutes.

  3. Career deep-dive with Maximilian Seifert (CTO) and Carmen Pölking (Head of Product), followed by a conversation about our culture and values with Vivien Littmann (People Lead), 60 minutes in total.

  4. References: with your consent only, we speak with 1 or 2 hiring managers you have recruited for in previous roles.

From your first call to our decision, the process takes no longer than 4 weeks.


Your contact: Vivien Littmann, People Lead

title: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01
descriptionHtml:
Shift Supervisor | DSL-01

Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten.

 

Over de functie

Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie.

Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES.

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar):

  • Werk je in dagdienst

  • Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01

  • Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies

  • Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators

  • Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie

  • Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek.

In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028):

  • Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces.

  • Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta.

  • Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren.

 

Jouw profiel

SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

  • Ervaring en affiniteit met Procestechniek, Chemische Technologie of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Minimaal een afgeronde VAPRO C of AOT niveau 4-opleiding

  • Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de chemische, petrochemische, raffinage- of vergelijkbare procesindustrie

  • Aantoonbare operationele leidinggevende ervaring en bewezen people development skills

  • Ervaring met procesautomatisering en het werken met DCS- en MES-systemen

  • Kennis van procesveiligheid, werkvergunningensystemen en relevante wet- en regelgeving

  • Ervaring met het nemen van operationele beslissingen in situaties waar veiligheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit samenkomen

Welkome extra kennis en ervaring:

  • Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten

  • Ervaring met commissioning, startup en operational readiness

  • Kennis van raffinage-, hydroprocessing- of duurzame brandstofprocessen

  • Ervaring met continue verbeterprogramma's en performance management

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen wij aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Waarom deze rol?

Deze functie biedt een kans die maar weinig operators en shift supervisors krijgen. Je bent vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij de realisatie van een compleet nieuwe fabriek en kunt jouw operationele expertise inzetten om invloed uit te oefenen op commissioning, procedures, opleidingen en de uiteindelijke manier van werken.

Na de opstart maak je de stap naar een operationele omgeving waarin je leiding geeft aan een moderne productie-installatie en een belangrijke rol speelt in het neerzetten van de standaarden, cultuur en prestaties van de fabriek.

Tegelijkertijd draag je direct bij aan de realisatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken. Een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuwe productieorganisatie én een tastbare bijdrage te leveren aan de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

NB: Voor de opbouw van de operationele organisatie zoeken we uiteindelijk vijf Shift Supervisors. De eerste twee Supervisors starten tijdens de project- en opstartfase van DSL-01. De overige drie posities worden naar verwachting in het voorjaar ingevuld, zodat het volledige team gereed is voor de operationele fase. ‌

 

Solliciteer

Wil jij meewerken aan de succesvolle realisatie van een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart.

NB: Een medische keuring maakt vanwege veiligheids- en gezondheidsredenen onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure voor deze functie. ‌

 

Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com.

📌 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

SkyNRG is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken.

Compensation: €4,583 – €6,000 per month

title: Signal & Power Integrity Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the Role 

You’ll help specialists shape requirements, design margins and acceptance criteria across silicon, package, PCB and system boundaries. Your team’s constraints and verification evidence will help design owners make informed trade-offs before problems become harder to resolve.

You’ll line-manage engineers, shape their development, agree achievable delivery commitments, and plan for tools, licences and compute capacity. You’ll coordinate analysis and hardware correlation, ensuring discrepancies receive specialist attention and integrity issues reach review and closure.

The methods and knowledge your team builds will outlast individual designs, strengthening how Graphcore approaches future signal and power challenges. Grow your leadership across interconnected engineering disciplines, combining people development with judgement that influences hardware from architecture to bring-up.

The team and culture

Signal and power integrity specialists retain technical ownership, rather than relying on one person to solve every problem. You’ll connect their work with design, firmware, test, bring-up and manufacturing colleagues.

Programme management owns the integrated plan. You’ll raise capacity conflicts early, bring practical options and make delivery confidence visible.

Decisions depend on evidence, documented assumptions and proportionate peer review. You’ll encourage challenge, seek specialist input when needed and escalate unresolved disagreements before they hold work back.

What we’re looking for

  • People leadership that develops engineers, sets expectations and addresses difficult performance issues, with readiness for formal line management.
  • Strong engineering foundations and experience in signal or power integrity, with sufficient understanding of the other discipline to challenge approaches.
  • Experience coordinating specialist engineering delivery, including estimates, work allocation, dependencies and capacity, in partnership with programme management.
  • Clear cross-disciplinary communication that explains risks and trade-offs, secures specialist contributions and helps stakeholders reach decisions.
  • First-principles reasoning and understanding of simulation, measurement and correlation, including model limitations and when to seek specialist review.
  • Evidence of improving engineering methods or shared knowledge, while maintaining clear ownership through technical investigations.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

Ready to lead the specialists behind reliable AI compute hardware? Apply for the Signal and Power Integrity senior manager role in Bristol.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
descriptionHtml:
About Clear Street:

Clear Street’s mission is to give every sophisticated investor access to every asset, in every market, through a unified platform built for speed, transparency and scale.
We give our clients the technology, tools, and service once reserved for the largest institutions, rebuilt with modern infrastructure. Our single, cloud-native, end-to-end capital markets platform powers investor growth today and is transforming how they can interact with markets tomorrow.

For more information, visit https://clearstreet.io.

The Role


As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)  you sit at the intersection of software reliability and operational excellence. You own the health, resilience, and recovery of our production systems—while spending equal energy innovating solutions that eliminate human toil, reduce incident blast radius, and raise the reliability bar across the entire platform.  You will partner closely with engineering, operations, and business teams to understand daily pain points and translate them into lasting automated solutions. Half your time is spent in the trenches—supporting production, responding to incidents, and deeply understanding how our
systems behave under real conditions. The other half is yours to build: automation, tooling, and observability platforms that make tomorrow's on-call shift meaningfully easier than today's.  


You will work on challenges like:


● Design and build comprehensive monitoring and observability platforms that surface the right signal at the right time—eliminating alert fatigue and accelerating root-cause analysis.
● Develop intelligent automation and self-healing capabilities that diagnose issues, trigger recovery workflows, and reduce mean time to recovery (MTTR) without manual intervention.
● Analyze incidents, identify systemic trends, and engineer solutions that prevent entire classes of failures from recurring.
● Build reusable runbooks, diagnostic tooling, and recovery playbooks that turn tribal knowledge into scalable platform capabilities.
● Create golden-path operational workflows—making the safest, most reliable path also the easiest one for engineering teams to follow.
● Partner with Platform Engineering to influence CI/CD pipelines, deployment safety, and infrastructure resilience from a production reliability perspective.
● Champion Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and SRE best practices while helping teams adopt modern engineering workflows.
● Continuously measure production health through SLIs/SLOs/SLAs, and drive engineering priorities based on reliability data.
● Explore emerging technologies—including AI-assisted diagnostics and developer tooling—that transform how we operate production systems.

The Team


We believe resilient systems are built by engineers who understand them end to end.  Our Production Engineering team is the first and last line of defense for our production platform.  We treat reliability as a product, with uptime and engineer experience as our north stars. We combine the discipline of SRE with a builder's mindset: when we see a recurring problem, we build a solution—not a workaround.


You will work across every engineering and operations team to understand failure modes, quantify reliability gaps, and build platform capabilities that scale with the organization. Whether it's reducing MTTR from hours to minutes, building self-service diagnostic tools, or designing proactive alerting that catches issues before customers notice, your work will have immediate, measurable impact.


If you're passionate about making production systems invisible to end users—and you get energy from both firefighting and building the systems that make fires less likely—you'll thrive here.

What We're Looking For


We're looking for engineers who combine operational instinct with a builder's discipline.


You should have:
● Strong hands-on Python skills—this is your primary language for automation and tooling.
● Experience in SRE, Production Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related discipline with direct production ownership.
● Proven track record of building automation and diagnostic tooling that improved recovery times or reduced operational toil.
● Deep familiarity with cloud-native technologies—Kubernetes, containers, distributed systems—and how they fail in production.
● Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, and a strong intuition for what "good" monitoring looks like.
● Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and GitOps-based deployment workflows (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, or similar).
● Familiarity with the broader technology stack: Java, Go, Kafka, Redis, Snowflake, and Postgres.
● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills—you thrive on ambiguous, high-stakes production problems.
● A product mindset applied to operational tooling: you think about usability, adoption, and documentation when building internal solutions.
● Excellent communication skills and the ability to work fluidly across engineering, operations, and business stakeholders.
● Self-starter mentality—you identify opportunities, take initiative, and deliver with minimal supervision.
● Curiosity and a continuous learning mindset; fintech or financial industry background is a plus.

The Technology You'll Work With


You'll operate and build on a modern cloud-native platform that includes:

● Kubernetes & AWS
● Terraform & ArgoCD
● GitHub Actions
● Kafka, Redis
● PostgreSQL & Snowflake
● Datadog
● Python, Go, Java
● gRPC & Protobuf
● Internal Platform APIs and Developer Tooling

What Success Looks Like


Within your first year, you'll have made a measurable impact on production reliability. Success looks like:


● Reducing mean time to detection (MTTD) and mean time to recovery (MTTR) across key production systems.
● Building automation that handles a meaningful percentage of incident scenarios without human intervention.
● Becoming a trusted subject matter expert for core platform components and their failure modes.
● Delivering observability and diagnostic tools that other engineers actually use and depend on.
● Establishing SLO baselines and driving engineering investment based on reliability data.
● Spending less of your time—and your teammates time—on repetitive manual toil.


Your impact won't be measured by the number of incidents you respond to—it will be measured by how reliably our systems run and how quickly we recover when they don't.

title: Social & Follower - Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting), with 25+ nationalities and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our collective travel belts. What we have in common, beyond very well-worn passports, is this: We want to change the way people travel. That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning.

 

Your expedition: Product & Growth

 

This role is about the heartbeat of Polarsteps, the social layer that keeps travelers connected to the people who care about their journeys. You'll own the Social & Follower experience. Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. You are responsible for the engagement mechanics; think about how to make followers feel involved, not just informed, turning a passive audience into a real homefront community.

 

While innovating on this engagement, you will also be owning one of the most important growth loops of our business: the social viral loop. Here you'll be working closely working together with other teams that use the share flow, while also closely collaborating with our Growth & Marketing team who are in contact with resources like our Polarsteps Pioneers.

 

The social viral loop is one of Polarsteps' core growth engines, and it deserves both love (features that make sharing feel fun and effortless - like our route sharing feature) and brains (the thinking to optimize the numbers behind it). This is a role for someone who gets excited about optimizing the % in a growth loop and, in parallel, wants to grow product strategy skills on an important part of the travel experience while delivering a great experience to users.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

You will:

  • Own the Social & Follower experience end-to-end, from sharing functionality and growth loops to follower engagement features, likes, comments, and trip interaction.

  • Drive growth for key metrics: MAU, sharing rates, and social engagement, setting the bar and holding yourself to it.

  • Design and run experiments to validate ideas fast. You won't guess when you can test.

  • Work hand-in-hand with Growth & Marketing to align product initiatives with acquisition and retention goals, no silos, just shared wins.

  • Translate messy, complex problems into small, testable stories, making outcomes clear for everyone on the team.

  • Celebrate the small wins as much as the big ones. Incremental progress is still progress.

The equipment in your backpack

What we're hoping you'll bring with you.

✅ 5+ years of PM experience, ideally with time spent in a Growth PM role

✅ Genuinely data fluent; you move from hypothesis to experiment to decision without losing momentum. You treat every dataset as a chance to get sharper, not just to confirm what you already know.

✅ A solid understanding of UX/UI and creating a great (app) experience to drive product growth

✅ Experience working on app-first consumer products (B2C is your world)

✅ Growth and marketing-minded, you understand funnels, loops, and what makes people come back

✅ Humble, collaborative, and energized by team wins, this role doesn't work in a silo

✅ Bonus: experience with social or community features, or products where sharing is core to the experience

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 70.000 - 80.000 (medior level) and EUR 85.000 - 95.000 (senior level) gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, to be evaluated during the interview process.

  • Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your Zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. title: Social Media Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🖌 Our Marketing team

No one is more creative and data-driven than this team, they have the best of both worlds!

The Marketing team's main mission is to get our product into the hearts of millions of users around the world.

The Growth team builds innovative ideas to conquer markets, attract, and retain users.

The Brand team strives to create Joko's vision for the long term and builds a connection with all its users.

The B2B Marketing team positions Joko as the top partner to have in our space and aims to build the most desired employer brand possible.

Led by Isa, our CMO, they are constantly innovating to take our business to new heights.

🎯 What you will do

At Joko, our goal is to turn social media into a primary engine for brand awareness and user acquisition. As our Social Media Manager, you won’t just manage an inbox; you will own the strategic distribution of Joko’s voice across the digital landscape.

You will bridge the gap between creative production and algorithmic performance. Using a data-first approach and cutting-edge AI tools, you will ensure that every piece of content we produce achieves maximum reach and resonates with our target audience.

You report to Luisa our Head of Brand & Communications will work closely with the whole Marketing team to translate insights, trends, and performance signals into a high-performing social media strategy.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and execute Joko’s social media growth and distribution strategy: You’ll design and run a multi-channel strategy across platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook to maximize reach, engagement, and positive brand sentiment.

  • Master platform algorithms and distribution mechanics: You’ll continuously test formats, hooks, posting cadence, and platform-native features to improve organic reach and ensure every piece of content performs at its highest potential.

  • Implement AI-powered community operations: You’ll deploy and manage automation tools to handle routine community interactions such as DMs, FAQs, and tagging while maintaining Joko’s tone of voice.

  • Act as the human-in-the-loop for high-impact interactions: You’ll step in during sensitive conversations, viral moments, and interactions with brand advocates to ensure thoughtful and on-brand responses.

  • Anticipate trends and cultural shifts: You’ll actively monitor social platforms and emerging conversations to identify opportunities for Joko to participate early and stand out.

  • Translate trends into actionable creative direction: You’ll turn social insights and cultural signals into clear briefs for the Content Creator to ensure our output remains relevant, distinctive, and thumb-stopping.

  • Own social media performance and insights: You’ll manage our social media dashboards, track advanced performance indicators such as share of voice, virality, and assisted conversions, and provide actionable insights to guide our content strategy.

  • Expand Joko’s social media ecosystem: You’ll develop initiatives that amplify our reach beyond owned channels, including creator collaborations, ambassador programs, and proactive brand participation in key social conversations.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: At least 5y experience in Social Media Strategy, Growth Marketing, or Brand Management, preferably in a fast-paced B2C startup or top-tier agency.

  • Strategic Mindset: You don't just "post content", you understand how a TikTok video fits into a 12-month brand vision.

  • AI Savvy: You are excited about using AI to automate the boring parts of the job so you can focus on the big picture.

  • Data Literacy: You are comfortable with data visualization tools and can turn a spreadsheet of metrics into a compelling narrative for the CMO.

  • Editorial Excellence: Native in French and perfect English proficiency. You have a "social-first" writing style (witty, concise, and perfectly aligned with Joko's DNA).

  • Project Leadership: Ability to lead a content calendar and coordinate between the Creative, Growth, and Brand teams without losing sight of deadlines.

  • Growth Instinct: You are obsessed with virality mechanics and have a proven track record of growing accounts or launching successful social campaigns.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €54K – €87K • Offers Equity

descriptionHtml:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Social Media who will own the shaping and execution of our UK social media strategy and lead social media managers across all European markets where Wellhub operates. As the most senior Social Media professional in Europe, you'll be the regional lead for the team and the primary social media partner for senior stakeholders.In this role, you'll partner closely with our Senior Director of Global Social Media to bring the UK strategy to life—creating platform-specific content, developing cultural relevance, supporting local influencer and ambassador programs, and elevating Wellhub's presence across key platforms like Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging channels.You're someone who lives and breathes social. You have a video-first mindset and love being behind—and occasionally in front of—the camera.You'll combine hands-on UK ownership with European team management, stakeholder leadership, and accountability for regional alignment and performance. Your creativity, agility, and understanding of UK social trends will shape how consumers, partners, and companies experience Wellhub.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Shape and Execute the UK Social Media Strategy.
  • Shape, localize, and operationalize Wellhub's social media strategy for the UK market.

  • Support country leaders and internal spokespeople with social content, thought leadership, and engagement guidance.
  • Own Measurement Optimisation and Insights.
  • Track and report on performance metrics across awareness, engagement, growth, and sentiment.Test new formats, creative variations, and posting strategies to continuously improve results.
  • Conduct social listening to understand audience behavior and guide content direction.
  • Review performance across European markets with local social managers and turn shared learnings into regional recommendations and improvements.
  • Community Engagement and Brand Advocacy
  • Oversee proactive community management across the UK channels—engaging in conversations, responding to comments, and cultivating brand advocates.
  • Ensure alignment with global crisis and response protocols.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have 7+ years of experience in social media, content creation, or digital marketing—ideally in fast-moving B2C or lifestyle brands.
  • You're fluent in UK social culture, humor, trends, and how different audiences behave online.
  • You have excellent English writing and editorial skills.
  • You're a video-first creator who is comfortable planning, shooting, editing—and occasionally stepping in front of the camera.
  • You're obsessed with social platforms: their algorithms, nuances, and emerging formats.
  • You understand how to speak to diverse audiences—consumers, HR leaders, corporate buyers, wellness partners.

  • You have experience managing and developing social media teams across markets, with the judgement and autonomy to serve as the senior regional lead.

  • You're proactive, curious, and passionate about wellbeing and digital storytelling.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Focused Energy’s Software Department builds the internal applications, data workflows, system integrations and automation that help our scientists, finance, legal, people and executive teams work faster and more reliably. As a Software Engineer in our forward deployed model, you will join projects where Focused Energy has an important technical or operational need, understand the context, build and deliver a reliable solution, complete a clean handover, and then move on to the next priority.

You will quickly learn several project domains across fusion systems, finance, legal and executive work, and you will own moderately complex features from design to deployment. You will be a go-to engineer for turning cross-functional needs into maintainable software, raising the standard for internal tools, and helping us reuse shared platforms and patterns.

You will see your work directly shape how fusion research and company operations run. You will gain broad exposure to scientific, hardware, operational and business problems, and you will take ownership from day one.

What You'll Do

  • Move between projects after delivering agreed outcomes, leaving software tested, documented, maintainable and ready for its long-term owner.

  • Improve code quality, remove small areas of technical debt, contribute to code reviews, and reuse shared platforms and patterns where they fit.

  • Learn several project domains quickly, deliver your first end-to-end features, and establish a reliable routine for testing, documentation and handover.

  • Take on broader and less clearly defined projects, help standardize how internal software is built, secured and operated, and become a trusted partner for teams across the company.

Who You Are

  • You can independently own well-scoped work, with support available for broader architecture or highly unclear decisions.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including readable code, data structures, debugging, automated testing, version control and code review, with evidence of delivered working software.

  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, role-based access and secure data handling.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD, package management, basic infrastructure configuration and automated build, test and deployment workflows.

  • Ability to use tests, logs, metrics and traces to find problems and confirm that software works as expected.

Nice-to-haves

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Software Engineer

Location: Bristol, London or Edinburgh (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Engineer I – Engineer II

Team: Engineering

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Software Engineering Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

The role

You’ll join the Kaluza Technology community: a large team of product-focused and data-led Product and Platform Engineers working at serious scale. Our ecosystem is diverse depending on the team, spanning TypeScript on AWS, Go on GCP, and Scala, so we care more about how you think through a problem than which language you learned it in. As a Software Engineer you’ll work in a product team on real features from your first weeks: shaping them with product and design, building them, shipping them, and learning to run them in production, with support at every step.

Engineers at Kaluza build with AI, and we mean that practically. From day one you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and we’ll teach you how we use it: planning work for agents, reviewing what they produce, and understanding every line that lands with your name on it. We care more about your judgement than your typing speed, and we’ll help you build both.

What you’ll do

  • Build real product features from your first weeks: pick up well-shaped work in a product team, grow into shaping it yourself, and see it through to production.

  • Work across the stack over time: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.

  • Build with AI coding agents, and understand what they produce: break work down so an agent can take it, review the result as carefully as a colleague’s PR, and be able to explain every line you merge. We’ll teach you our way of working with them.

  • Learn the systems you run: instrument what you ship, watch how it behaves in production, and shadow the on-call rota before you join it.

  • Stay close to the people who use what you build: a supplier’s operations team, a customer plugging in a car at night. Ask why, and bring what you learn back to the team.

  • Improve how the team works: tests, checks, docs and shared context that make the next person’s job easier, including the agents’.

What you’ll bring

These are the foundations and habits we see in engineers who do well here. Nobody arrives with all of them, and the junior end of this role exists so people can grow into them. If you’re excited by the role and can see yourself here, apply.

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Solid foundations in one part of a modern stack: TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Scala, Python or similar, from work, study or things you’ve built yourself, and an appetite to learn the rest.

  • Curiosity about how systems fail: you’d rather find out why a service fell over than restart it, and you want to learn how to design for that.

  • Comfort with code you didn’t write: you can read it, test it and explain what it does before you change it, whether a person or an agent wrote it.

  • An interest in the people who use the product: you ask who it’s for and how you’ll know it worked.

  • Clear writing: a PR description or a short note that a teammate (or an agent) could act on without asking you.

  • The habit of learning out loud: you ask questions early, share what you learn, and give and take feedback well.

Nice to have: Some experience with AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar but don’t worry if not, we’ll teach you our way of working with them over time.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

title: Software Engineer - Video Streaming
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

About GDFT 

Gaming, Developer, and Future Technology (GDFT) are the technology specialists at PlayStation. We build the underlying systems that power core platform capabilities and developer tools. Our mission is to enable world-class gaming experiences by delivering low-level, high-performance technology for PlayStation platforms. 

The Role 

We are looking for an engineer to join the GDFT department, working on the design and optimisation of PlayStation’s real-time game streaming technologies. 

You will contribute to the development of low-latency video streaming systems across current and future PlayStation platforms, working on performance-critical areas spanning frame capture, media pipelines, codec configuration, system services and streaming transport. 

The role is particularly suited to engineers with a strong C/C++ background and experience working with native video or media systems, including embedded devices, TV firmware, set-top boxes, consoles, or similar. 

Our work sits at the intersection of product engineering and R&D. Alongside delivering production technology, engineers are encouraged to investigate new approaches to reducing end-to-end latency, improving visual quality and reducing bitrate, using measurement and experimentation to determine where meaningful improvements can be made. 

 What You'll Be Doing 

  • Develop, optimise and maintain low-level C and C++ components within PlayStation’s game streaming stack. 
  • Investigate opportunities to reduce end-to-end streaming latency across frame capture, buffering, encoding, transport, decoding and presentation. 
  • Optimise the use and configuration of hardware video encoders, applying knowledge of codec behaviour and low-latency encoding techniques. 
  • Analyse existing media pipelines to identify unnecessary buffering, memory copies, synchronisation delays and other sources of latency. 
  • Use software and hardware instrumentation to measure system behaviour, validate hypotheses and quantify the impact of performance changes. 
  • Investigate and debug issues across user-space applications, system services and daemon-level components. 
  • Prototype and evaluate new approaches to improving streaming quality, latency and bandwidth efficiency. 
  • Work with engineers and researchers across the wider organisation on areas such as codec development, rate control, Forward Error Correction and emerging media technologies. 
  • Contribute technical findings and recommendations to design discussions, working with senior engineers to determine appropriate production solutions. 
  • Collaborate across teams to integrate and validate streaming technologies within PlayStation platform software. 
  • Attend periodic in-person workshops or team events, with travel possible a few times per year. 

 What We Are Looking For 

This is a mid-level opportunity. You should bring some of the following skills and experience: 

  • Strong proficiency in C and C++. 
  • Experience developing native, performance-sensitive software rather than primarily web or managed application stacks. 
  • Experience working with real-time video, media pipelines, codecs or embedded multimedia systems. 
  • Practical understanding of video compression and media formats, including concepts such as chroma subsampling, bit depth and colour representation, with familiarity of codecs such as AVC, HEVC or AV1. 
  • Understanding of concepts relevant to low-latency video encoding, which may include GOP structures, reference frames, rate control, VBV, quantisation parameters, slices, tiles or hardware codec APIs. 
  • Strong debugging, profiling and performance-analysis skills. 
  • An ability to investigate complex technical problems, identify likely causes and use evidence and instrumentation to support conclusions. 
  • Comfortable working in unfamiliar parts of a large system and developing an understanding of how multiple components interact. 
  • An experimental mindset, with an interest in prototyping, measuring and evaluating alternative technical approaches. 
  • Ability to contribute to technical discussions and work with senior engineers when deciding how findings should be taken forward. 

 Highly Desirable Skills: 

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be advantageous; we do not expect candidates to have experience across all of them: 

  • Familiarity with techniques for evaluating video codec performance, including bitrate/quality/latency trade-offs and objective or perceptual video quality metrics (such as PSNR and VMAF). 
  • Familiarity with compressed video bitstreams and codec signalling, such as NAL units/OBUs, parameter sets, profiles/levels and supplemental enhancement information. 
  • Experience developing native video players, media frameworks or codec pipelines on TVs, set-top boxes, consoles, mobile devices or other embedded platforms. 
  • Experience configuring or integrating hardware video encoders or decoders. 
  • Deeper knowledge of H.264, HEVC, AV1 or other current and emerging video codecs, beyond high-level API configuration, such as reference structures, rate-control behaviour, bitstream structure or encoder-specific optimisation. 
  • Experience optimising real-time video for low latency, visual quality or bitrate efficiency. 
  • Familiarity with frame capture, graphics presentation pipelines, framebuffers or GPU/CPU synchronisation. 
  • Experience identifying and reducing memory copies, queueing delays, memory-bandwidth limitations or other system-level performance bottlenecks. 
  • Experience working with system services, daemons, firmware interfaces or other low-level platform components. 
  • Familiarity with techniques such as content-aware encoding, region-of-interest encoding, adaptive resolution or frame rate, alternative reference-frame strategies or similar streaming optimisations. 
  • Experience with Forward Error Correction or other techniques for improving the resilience of real-time media. 
  • Experience with SIMD, vectorisation, cache optimisation or multithreaded performance tuning with instrumentation. 
  • Experience with console or embedded systems development environments. 
  • Experience with Git, Jenkins or similar CI/CD workflows. 

 Why Work in GDFT 

  • Focused on platform-wide technology development 
  • Room to explore and innovate within performance-critical system areas 
  • Work on cross-regional collaborative projects 
  • Flexible and relaxed working environment, with strong support for hybrid work 
  • Opportunities for extensive professional development, technical conference attendance, and participation in internal hackathons

title: Software Lead Engineer | NTS Eindhoven
