At NTS, we make it possible together. Technology inspires and drives us; it is our passion. Every day we work on unique solutions to complex challenges. Whether it's ultra-complex or ultra-precise solutions, we are proud of what we do and what we deliver.

Want to set the technical direction of complex software projects and guide engineering teams towards reliable, high-quality solutions? Are you passionate about software development and high-tech product development, and do you enjoy combining technical expertise with technical leadership? Then get started as Software Lead Engineer at NTS Eindhoven and let's make it possible together.

Job Description

As Software Lead Engineer/ Technical Lead at NTS Eindhoven, you set the technical direction for our software projects and coordinate the technical work of the engineers assigned to them. Working in collaborative teams of fewer than ten colleagues, you translate project objectives and complex requirements into software architecture, design decisions and executable technical plans.

This is a technical leadership role without line-management responsibility. You lead through technical direction, coordination and coaching, while the Group Lead or Competence Manager remains responsible for people management.

Our teams develop qualification tools, semiconductor equipment, defence and healthcare systems, and other advanced technology solutions. You collaborate closely with software, mechanical, electrical and mechatronics engineers to deliver integrated system solutions that meet high quality standards.

We value clear and transparent communication. You proactively identify technical risks and roadblocks, support the team in resolving challenges and ensure that solutions are delivered in line with project objectives.

Furthermore, your key responsibilities are:

  • Lead the technical side of software projects, including architecture, design and technical decision-making;

  • Coordinate the technical work of engineers allocated to your projects and ensure alignment with project plans;

  • Provide accurate technical estimates and planning input to project managers;

  • Safeguard software quality by promoting best practices, code reviews and effective test strategies;

  • Identify technical risks and roadblocks early and define and implement mitigation actions;

  • Coach and support colleagues technically, encourage knowledge sharing and contribute to continuous improvement;

  • Stay close to the code and contribute hands-on whenever required.

Job Requirements

To be successful in this role, you bring a strong combination of technical expertise, leadership capabilities and interpersonal skills. You recognise yourself in the following profile:

  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field;

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in developing technical software using C#, .NET/.NET Framework or C++ (knowledge of C is a plus);

  • Proven experience in setting technical direction, coordinating engineering activities and guiding other software engineers, with or without formal line-management responsibility;

  • Experience in UI development, for example WPF, and a strong understanding of OOP principles and UML design;

  • Experience working in an Agile development environment and with Azure DevOps or similar platforms;

  • Experience in a high-tech mechatronic environment is a strong advantage;

  • Knowledge of one or more of the following areas is a plus: databases, DevOps, test strategy, electronics or mechatronics, and computer vision;

  • Excellent communication and social skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics in an understandable way;

  • Proficient in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Dutch is a plus;

  • A proactive team player with a strong willingness to learn, develop and collaborate in the fast-evolving high-tech industry.

Your terms of employment

At NTS, we combine our passion for technology with innovative solutions to complex challenges. You get the freedom and confidence to fully use and develop your talents in a dynamic and energetic environment. We invest both in technology and in you as a future colleague!

With this challenge, we offer the following terms of employment:

  • Competitive salary;

  • A position at NTS Eindhoven, with a working week of at least 32 hours;

  • Personal growth and development opportunities, for example through training and/or education;

  • 27 vacation days and an additional 13 ADV days;

  • Excellent pension plan with PME;

  • Travel expense allowance paid monthly, with a maximum of 50 km per single journey and an allowance of €0.21 per km;

About NTS

We deliver unique solutions to complex challenges and drive technological advancement for our customers. By combining development, manufacturing and assembly, we play an integral role in bringing the supply chain together. We combine the best skills and brightest ideas into a working system for the world's most advanced Semiconductor, Opto-Mechatronics and Analytical solutions. For this reason, we have grown into a Tier-1 supplier to OEMs and an international player operating from various (production) sites in Europe, Asia and the US.

Although we offer our teams around the world a great place to work, we do not forget to remain firmly rooted locally. Ultimately, the core of NTS is our people. Their excellent manufacturing skills, customer-focused mindset and clear technical solutions have made NTS what it is today. Together, we create a culture that everyone can be proud of because we make it possible together. That's why we take every opportunity to celebrate our people, our craftsmanship and our successes.

title: Solutions Architect, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Abnormal AI is seeking a Solutions Architect, that will play a key role in the pre-sales process, serving as a technical expert and trusted advisor to prospects and customers. A primary focus of this role will be assisting organizations in transitioning from legacy Third Party Secure Email Gateways (SEGs) to Abnormal AI’s platform. You will partner with sales teams to deliver impactful presentations, lead migration planning sessions, and architect technical solutions that address complex customer requirements.

This role demands deep expertise in email systems (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Exchange on-premises) and email security technologies (legacy SEGs, API-based vendors), as well as the ability to communicate effectively with technical and business audiences. Your contributions will directly impact Abnormal’s success in strategic and large-scale opportunities.

The ideal candidate for the role will have the following skillset: 

  • Technical Expertise:
    • Deep understanding of email systems: Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Exchange on-premises.
    • Strong knowledge of Secure Email Gateways (Proofpoint, Mimecast, Barracuda) and API and Transport Rule-based vendors.
    • Expertise in email security protocols and standards, such as SPF, DKIM, DMARC, encryption, spam scanning, sandboxing and emulation.
  • Customer-Facing Skills:
    • Proven ability to earn “trusted advisor” status with large and strategic customers.
    • Exceptional presentation and communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
    • Demonstrated experience in architecting solutions for enterprise customers during pre-sales engagements.
  • Problem Solving and Leadership:
    • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in high-pressure, customer-facing scenarios.
    • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously while delivering consistent results.

What you will do 

Pre-Sales Enablement

  • Partner with sales teams to provide deep subject matter expertise (SME) on email security architectures, technologies and infrastructures.
  • Build trusted relationships with customers’ technical staff and leadership to identify pain points and align solutions with business goals.
  • Lead technical workshops, solution presentations, and roadmap discussions to drive buy-in and support for SEG displacement initiatives.
  • Architect complex, tailored solutions that address customer requirements and ensure seamless migrations to Abnormal AI.

SEG Displacement and Migration

  • Guide customers through the migration process, including evaluating their current SEG setup, identifying gaps, and creating comprehensive transition plans.
  • Act as a technical lead for SEG replacement projects, troubleshooting challenges, and ensuring a seamless transition to Abnormal’s platform.
    • You are the SME
  • Educate customers on the advantages of API-based email security and provide expert recommendations on best practices for adoption.

Product Expertise and Feedback Loop

  • Serve as a conduit between the field (sales, customers) and R&D/Product teams to provide actionable insights on customer needs, technical challenges, and feature requests.
  • Collaborate with Product Management to prioritize roadmap features based on customer feedback, opportunity size, and strategic importance.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive products, and customer challenges to position Abnormal AI effectively.

Enablement and Thought Leadership

  • Develop and deliver training sessions and technical content to upskill sales engineers and enhance their ability to handle complex customer scenarios.
  • Create repeatable and consumable technical assets, such as blog posts, videos, and presentations, that showcase your expertise and support the broader team.
  • Represent Abnormal AI at industry conferences, webinars, and customer events to share thought leadership and deepen relationships.

Must Haves 

  • Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Messaging Administrator, Google Workspace Administrator, CISSP, GIAC, or similar.
  • Familiarity with advanced email security technologies, such as Email Authentication, Sandboxing, Machine Learning, and Behavioral Analysis.
  • Experience in SEG replacement projects or equivalent migrations to API-based email security solutions.
  • Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) relevant to email security.

descriptionHtml:

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. title: Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. We are looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to join us on a permanent basis. 

Our Commerce & Technology division helps leading global brands design, build and run the commerce platforms behind their growth. We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to lead solution in business pursuits and account growth, across enterprise commerce. 

You will be the person in the room who understands how the whole commerce estate fits together, from web storefront and mobile app through commerce platform, data and ERP.   You will turn that understanding into a clear case for business value, win the trust of senior client stakeholders, and when it helps, build a working demonstration to show them what good looks like.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Architect Enterprise Commerce: Design end to end commerce solutions across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, HCL and composable (MACH) solutions, spanning web, mobile apps, data and back office systems.  
  • Lead with value: Frame every solution around commercial outcomes, cost and return, so clients can see clear cases for change rather than a technology shopping list.  
  • Serve as an outward-facing, energetic leader who runs workshops, participates in governance, and collaborates with commercial teams to identify and shape technical growth opportunities. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Client Engagement and Discovery: Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders. Run discovery workshops, ask the questions that uncover what really matters, and cut through complexity to the decisions that count. 
  • Solution Design and Architecture: Produce clear architecture diagrams and solution designs covering storefront, mobile apps, commerce platform, search, content, order management, product information, payments, data and other integrations. Recommend the right platform and approach for each client rather than defaulting to one. 
  • Platform Selection and Replatforming: Guide clients through platform choices and migrations, including the move from monolithic to composable, weighing total cost of ownership, speed to market, risk and operating model. 
  • Data, Integration and Back Office: Get into the detail of how commerce connects to ERP (such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Oracle), order management, warehouse, customer data and analytics, and design integration patterns that hold up at enterprise scale. 
  • Mobile and Omnichannel: Shape mobile app strategy and architecture (native, cross platform and headless) alongside web, store and marketplace channels, so the customer experience is joined up. 
  • Business Case and Value: Build business cases, value models and roadmaps that link technology decisions to revenue, conversion, margin and cost to serve. 
  • Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept: Stand up demo storefronts and prototypes quickly, such as a Shopify store or a composable proof of concept, to show clients what is possible and take risk out of their decisions. 
  • Proposals and Pitches: Own the solution story, architecture, assumptions and effort estimates in proposals, and present them with confidence at pitch. 
  • Handover and Delivery Assurance: Make sure what is sold can be delivered, with a clean handover to delivery teams and continued involvement through mobilisation. 
  • Market and Partner Leadership: Stay across the commerce market, including cloud (AWS, GCP), AI in commerce and agentic commerce. Share that knowledge to strengthen our propositions and our partner relationships. 

What we want from you 

  • Enterprise Commerce Experience: Extensive senior experience in enterprise commerce across retail, consumer brands or B2B, gained in digital agencies, consultancies or large brands. 
  • Breadth Across Platforms: Strong working knowledge of Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Shopify, plus composable and MACH (microservices, API first, cloud native, headless) components such as Commerce tools, Contentful, Algolia, Akeneo or similar. 
  • Presales and New Business: A track record of shaping and winning significant commerce deals, running workshops, writing proposals and presenting to senior audiences. 
  • Commercial Acumen: Understands how clients make money. Speaks confidently about value, cost and return, and can hold a commercial conversation with a Chief Executive or Chief Financial Officer as easily as with a Chief Technology Officer. 
  • Data and ERP Integration: Hands on understanding of how commerce connects with ERP, order management, product information, customer data and analytics, and the integration patterns that make it work. 
  • Mobile Apps: Solid understanding of mobile commerce app architecture and delivery, including native and cross platform approaches and how apps connect to headless commerce services. 
  • Architecture and Communication: Excellent diagramming, written and verbal skills. Able to turn complex estates into simple pictures and clear stories for senior audiences. 
  • Hands On Credibility: Comfortable building a demo store, configuring a platform or proving a concept yourself, rather than relying on slides alone. 
  • Presence: Energetic, confident and credible with clients. Able to cut through noise and lead the room. 

If you know some of this, even better 

  • Certifications across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce B2C Commerce or Shopify, MACH 
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional) and experience running commerce on Cloud solutions.  
  • Order management, product information management and marketplace platforms 
  • B2B commerce, including complex pricing, catalogue and account structures 
  • Agentic commerce concepts and emerging standards (ACP, AP2, A2A) and practical use of AI in commerce 
  • Total cost of ownership and business case modelling 
  • The C4 model and diagrams as code 

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

Permanent only

descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible depuis Paimpol)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul(e) et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

title: Sr. Compliance Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Compliance Consultant to help our clients navigate regulatory change, horizon-scan upcoming regulation, and overcome regulatory challenges so they can transform their businesses and meet their strategic growth objectives.

This is a versatile, high-impact role at the intersection of regulation, client advisory, practical delivery and product strategy. Your mission is to deeply understand our clients’ needs and regulatory obligations, and to deliver solutions that help them achieve their compliance and business outcomes. You’ll stay ahead of the risk and compliance landscape, translating regulatory change into clear guidance for our customers and concrete requirements for our Product team.

Whether you’re shaping a client’s regulatory strategy or influencing our product roadmap, you’ll bring deep knowledge and hands-on experience of financial crime compliance, along with strong commercial awareness. Acting as an in-house consultant, you’ll connect long-term regulatory horizons with granular operational realities.

 

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move comfortably between complex challenges, and have the judgement to turn them into sharp, practical solutions. You’ll also work on long-horizon strategic projects, such as building government relationships and expanding Condukt’s global data footprint, where progress is measured in weeks, not months.

If you thrive in dynamic environments where no two days look the same, enjoy tackling a constant stream of new and complex problems, and want to help shape how financial institutions and fintechs approach compliance, this role is for you.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Act as Condukt’s subject matter expert on KYB/KYC and AML/CFT, giving clients clear, commercially minded advice on their regulatory obligations

  • Lead client engagements end to end, from understanding the business challenge and assessing current controls to designing solutions that combine Condukt’s platform with third-party providers and supporting their implementation

  • Produce high-quality, client-ready deliverables, such as gap analyses, risk assessments, onboarding and monitoring frameworks, policies and decision papers

  • Run workshops with client stakeholders, from compliance teams to the C-suite, turning discussion into practical next steps

  • Horizon-scan regulation across the UK, Europe and beyond, and brief clients on what’s coming and what it means for them, directly or alongside our commercial team

  • Advise clients on their compliance stack, testing and benchmarking providers through structured, RFP-style evaluations

  • Build and maintain relationships with regulators, government bodies and company registers to secure access to data, expand Condukt’s global footprint and represent Condukt in industry forums

  • Shape Condukt’s advisory proposition, identifying emerging client needs and opportunities to bring new capabilities to existing clients alongside our commercial team

  • Partner with Product to translate regulatory and client needs into the signals, data and capabilities we build

  • Contribute to business development and thought leadership with a clear, well-argued point of view on regulation, through proposals, client pitches, whitepapers, briefings, webinars and industry events

 

What you bring:

  • 4+ years’ experience in financial crime compliance, gained in a consultancy, a regulator or a regulated financial services firm

  • Deep domain expertise in risk and compliance, ideally across KYB/KYC, AML/CFT or business onboarding in financial services

  • A track record of advising financial institutions and fintechs on risk, compliance or regulatory matters, with a toolkit of structured frameworks you can adapt to a fast-growing company

  • Experience leading client engagements and producing polished, client-ready deliverables

  • Experience advising on vendor assessment and selection, including running or contributing to RFP processes

  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with C-suite stakeholders, regulators and government agencies

  • Strong commercial awareness: you can turn regulatory requirements into solutions clients see real value in

  • A legal background, or solid working knowledge of financial regulation and how legislation translates into operational requirements

  • Sound judgement and tact in sensitive situations: you know what to communicate, to whom and when

  • The analytical rigour to dig into complex legislation and question established interpretations

  • A self-starter mindset that thrives in fast-moving, high-ownership environments

Bonus:

  • Experience in government relations or regulatory affairs

  • Prior experience in fintech, banking, payments or compliance infrastructure

  • Early-stage startup experience

  • Second language proficiency (German, French, and Dutch, especially valued)

 

Our offer:

  • Tackle meaningful problems with real-world impact

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Flat hierarchy with direct access to the founders

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Private health insurance, plus sick and compassionate leave as needed

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Staff Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 4, that looks like this:

 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 4 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

It would be great if you have:

Why this role

Dat willen we bij Dura Vermeer vastleggen in één Bouwplaatsprotocol: een praktische handleiding én visuele standaard voor de bouwplaats. Het laat zien hoe we onze bouwplaatsen herkenbaar, netjes, veilig en slim inrichten. En dat protocol ga jij helpen maken.

Dit maakt deze stage interessant:

Je zit tijdens deze stage precies tussen communicatie, ontwerp en de praktijk van de bouw in. De ene dag praat je met een uitvoerder over wat er wel en niet werkt. De volgende dag orden je alle informatie die al binnen Dura Vermeer beschikbaar is. Daarna schrijf je een richtlijn zo dat iemand hem in een paar seconden begrijpt en zet je die in Adobe InDesign om in een pagina die ook visueel klopt.

Je hoeft dus niet te kiezen tussen schrijven of ontwerpen. Je doet allebei.

Dit ga je doen:

  • bestaande richtlijnen en informatie binnen Dura Vermeer verzamelen en structureren;

  • bekijken hoe bouwplaatsen nu worden ingericht en waar collega's in de praktijk tegenaan lopen;

  • praten met uitvoerders en collega’s binnen Dura Vermeer Materieel;

  • bepalen welke onderwerpen, standaarden en middelen in het Dura Vermeer-protocol thuishoren;

  • foto's, illustraties, iconen, tabellen en andere visuele middelen maken en inzetten om informatie snel duidelijk te maken;

  • waar nodig nieuwe communicatiemiddelen of formats ontwikkelen;

  • het complete protocol vormgeven in de huisstijl van Dura Vermeer;

  • kritisch testen of iemand op de bouwplaats er ook daadwerkelijk snel mee kan werken en het protocol op basis van deze feedback verbeteren.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om na te denken over vragen als: hoe maken we een document van deze omvang prettig om te gebruiken? Wat moet je laten zien in plaats van uitleggen? Welke informatie hoort bij elkaar? Welke dingen helpen een uitvoerder echt verder?


Wat breng jij mee

Voor deze opdracht zoeken we niet alleen iemand die mooi kan vormgeven. En ook niet alleen iemand die goed kan schrijven. Juist de combinatie is belangrijk.

Jij:

  • vindt het leuk om veel informatie terug te brengen tot een logische structuur. Je kunt een technisch verhaal begrijpelijk opschrijven en hebt tegelijkertijd oog voor typografie, beeld, hiërarchie en vormgeving;

  • volgt een hbo-opleiding zoals Communicatie, Creative Business, Communication & Multimedia Design (CMD), Media & Design, Crossmedia Design, Marketingcommunicatie, Visual Communication/Graphic Design of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • schrijft helder en foutloos Nederlands;

  • kunt werken met Adobe Creative Suite;

  • kunt zelfstandig informatie ophalen, ordenen en keuzes onderbouwen;

  • vindt het leuk om collega's uit verschillende vakgebieden te spreken en hun kennis te vertalen naar een bruikbaar eindproduct.

Wat bieden wij jou

  • Een afstudeer- of meewerkstage met duidelijke opdracht en zichtbare impact;

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invulling;

  • Een stagevergoeding van € 700,- per maand;

  • Begeleiding vanuit communicatie en nauwe samenwerking met collega's uit de praktijk;

  • Een kijkje achter de schermen van de bouwplaats én de materieeldienst.

Waarom dit interessant is

Je werkt niet aan een onderzoek dat in de la verdwijnt, maar aan een product dat straks op al onze bouwplaatsen zichtbaar is. Je combineert analyse, creativiteit en praktijk en levert iets op wat direct gebruikt wordt door uitvoerders en projectteams.

title: Stage Community management (H/F/X) - Lyon
descriptionHtml:
Handicap International (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 59 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons 4000 employés dans le monde.

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap.

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux premiers entretiens.

Au sein de l’équipe communication de Handicap International France, vous participerez au développement et à l’animation des communautés de l’organisation sur les réseaux sociaux (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, etc.), en lien étroit avec le community manager et le social media manager.

Vous contribuerez à faire vivre les échanges avec les internautes, à identifier les sujets susceptibles de susciter leur intérêt et à adapter les prises de parole de l’association aux usages des différentes plateformes. Vous participerez à la recherche de nouvelles idées éditoriales, à la conception de formats adaptés aux réseaux sociaux et à la valorisation des actions de l’organisation auprès du grand public.

Vous prendrez également part à la préparation et à la coordination de la diffusion des publications, ainsi qu’à une veille sur les tendances numériques, les conversations en ligne et les initiatives d’autres acteurs du secteur. Enfin, vous contribuerez au suivi des interactions et à l’analyse des performances des contenus afin de dégager des enseignements et de proposer des pistes d’amélioration.

Ce stage vous permettra de découvrir les enjeux de l’animation de communautés numériques au sein d’une ONG internationale et de participer à des actions de communication visant à sensibiliser le public, encourager l’engagement citoyen et faire connaître les combats de Handicap International en faveur des droits des personnes handicapées et des populations vulnérables.

Activité 1 : Développement et animation des communautés en ligne Participation à l’animation des espaces d’échange de Handicap International France sur les réseaux sociaux. Identification des sujets de conversation et des besoins de la communauté, suivi des interactions et contribution à la qualité des échanges avec les internautes.

Activité 2 : Conception éditoriale et adaptation des contenus social media Contribution à la recherche d’idées et à la proposition de formats adaptés aux usages des différentes plateformes. Participation à la rédaction de publications, à la déclinaison de contenus existants et à la création de formats engageants en lien avec l’actualité, les campagnes et les missions de l’organisation.

Activité 3 : Coordination opérationnelle de la diffusion social media Participation à la préparation et à l’organisation des publications : mise à jour du calendrier éditorial, adaptation des messages aux spécificités des plateformes, préparation des éléments nécessaires à leur diffusion et suivi de leur bonne mise en ligne via Agorapulse.

Activité 4 : Veille des conversations numériques et suivi de l’engagement Observation des tendances, des pratiques des autres organisations et des discussions en ligne autour des thématiques portées par Handicap International. Contribution à l’analyse des réactions et des performances des publications, à la réalisation de bilans et à l’identification de recommandations pour améliorer les interactions et l’engagement des communautés.

Requirements

Polyvalence et technicité digitale · Excellente maîtrise grammaticale et connaissances des règles typographiques · Appétence digitale et tendances réseaux sociaux · Maîtrise des outils des plateformes (Meta Business Suite, Campaign Manager LinkedIn, YouTube Studio, TikTok, Agorapulse, par exemple) · Sensibilité graphique et sens du détail

Bonne culture générale et intérêt pour le monde de la solidarité internationale/actualité internationale

descriptionHtml:

Notre mission est d’aider les entreprises à exploiter tout le potentiel de l’IA et de la data en développant des solutions sur-mesure adaptées à leurs enjeux métiers. En tant que pionniers dans ce domaine, nous allions expertise technologique et excellence opérationnelle, en collaborant avec les plus grands acteurs du marché. Nos clients couvrent tous les secteurs clés de l’économie – industrie, retail, luxe, grande consommation, santé, finance – et incluent des grands groupes internationaux.

title: Stage duurzame en innovatieve materiaaloplossingen voor betonconstructies
descriptionHtml:
Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stage lopen bij Dura Vermeer.

Hoe maak je een betonconstructie duurzamer, zonder in te leveren op veiligheid en kwaliteit? Tijdens deze stage bij Dura Vermeer Divisie Infra onderzoek jij welke materialen daaraan kunnen bijdragen. Je combineert constructieve berekeningen met duurzaamheid en ontdekt hoe we materiaalkeuzes maken voor infraprojecten. Volg jij een technische hbo- of wo-opleiding en zoek je een meewerk- of afstudeerstage? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Dit wordt jouw stage

Voor betonconstructies komen steeds meer nieuwe materiaaloplossingen beschikbaar. Maar een materiaal met een lagere milieu-impact is niet automatisch voor iedere toepassing de beste keuze. Ook de sterkte, kosten en verwerking op de bouwplaats tellen mee. Hoe vergelijk je die oplossingen op een eerlijke manier? Dat ga jij onderzoeken.

Samen met je begeleider kies je een betonconstructie die als basis dient voor jouw onderzoek. Je onderzoekt hoe verschillende materiaaloplossingen aan dezelfde technische eisen kunnen voldoen. Vervolgens vergelijk je de oplossingen op technische prestaties, milieu-impact, kosten en praktische toepasbaarheid.

Afhankelijk van jouw opleiding, interesses en leerdoelen ga je aan de slag met:

  • Het kiezen van een geschikte betonconstructie en het vaststellen van de eisen waaraan deze moet voldoen.

  • Het verzamelen van informatie over bestaande en innovatieve materiaaloplossingen.

  • Het uitwerken van materiaalvarianten en het maken van constructieve berekeningen.

  • Het vergelijken van de varianten: wat zijn de voordelen, beperkingen en aandachtspunten?

  • Het vertalen van jouw resultaten naar een advies voor onze collega’s.

Je legt je aanpak, berekeningen en conclusies vast in een rapport en presenteert je bevindingen aan het team. Daarmee help je onze collega’s om beter onderbouwde materiaalkeuzes te maken.

Je staat er tijdens je onderzoek niet alleen voor. Je werkt samen met constructeurs, ontwerpers en duurzaamheidsadviseurs en krijgt begeleiding van ervaren collega’s. Zo leer je hoe constructief ontwerp en duurzaamheid in de praktijk samenkomen. Samen stemmen we de invulling en diepgang van de opdracht af op jouw opleiding en op de eisen van je meewerk- of afstudeerstage.

Bij ons breng je ook je eigen kennis en ideeën in. Je krijgt ruimte om vragen te stellen, initiatief te nemen en te ontdekken waar jouw interesses liggen. Zo maak je niet alleen meer van je studie, maar ook meer carrière.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Dit breng jij mee

  • Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Civiele Techniek, Constructieve Techniek, Structural Engineering, Built Environment met een constructieve specialisatie of een soort gelijke opleiding;

  • Je bent op zoek naar een stage voor minimaal vier dagen per week;

  • Je bent proactief en durft vragen te stellen;

  • Je bent analytisch, kritisch en onderzoekend;

  • Je hebt bij voorkeur kennis van betonconstructies en constructieve berekeningen;

  • Je hebt interesse in innovatieve materialen en duurzaamheid.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een mooie stagevergoeding van € 700 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week;

  • Bouw mee aan je toekomst: je stage is het perfecte startpunt om door te stromen naar een traineeship of startersbaan binnen Dura Vermeer;

  • Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en je eigen initiatieven te laten horen;

  • Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens;

  • Goede begeleiding van een ervaren collega of manager in jouw vakgebied. Je werkt tijdens je stage samen met fijne collega's die zorgen voor een leuke en professionele werksfeer;

  • Stage lopen én plezier maken: van kennismaking op de introductiedag tot leuke activiteiten en projectbezoeken met collega’s en medestagiaires.

Wil jij ook meer uit je stage halen?

Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Solliciteer direct via onze website met de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature (niet per e-mail).

Geef in jouw motivatiebrief duidelijk aan welke richting jou aanspreekt en wanneer je gewenste start- en einddatum is. Op die manier kunnen wij jou optimaal helpen.

descriptionHtml:

Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐 At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

Explore your future career 🔭

As our new Strategic Account Executive, you will drive Malt's growth across the French market by winning high-impact Enterprise accounts.

You will join the Enterprise Sales team, leading complex acquisition cycles from initial contact to contract execution.

You will focus on large French enterprises, navigating complex procurement ecosystems and strategic decision-makers.


Key responsibilities ✨

  • Execute targeted account prospecting strategies to identify and engage multi-stakeholder entry points across enterprise accounts.

  • Lead in-depth discovery and qualification using a structured sales framework (Meddic, BANT, SPIN..) to validate business pain points, metrics, and economic buyers.

  • Build compelling, ROI-driven business cases and tailored value proposals that resonate with C-level executives and procurement leaders.

  • Coordinate Proof of Value (PoV) and pilot programs to validate operational readiness, product capabilities and accelerate conversion of our Marketplace use cases.

  • Manage complex, multi-entity MSA commercial negotiations to close high-value, scalable agreements.

  • Orchestrate internal cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Bid Management, and Account Management) to ensure seamless deal structuring and post-signature handover.

  • Maintain high CRM hygiene, accurate pipeline tracking, and rigorous forecasting in Salesforce.


    • About you 🧑‍🚀

  • Proven track record (5+ years) in B2B enterprise sales, successfully closing complex, high-value deals (MSAs) with large corporations.

  • French on a native level and English on a fluent level, with outstanding executive communication and presentation skills.

  • Deep mastery of enterprise sales methodologies (MEDDIC, Value Selling) and disciplined pipeline management in CRM tools (Salesforce).

  • Strong business acumen and commercial negotiation skills, with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders, HR leaders, and Procurement departments.


    • How to join the mission? 🚀
  • First call with Agathe, our Talent Acquisition Lead, to better understand your background, aspirations, and answer any questions you may have. (30-45 minutes)
  • Interview with your future manager, Julien, to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role. (45-60 minutes)
  • Business case in order to assess your technical skills in enterprise strategy and ROI modeling.
  • Final interview with a C-level executive to discuss Malt’s long-term vision and your role in our expansion.

title: Strategic Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you'll do

You'll play a central role in building and growing Legora's most strategic global client relationships. Working closely with our Sales, Engagement, Customer Success and regional teams, you'll ensure our most important customers realise lasting value from Legora, while identifying opportunities to deepen relationships and expand our impact across their organisations.

This is a high-ownership role that combines commercial judgement, relationship management and strategic execution. You'll work with senior stakeholders at leading corporates and law firms, bringing together the right people across Legora to deliver an exceptional client experience and drive long-term growth.

Grow and deepen strategic client relationships

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across our most important global accounts, developing a deep understanding of their priorities, challenges and ambitions.

  • Identify and drive opportunities to expand Legora's presence across different functions in global client organisations, partnering with Account Executives and account owners to turn opportunities into commercial outcomes.

  • Develop strategic account pursuit plans that connect client priorities with clear opportunities for adoption, expansion and long-term growth.

  • Turn successful client engagements into repeatable approaches that can be applied across our wider strategic accounts portfolio.

Drive an exceptional client experience

  • Act as a key strategic point of contact for priority clients, working alongside our regional Sales, Engagement and Customer Success teams to deliver a consistent, high-quality experience.

  • Coordinate across internal teams and regions to ensure client priorities are understood, commitments are delivered and relationships continue to develop.

  • Anticipate risks to client relationships, take ownership of resolving challenges and ensure issues are addressed before they affect long-term success.

  • Identify opportunities to increase adoption and engagement across teams, practice areas and offices, helping clients realise the full value of Legora.

Bring the client's voice into Legora

  • Develop a deep understanding of how our strategic clients use Legora, where they see value and what they need from us next.

  • Identify and articulate return on investment from Legora to senior client stakeholders

  • Partner with Product and Legal Engineering to translate client feedback into insights that inform product development and improve the customer experience.

  • Connect clients with relevant expertise, resources and stakeholders across Legora to strengthen relationships and accelerate adoption.

Collaborate across Legora to drive growth

  • Partner closely with Sales, Engagement, Customer Success, Legal Engineering and Deal Desk to deliver a seamless experience across the client lifecycle, from initial engagement through to expansion and renewal.

  • Maintain clear account plans, stakeholder maps and commercial forecasts, ensuring teams have a shared understanding of priorities, opportunities and risks.

  • Share insights and best practices across the wider Growth organisation, helping define how Legora manages and grows its most strategic relationships.

What you'll bring

  • Experience in strategic account management, customer success, partnerships or commercial roles, ideally within B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.

  • A track record of building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and translating those relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to identify expansion opportunities, navigate complex account structures and drive initiatives through to completion.

  • Experience working with large, complex enterprise customers, ideally across multiple teams, business units or geographies.

  • Structured problem-solving skills and the ability to bring clarity, direction and momentum to complex client relationships.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to engage senior legal and business leaders.

  • A collaborative approach, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around shared client and commercial priorities.

  • Familiarity with the legal industry, professional services or legal technology is advantageous, but not essential.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
